english: Hello.
transliteration: NEE-how.
translation: 你好。

english: Good morning.
transliteration: JOH-sun.
translation: 早晨。

english: My name is ___.
transliteration: NGOH gee-OO ___.

english: I am your doctor.
transliteration: NGOH hay NEI geh ee-SUNG.
translation: 我係你嘅醫生。

english: I am your nurse.
transliteration: NGOH hay NEI geh woo-SUH.
translation: 我係你嘅護士。

english: I am a medical student.
transliteration: NGOH hay ee-KOHK SUE-sung.
translation: 我係醫科學生。

english: I am a social worker.
transliteration: NGOH hay SAH-gung.
translation: 我係社工。

english: How would you like me to address you?
transliteration: NEI seung NG-oh dim CHING-hoo NEI?
translation: 你想我點稱呼你？

english: How can I help you today?
transliteration: GUM-yut yow MEH-hoh-yee-bang doh NEI?
translation: 今日有咩可以幫到你？

english: Thank you for speaking with me.
transliteration: DOH-jeh NEI tung NG-oh gong.
translation: 多謝你同我講。

english: What language do you prefer to speak?
transliteration: NEI seung yong MEH-yu-yin king-GAHI?
translation: 你想用咩語言傾偈？

english: Would you like a professional interpreter?
transliteration: NEI seung m-seung yew JEEN-yip cheen-YIK-yoon bang-sow?
translation: 你想唔想要專業傳譯員幫手？

english: We can call an interpreter.
transliteration: NGOH-dei hoh-yee dah-deen-wah yawn cheen-YIK-yoon.
translation: 我哋可以打電話搵傳譯員。

english: Please speak slowly.
transliteration: CHING gong maan-dee.
translation: 請講慢啲。

english: Could you repeat that, please?
transliteration: HOH-m-hoh-yee ching NEI joy gong yat-chi?
translation: 可唔可以請你再講一次？

english: I did not understand. Could you explain again?
transliteration: NGOH m-ming-baak. HOH-m-hoh-yee joy gaai-sik yat-chi?
translation: 我唔明白。可唔可以再解釋一次？

english: Please tell me if anything is unclear.
transliteration: yow yam-hoh-yeh m-ching-choh, ching wah bei NG-oh jee.
translation: 有任何嘢唔清楚，請話俾我知。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow man-tai seung man?
translation: 你有冇問題想問？

english: Could you explain in your own words what we discussed?
transliteration: HOH-m-hoh-yee yong NEI ji-gei geh syut-wah, gong faan NGOH-dei king-gwoh geh yoon-yung?
translation: 可唔可以用你自己嘅說話，講返我哋傾過嘅內容？

english: You can answer yes or no.
transliteration: NEI hoh-yee daap HAY hai-hok-je HAY m-hai.
translation: 你可以答「係」或者「唔係」。

english: Please point to what you mean.
transliteration: CHING ji-chut NEI gong-gan geh deih-fong.
translation: 請指出你講緊嘅地方。

english: Is it okay if I ask you some questions?
transliteration: NGOH hoh-m-hoh-yee man NEI gei tiu man-tai?
translation: 我可唔可以問你幾條問題？

english: Would you like someone to stay with you?
transliteration: NEI seung m-seung yow-yan pui-jyu NEI?
translation: 你想唔想有人陪住你？

english: Would you prefer to speak privately?
transliteration: NEI seung m-seung si-dei-ha dih?
translation: 你想唔想私底下傾？

english: Is it okay if I examine you?
transliteration: NGOH hoh-m-hoh-yee bang NEI jou gim-cha?
translation: 我可唔可以幫你做檢查？

english: Please tell me if you feel uncomfortable.
transliteration: yut-gwoh NEI gok-dak m-syoo-foo, ching wah bei NG-oh jee.
translation: 如果你覺得唔舒服，請話俾我知。

english: We can stop at any time.
transliteration: NGOH-dei seui-si hoh-yee ting.
translation: 我哋隨時可以停。

english: Do you agree with this plan?
transliteration: NEI tung m-tung-yee nee-go gai-waak?
translation: 你同唔同意呢個計劃？

english: Would you like more time to decide?
transliteration: NEI seung m-seung doh-dee si-gaan haau-leui?
translation: 你想唔想多啲時間考慮？

english: I will explain what I am doing.
transliteration: NGOH wui gaai-sik NGOH yee-gaa jou-gan mat.
translation: 我會解釋我而家做緊乜。

english: What is your full name?
transliteration: NEI geh chyun-ming hay mat-yeh?
translation: 你嘅全名係乜嘢？

english: What is your date of birth?
transliteration: NEI geh choot-sang yat-kei hay gei-si?
translation: 你嘅出生日期係幾時？

english: How old are you?
transliteration: NEI gei-doh seui?
translation: 你幾多歲？

english: What is your phone number?
transliteration: NEI geh deen-wah hoh-mah hay gei-doh?
translation: 你嘅電話號碼係幾多？

english: What is your address?
transliteration: NEI geh dei-jai hay mat-yeh?
translation: 你嘅地址係乜嘢？

english: Who is your emergency contact?
transliteration: NEI geh gan-gap leen-lok-yan hay bin-go?
translation: 你嘅緊急聯絡人係邊個？

english: Do you have a family doctor?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow gaa-ting yee-sang?
translation: 你有冇家庭醫生？

english: What pharmacy do you use?
transliteration: NEI ping-si heui bin-gaan yeuk-fong pui-yeuk?
translation: 你平時去邊間藥房配藥？

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: GUM-yut hay mat-si ling NEI lai tai yee-sang?
translation: 今日係咩事令你嚟睇醫生？

english: What is your main concern?
transliteration: NEI jui daam-sam geh hay me?
translation: 你最擔心嘅係咩？

english: When did this problem start?
transliteration: NEE-go man-tai gei-si hoi-chi geh?
translation: 呢個問題幾時開始嘅？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: HAY dat-yin hoi-chi, ding-hay maan-maan hoi-chi?
translation: 係突然開始，定係慢慢開始？

english: Is it there all the time or does it come and go?
transliteration: NEE-go man-tai hay yat-jik do-yow, ding-hay si-yow-si-moh?
translation: 呢個問題係一直都有，定係時有時冇？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: ching-fong hay hoh-juen, ngok-fa, ding-hay mo-bin?
translation: 情況係好轉、惡化，定係冇變？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: NEI yee-chin yow-m-yow si-gwoh nee-go man-tai?
translation: 你以前有冇試過呢個問題？

english: What makes it better?
transliteration: jou-dee-meh wui ling ching-fong hoh-dee?
translation: 做啲咩會令情況好啲？

english: What makes it worse?
transliteration: jou-dee-meh wui ling ching-fong cha-dee?
translation: 做啲咩會令情況差啲？

english: Do you have any other symptoms?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow kei-ta jing-joong?
translation: 你有冇其他症狀？

english: How is this affecting your daily life?
transliteration: NEE-go ching-fong dim-yeung ying-heung NEI geh yat-chong sang-woot?
translation: 呢個情況點樣影響你嘅日常生活？

english: Where does it hurt?
transliteration: bin-doo tung?
translation: 邊度痛？

english: Can you point to where it hurts?
transliteration: HOH-m-hoh-yee ji-chut bin-doo tung?
translation: 可唔可以指出邊度痛？

english: Does the pain spread anywhere else?
transliteration: tung yow-m-yow kwok-saan doh kei-ta dei-fong?
translation: 痛有冇擴散到其他地方？

english: What does the pain feel like?
transliteration: tung hay dim-yeung geh gam-gok?
translation: 痛係點樣嘅感覺？

english: Is it sharp, dull, burning, or cramping?
transliteration: HAY chi-tung, yam-yam-jok-tung, jok-tung, ding-hay chow-gaan gam tung?
translation: 係刺痛、隱隱作痛、灼痛，定係抽筋咁痛？

english: On a scale from zero to ten, how bad is the pain?
transliteration: yut-gwoh yong ling doh sap-fan ping-fan, tung yow gei yim-joong?
translation: 如果用零到十分評分，痛有幾嚴重？

english: Does it hurt when I touch here?
transliteration: NGOH mo NGEE-do wui-m-wui tung?
translation: 我摸呢度會唔會痛？

english: Does the pain wake you from sleep?
transliteration: tung wui-m-wui tung-sing NEI?
translation: 痛會唔會痛醒你？

english: Is the pain different from before?
transliteration: NEE-chi geh tung tung ji-chin yow-m-yow m-tung?
translation: 呢次嘅痛同之前有冇唔同？

english: Do you have any long-term medical conditions?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow cheung-kei-bing?
translation: 你有冇長期病？

english: Have you ever stayed in a hospital?
transliteration: NEI yee-chin yow-m-yow jyu-gwoh yee-yoon?
translation: 你以前有冇住過醫院？

english: Have you had any operations?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow jou-gwoh sau-sut?
translation: 你有冇做過手術？

english: When were you diagnosed?
transliteration: NEI hay gei-si kok-jun geh?
translation: 你係幾時確診嘅？

english: Does anyone in your family have a similar condition?
transliteration: NEI uk-key yow-m-yow yan yow lui-sai geh bing?
translation: 你屋企有冇人有類似嘅病？

english: Do you have any allergies?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow man-gam?
translation: 你有冇敏感？

english: Are you allergic to any medicines?
transliteration: NEI deui yam-hoh yeuk-mat yow-m-yow man-gam?
translation: 你對任何藥物有冇敏感？

english: What happens when you have that reaction?
transliteration: NEI yow nee-jung faan-ying si wui yow MEH-hoh ching-fong?
translation: 你有呢種反應時會有咩情況？

english: Have you received your routine vaccinations?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow da KAI ping-si yiu da geh yee-miu?
translation: 你有冇打齊平時要打嘅疫苗？

english: What medicines do you take?
transliteration: NEI sik-gan MEH-yeh yeuk?
translation: 你食緊咩藥？

english: Can you show me your medication list?
transliteration: HOH-m-hoh-yee bei NG-oh tai-ha NEI geh yeuk-mat ching-daan?
translation: 可唔可以俾我睇吓你嘅藥物清單？

english: What dose do you take?
transliteration: NEI mui-chi sik gei-doh jai-leung?
translation: 你每次食幾多劑量？

english: How often do you take it?
transliteration: NEI gei-noi sik yat-chi?
translation: 你幾耐食一次？

english: When did you last take it?
transliteration: NEI seung-chi gei-si sik?
translation: 你上次幾時食？

english: Have you started any new medicines?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow hoi-chi sik san yeuk?
translation: 你有冇開始食新藥？

english: Have you stopped taking any medicines?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow ting-sik yam-hoh yeuk?
translation: 你有冇停食任何藥？

english: Have you missed any doses?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow loh-sik yeuk?
translation: 你有冇漏食藥？

english: Do you take vitamins or herbal remedies?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow sik wai-ta-ming waak-je chow-yeuk?
translation: 你有冇食維他命或者草藥？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow lau-yee doh yam-hoh foo-jok-yung?
translation: 你有冇留意到任何副作用？

english: Who do you live with?
transliteration: NEI tung bin-go yat-chi jyu?
translation: 你同邊個一齊住？

english: Do you have someone who can help you at home?
transliteration: NEI uk-key yow-m-yow yan hoh-yee bang doh NEI?
translation: 你屋企有冇人可以幫到你？

english: Do you feel safe at home?
transliteration: NEI hai uk-key gok-dak on-chyun ma?
translation: 你喺屋企覺得安全嗎？

english: Do you need help with everyday activities?
transliteration: yat-chong sang-woot yow-m-yow dee si yiu yan bang-sow?
translation: 日常生活有冇啲事需要人幫手？

english: Do you have reliable transportation to appointments?
transliteration: NEI heui foo-chan yow-m-yow hoh-kaau geh gaau-tung on-paai?
translation: 你去覆診有冇可靠嘅交通安排？

english: Do you have trouble paying for medicines?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow ging-jai kwan-naan, maai-m-hey yeuk?
translation: 你有冇經濟困難，買唔起藥？

english: Do you have a stable place to live?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow wan-ding geh jyu-choo?
translation: 你有冇穩定嘅住處？

english: What kind of work do you do?
transliteration: NEI jou bin yat-hong?
translation: 你做邊一行？

english: Do you need a medical note for work or school?
transliteration: NEI faan-gung waak-je faan-hok yiu yee-sang ji ma?
translation: 你返工或者返學需要醫生紙嗎？

english: Please sit here.
transliteration: CHING choo hai NEE-do.
translation: 請坐喺呢度。

english: Please lie down.
transliteration: CHING fan-dai.
translation: 請瞓低。

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: CHING juen-san seik-heung yat-bin fan.
translation: 請轉身側向一邊瞓。

english: Please stand up slowly.
transliteration: CHING maan-maan kei-yaat-san.
translation: 請慢慢企起身。

english: Please stay still for a moment.
transliteration: CHING jaam-si m-hoh yuhk.
translation: 請暫時唔好郁。

english: Please take a deep breath.
transliteration: CHING sam-hup-sik.
translation: 請深呼吸。

english: Please breathe normally.
transliteration: CHING jiu-chong hup-sik.
translation: 請照常呼吸。

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: yut-gwoh yow yam-hoh dei-fong tung, ching wah bei NG-oh jee.
translation: 如果有任何地方痛，請話俾我知。

english: May I check your blood pressure?
transliteration: NGOH hoh-m-hoh-yee bang NEI leung hyut-aat ma?
translation: 我可以幫你量血壓嗎？

english: I am going to check your temperature.
transliteration: NGOH yee-gaa wui bang NEI leung tai-wan.
translation: 我而家會幫你量體溫。

english: We will check your height and weight.
transliteration: NGOH-dei wui leung NEI geh san-go tung tai-jung.
translation: 我哋會量你嘅身高同體重。

english: You can get dressed now.
transliteration: NEI yee-gaa hoh-yee jeung faan saam.
translation: 你而家可以着返衫。

english: We would like to do a blood test.
transliteration: NGOH-dei seung bang NEI chow hyut-yim hyut.
translation: 我哋想幫你抽血驗血。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: NGOH-dei seui-yiu NEI tai-gung nyu-yik yeung-bun.
translation: 我哋需要你提供尿液樣本。

english: The test may cause brief discomfort.
transliteration: NEE-go gim-cha hoh-nang wui ling NEI doen-jyun m-syoo-foo.
translation: 呢個檢查可能會令你短暫唔舒服。

english: The results are not ready yet.
transliteration: git-gwoh jung-mei choot.
translation: 結果仲未出。

english: The test results are normal.
transliteration: gim-cha git-gwoh jing-seung.
translation: 檢查結果正常。

english: The test results need further review.
transliteration: gim-cha git-gwoh seui-yiu joy tai yat-tai.
translation: 檢查結果需要再睇一睇。

english: We may need more tests.
transliteration: NGOH-dei hoh-nang yiu jou do-dee gim-cha.
translation: 我哋可能要做多啲檢查。

english: We will explain the results to you.
transliteration: NGOH-dei wui tung NEI gaai-sik git-gwoh.
translation: 我哋會同你解釋結果。

english: There are several treatment options.
transliteration: yow gei-jung ji-liu fong-faat hoh-yee suy-jik.
translation: 有幾種治療方法可以選擇。

english: I would like to explain the benefits and risks.
transliteration: NGOH seung tung NEI gaai-sik ji-liu geh hoh-choh tung fung-heen.
translation: 我想同你解釋治療嘅好處同風險。

english: What matters most to you in choosing treatment?
transliteration: gim ji-liu fong-faat go-jan, NEI jui-jung-si dee mat?
translation: 揀治療方法嗰陣，你最着重啲乜？

english: This treatment may take time to work.
transliteration: NEE-jung ji-liu hoh-nang yiu yat-doen si-gaan sin gin-haau.
translation: 呢種治療可能要一段時間先見效。

english: Please take the medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: CHING on yee-sang ji-si sik yeuk.
translation: 請按醫生指示食藥。

english: Please do not change the dose without medical advice.
transliteration: mei-yow yee-woo yan-gwoon gin-yee ji-chin, ching m-hoh ji-hang goi yeuk-leung.
translation: 未有醫護人員建議之前，請唔好自行改藥量。

english: Please let us know if you have side effects.
transliteration: yut-gwoh yow foo-jok-yung, ching wah bei NGOH-dei jee.
translation: 如果有副作用，請話畀我哋知。

english: Would you like written instructions?
transliteration: NEI seung yiu syu-min ji-si ma?
translation: 你想要書面指示嗎？

english: Please wait in the waiting area.
transliteration: CHING hai dang-hau-keui dang yat-dang.
translation: 請喺等候區等一等。

english: The nurse will see you shortly.
transliteration: woo-suh hoh-faai wui gin NEI.
translation: 護士好快會見你。

english: The doctor will come back soon.
transliteration: yee-sang hoh-faai wui faan-lai.
translation: 醫生好快會返嚟。

english: We are taking you to another room.
transliteration: NGOH-dei yee-gaa daai NEI heui ling yat-gaan fong.
translation: 我哋而家帶你去另一間房。

english: You may need to stay in the hospital.
transliteration: NEI hoh-nang yiu lau hai yee-yoon.
translation: 你可能要留喺醫院。

english: We will observe you for a little longer.
transliteration: NGOH-dei wui joy gwaan-jyu NEI yat-jun.
translation: 我哋會再觀察你一陣。

english: You can go home today.
transliteration: NEI GUM-yut hoh-yee faan-uk-key.
translation: 你今日可以返屋企。

english: Where is your appointment scheduled?
transliteration: NEI yue-yue-syue jou hai bin-doo tai?
translation: 你預約咗喺邊度睇？

english: Please bring your medication list next time.
transliteration: haa-chi ching daai-maai NEI geh yeuk-mat ching-daan.
translation: 下次請帶埋你嘅藥物清單。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: NGOH-dei wui bang NEI on-paai foo-chan.
translation: 我哋會幫你安排覆診。

english: Please follow up with your family doctor.
transliteration: CHING yawn NEI geh gaa-ting yee-sang gan-jun.
translation: 請搵你嘅家庭醫生跟進。

english: We will contact you about the results.
transliteration: yow git-gwoh NGOH-dei wui leen-lok NEI.
translation: 有結果我哋會聯絡你。

english: Please come back if your symptoms get worse.
transliteration: yut-gwoh jing-jong Ngok-fa, ching faan-lai tai.
translation: 如果症狀惡化，請返嚟睇。

english: If you have a medical emergency, call emergency services.
transliteration: yut-gwoh yow gan-gap yee-liu ching-fong, ching da gan-gap deen-wah kau-joh.
translation: 如果有緊急醫療情況，請打緊急電話求助。

english: Do you understand the next steps?
transliteration: NEI ming-m-ming-baak jip-jyu lok-lai yiu jou-dee-meh?
translation: 你明唔明白接住落嚟要做啲乜？

english: Is there anything else you would like to discuss?
transliteration: jung yow-m-yow kei-ta yeh seung king?
translation: 仲有冇其他嘢想傾？

english: Thank you. Take care.
transliteration: M-GOI. BOH-jung.
translation: 唔該。保重。

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: NEI-how, NG-oh hay NEI yee-liu team geh yat-yun.
translation: 你好，我係你醫療團隊嘅一員。

english: What brought you to the hospital today?
transliteration: GUM-yut hay mat-yeh ling NEI lai yee-yoon?
translation: 今日係乜嘢令你嚟醫院？

english: What is worrying you the most?
transliteration: NEI jui daam-sam dee mat?
translation: 你最擔心啲乜？

english: I would like to ask some questions about your heart.
transliteration: NGOH seung man NEI gei tiu gwaan-yu sam-jong geh man-tai.
translation: 我想問你幾條關於心臟嘅問題。

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: NGOH hoh-m-hoh-yee bang NEI jou gim-cha ma?
translation: 我可以幫你做檢查嗎？

english: Please tell me if you feel uncomfortable.
transliteration: yut-gwoh NEI gok-dak m-syoo-foo, ching wah bei NG-oh jee.
translation: 如果你覺得唔舒服，請話畀我知。

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: NEI seui-yiu cheen-YIK-yoon ma?
translation: 你需要傳譯員嗎？

english: When did your symptoms begin?
transliteration: NEI gei-si hoi-chi yow nee-dee jing-joong?
translation: 你幾時開始有呢啲症狀？

english: Did they start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: dee jing-joong hay dat-yin hoi-chi, ding-hay maan-maan hoi-chi?
translation: 啲症狀係突然開始，定係慢慢開始？

english: What were you doing when they started?
transliteration: hoi-chi go-jan NEI hai-do jou-gan mat?
translation: 開始嗰陣你喺度做緊乜？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: mui-chi faat-jok wui chi-juk gei-noi?
translation: 每次發作會持續幾耐？

english: How many days have you had these symptoms?
transliteration: NEI yow nee-dee jing-joong gei-doh yat la?
translation: 你有呢啲症狀幾多日喇？

english: How often does this happen?
transliteration: NEE-jung ching-fong gei-noi faat-sang yat-chi?
translation: 呢種情況幾耐發生一次？

english: Is it constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: NEE-jung gam-gok hay chi-juk geh, ding-hay si-yow-si-moh?
translation: 呢種感覺係持續嘅，定係時有時無？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: ching-fong yow hoh-juen, ngok-fa, ding-hay mo-bin?
translation: 情況有好轉、惡化，定係冇變？

english: Has this happened before?
transliteration: yee-chin yow-m-yow si-gwoh gam-yeung?
translation: 以前有冇試過咁樣？

english: Do you have chest pain right now?
transliteration: NEI yee-gaa yow-m-yow hung-hau tung?
translation: 你而家有冇胸口痛？

english: Please point to where it hurts.
transliteration: CHING ji bei NG-oh tai bin-doo tung.
translation: 請指畀我睇邊度痛。

english: Is the pain in the middle, left, or right side of your chest?
transliteration: NEI hung-hau jung-gaan, jo-bin ding-hai yau-bin tung?
translation: 你胸口中間、左邊定右邊痛？

english: Does it feel like pressure or heaviness?
transliteration: tung geh gam-gok chi-sai sau-aat waak-je hoh-jung ma?
translation: 痛嘅感覺似受壓或者好重嗎？

english: Does it feel tight or squeezing?
transliteration: tung geh gam-gok chi-sai bang-gan waak-je bei-yip-jyu ma?
translation: 痛嘅感覺似繃緊或者被揑住嗎？

english: Is it sharp or stabbing?
transliteration: tung hay kim-ngoi waak-je chi-sai bei yeh chi-dou ma?
translation: 痛係尖銳或者似畀嘢刺到嗎？

english: Does it feel like burning?
transliteration: tung geh gam-gok chi-sai jok-yit ma?
translation: 痛嘅感覺似灼熱嗎？

english: Does the pain spread to your arm or shoulder?
transliteration: tung wui-m-wui yin-san doh NEI jeung sau-bei waak-je bok-tau?
translation: 痛會唔會延伸到你隻手臂或者膊頭？

english: Does the pain spread to your jaw or neck?
transliteration: tung wui-m-wui yin-san doh NEI go haa-ba waak-je gang?
translation: 痛會唔會延伸到你個下巴或者頸？

english: Does the pain spread to your back?
transliteration: tung wui-m-wui yin-san doh NEI bui-jik?
translation: 痛會唔會延伸到你背脊？

english: On a scale from zero to ten, how severe is the pain?
transliteration: yiu ling doh sap, tung yow gei yim-joong?
translation: 由零到十，痛有幾嚴重？

english: Is this the worst chest pain you have ever had?
transliteration: NEE-chi hay NEI si-gwoh jui-yim-joong geh hung-hau tung ma?
translation: 呢次係你試過最嚴重嘅胸口痛嗎？

english: Does the pain start when you walk or climb stairs?
transliteration: NEI haang-loo waak-je haang lau-tai go-jan wui hoi-chi tung ma?
translation: 你行路或者行樓梯嗰陣會開始痛嗎？

english: Does the pain improve when you rest?
transliteration: jau-sik go-jan, tung wui-m-wui hoh-dee?
translation: 休息嘅時候，痛會唔會好啲？

english: Does the pain occur even when resting?
transliteration: jau-sik go-jan dou wui tung ma?
translation: 休息嘅時候都會痛嗎？

english: Does deep breathing make the pain worse?
transliteration: sam-hup-sik wui-m-wui ling tung-choh ga-gaai ma?
translation: 深呼吸會令痛楚加劇嗎？

english: Does coughing make it worse?
transliteration: haak-sau wui-m-wui ling tung-choh ga-gaai ma?
translation: 咳嗽會令痛楚加劇嗎？

english: Does pressing on your chest make it worse?
transliteration: an NEI go hung-hau wui-m-wui ling tung-choh ga-gaai ma?
translation: 按你個胸口會令痛楚加劇嗎？

english: Does changing position affect the pain?
transliteration: juen-woon ji-sai wui-ying tung-choh ma?
translation: 轉換姿勢會影響痛楚嗎？

english: Does lying flat make it worse?
transliteration: ping-taai wui-m-wui ling tung-choh ga-gaai ma?
translation: 平躺會令痛楚加劇嗎？

english: Does leaning forward make it better?
transliteration: heung-chin king wui-m-wui ling tung-choh hoh-dee ma?
translation: 向前傾會令痛楚好啲嗎？

english: Does the pain occur after eating?
transliteration: sik-jyun yeh ji-hau wui tung ma?
translation: 食完嘢之後會痛嗎？

english: Does anything else make the pain better or worse?
transliteration: jung yow-m-yow kei-ta yeh wui ling tung-choh hoh-dee waak-je cha-dee?
translation: 仲有冇其他嘢會令痛楚好啲或者差啲？

english: Are you having trouble breathing right now?
transliteration: NEI yee-gaa yow-m-yow foo-sik kwan-naan?
translation: 你而家有冇呼吸困難？

english: Have you fainted or lost consciousness?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow wan-dou waak-je sat-heui ji-gok?
translation: 你有冇暈低或者失去知覺？

english: Do you feel dizzy or lightheaded?
transliteration: NEI gok-dak tau-yun waak-je tau hing-piu-piu ma?
translation: 你覺得頭暈或者頭輕飄飄嗎？

english: Have you had cold sweats?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow choot laang-haan?
translation: 你有冇出冷汗？

english: Do you feel nauseated or have you vomited?
transliteration: NEI gok-m-gok-dak faan-wei waak-je ou-gwoh?
translation: 你覺唔覺得反胃或者嘔過？

english: Have you suddenly developed severe pain in your chest or back?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow dat-yin hung-hau waak-je bui-jik kek-tung?
translation: 你有冇突然胸口或者背脊劇痛？

english: Have you coughed up blood?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow haak hyut?
translation: 你有冇咳血？

english: Has one leg suddenly become swollen or painful?
transliteration: yow-m-yow yat-jek goek dat-yin jung-jo waak-je tung?
translation: 有冇一隻腳突然腫咗或者痛？

english: Do your lips or fingers look blue?
transliteration: NEI geh jeui-chun waak-je sau-jai yow-m-yow bin-laam?
translation: 你嘅嘴唇或者手指有冇變藍？

english: Are you having new weakness or trouble speaking?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow san choot-yin geh mo-lik, waak-je gong-yeh yow kwan-naan?
translation: 你有冇新出現嘅無力，或者講嘢有困難？

english: Do you get short of breath when walking?
transliteration: NEI haang-loo go-jan wui-m-wui hei-chyun?
translation: 你行路嗰陣會唔會氣喘？

english: How far can you walk before you need to stop?
transliteration: NEI haang gei-yuen jow yiu ting-dai jau-sik?
translation: 你行幾遠就要停低休息？

english: Can you climb one flight of stairs?
transliteration: NEI haang-m-haang dou yat-chong lau-tai?
translation: 你行唔行到一層樓梯？

english: Do you get short of breath while resting?
transliteration: NEI jau-sik go-jan wui-m-wui hei-chyun?
translation: 你休息嘅時候會唔會氣喘？

english: Is breathing harder when you lie flat?
transliteration: ping-taai go-jan wui-m-wui gok-dak foo-sik gang kwan-naan?
translation: 平躺嘅時候會唔會覺得呼吸更困難？

english: How many pillows do you sleep with?
transliteration: NEI fan-gaak wui yong gei-doh-go jaam-tau?
translation: 你瞓覺會用幾多個枕頭？

english: Do you wake up at night gasping for air?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow si-gwoh fan-dou bun-yeh dat-yin sing-jo, chyun-jyu hei?
translation: 你有冇試過瞓到半夜突然醒咗，喘住氣？

english: Have your feet or ankles become swollen?
transliteration: NEI geh goek waak-je goek-ngaan yow-m-yow jung?
translation: 你嘅腳或者腳眼有冇腫？

english: Have you gained weight suddenly?
transliteration: NEI yow-m-yow dat-yin jung-jo?
translation: 你有冇突然重咗？

english: Are you more tired than usual?
transliteration: NEI hay-m-hay bei ping-si gang gui?
translation: 你係咪比平時更攰？

english: Has your ability to do daily activities changed?
transliteration: NEI jou yat-chong waat-dung geh nang-lik yow-m-yow goi-bin?
translation: 你做日常活動嘅能力有冇改變？

english: Does your heart sometimes race or beat very fast?
transliteration: NEI yow-si wui-m-wui gok-dak sam-tiut-dak hoh-faai?
translation: 你有時會唔會覺得心跳得好快？

english: Does your heartbeat feel irregular?
transliteration: NEI gok-m-gok-dak sam-tiut m-gwai-lut?
translation: 你覺唔覺得心跳唔規律？

english: Does it feel like your heart skips a beat?
transliteration: NEI gok-m-gok-dak go sam hou-chi lou-tiut yat-paak?
translation: 你覺唔覺得個心好似漏跳一拍？

english: Does your heart suddenly start and stop racing?
transliteration: NEI go sam wui-m-wui dat-yin tiut-dak hoh-faai, ji-hau yau dat-yin ting faan?
translation: 你個心會唔會突然跳得好快，之後又突然停返？

english: How long do the palpitations last?
transliteration: sam-gwai wui chi-juk gei-noi?
translation: 心悸會持續幾耐？

english: Do you feel dizzy when your heart races?
transliteration: NEI sam-tiut-dak hoh-faai go-jan wui-m-wui tau-yun?
translation: 你心跳得好快嗰陣會唔會頭暈？

english: Did you have any warning before fainting?
transliteration: NEI wan-dou ji-chin yow-m-yow yam-hoh sin-jiu?
translation: 你暈低之前有冇任何先兆？

english: Did you faint during exercise?
transliteration: NEI jou wan-dung go-jan yow-m-yow wan-dou?
translation: 你做運動嗰陣有冇暈低？

english: Did you injure yourself when you fell?
transliteration: NEI dai-dou go-jan yow-m-yow jing-can ji-gei?
translation: 你跌低嗰陣有冇整親自己？

english: Has anyone in your family died suddenly at a young age?
transliteration: nay uk-KAY yau-MOW-yahn hau-SAHNG goh-jahn dahk-YEEN gwoh-SUN
translation: 你屋企有冇人後生嗰陣突然過身？

english: Have you been told you have high blood pressure?
transliteration: yau-MOW-yahn tung nay gohng-gwoh nay hyoot-PONG GOW
translation: 有冇人同你講過你血壓高？

english: Do you measure your blood pressure at home?
transliteration: nay hai uk-KAY yau-MOW lohng hyoot-PONG
translation: 你喺屋企有冇量血壓？

english: What is your usual blood pressure?
transliteration: nay ping-SIH hyoot-PONG gay-DOH
translation: 你平時血壓幾多？

english: Have you been told you have high cholesterol?
transliteration: yau-MOW-yahn tung nay gohng-gwoh nay daam-GOOH-SOHN GOW
translation: 有冇人同你講過你膽固醇高？

english: Do you have diabetes?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW tong-YEEH-bing
translation: 你有冇糖尿病？

english: Do you smoke cigarettes or use tobacco?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sik-YEEN waak-JAY yung-YEEN-CHO
translation: 你有冇食煙或者用煙草？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW YUM-JAU
translation: 你有冇飲酒？

english: Do you use cocaine or other recreational drugs?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW yung-hoh-KAH-YEEN waak-JAY kei-TAH siu-HIN-sing DOOK-ban
translation: 你有冇用可卡因或者其他消遣性毒品？

english: How physically active are you?
transliteration: nay ping-SIH zouh gay-DOH yun-DUNG
translation: 你平時做幾多運動？

english: Does anyone in your family have heart disease?
transliteration: nay uk-KAY yau-MOW-yahn yau-SAM-JOHNG-bing
translation: 你屋企有冇人有心臟病？

english: Have you ever had a heart attack?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW sih-GWOH SAM-JOHNG-bing-FAT
translation: 你以前有冇試過心臟病發？

english: Have you been told you have angina?
transliteration: yau-MOW-yahn tung nay gohng-gwoh nay yau-SAM-yin-TUNG
translation: 有冇人同你講過你有心絞痛？

english: Have you been told you have heart failure?
transliteration: yau-MOW-yahn tung nay gohng-gwoh nay yau-SAM-JOHNG-SYUAI-faat
translation: 有冇人同你講過你有心臟衰竭？

english: Do you have atrial fibrillation or another irregular rhythm?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW SAM-fong-faahn-DUNG waak-JAY kei-TAH SAM-leot-bat-jing
translation: 你有冇心房顫動或者其他心律不正？

english: Do you have a heart valve problem?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW SAM-faan-MAAN-taai
translation: 你有冇心瓣問題？

english: Have you ever had heart surgery?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW zouh-gwoh SAM-JOHNG-sau-seot
translation: 你以前有冇做過心臟手術？

english: Have you had a stent placed in an artery of your heart?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sih-GWOH hai SAM-JOHNG ge BOK-gwun fong-ji-SOHNG
translation: 你有冇試過喺心臟嘅血管放支架？

english: Have you had bypass surgery?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW zouh-gwoh DAAK-kiu-sau-seot
translation: 你有冇做過搭橋手術？

english: Do you have a pacemaker or defibrillator?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW jong kej-BOK-kee waak-JAY choy-CHAN-kee
translation: 你有冇裝起搏器或者除顫器？

english: Have you ever had a blood clot in your leg or lung?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW sih-GWOH goek waak-JAY fai-yau hyoot-faai
translation: 你以前有冇試過腳或者肺有血塊？

english: Have you had a stroke or mini-stroke?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sih-GWOH joong-FONG waak-JAY siu-joong-FONG
translation: 你有冇試過中風或者小中風？

english: Do your calves hurt when you walk?
transliteration: nay haang-LOU goh-jahn siu-TUI wui-MOW TUNG
translation: 你行路嗰陣小腿會唔會痛？

english: Does the leg pain improve when you stop walking?
transliteration: nay ting-DAI m-HAAng ji-hau, jek-GOEK ge TUNG wui-MOW hou-DI
translation: 你停低唔行之後，隻腳嘅痛會唔會好啲？

english: Do your feet feel unusually cold?
transliteration: nay deui-GOEK wui-MOW dong-dak bat-sam-choeng
translation: 你對腳會唔會凍得唔尋常？

english: Have you noticed a change in the colour of your feet?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW lau-YI dou goek ge YAN-sik yau-BIN
translation: 你有冇留意到腳嘅顏色有變？

english: Do you have wounds on your feet that are not healing?
transliteration: nay jek-GOEK yau-MOW soeng-HOUK yiht-jik dou mei-HOU
translation: 你隻腳有冇傷口一直都未好？

english: Is one leg more swollen than the other?
transliteration: hai-MAI yau-YEK jek-GOEK bei ling-YEK jung
translation: 係咪有一隻腳比另一隻腫？

english: Do you have pain in your legs even at rest?
transliteration: nay deui-GOEK zau-SOEN m-YUK, sau-SIK gan dou wui-MOW TUNG ma
translation: 你對腳就算唔郁、休息緊都會痛嗎？

english: What medicines do you take every day?
transliteration: nay mui-YAHT sik-DI mat-YEOK
translation: 你每日食啲乜嘢藥？

english: Can you show me your medication list?
transliteration: hoh-BAT-hoh-YEE bei-NGOH tai-ha nay ge yeok-MAAT ching-DAN
translation: 可唔可以畀我睇吓你嘅藥物清單？

english: What dose do you take?
transliteration: nay mui-CHOH sik gay-DOH jai-LOENG
translation: 你每次食幾多劑量？

english: How many times a day do you take it?
transliteration: nay yat-YAHT sik gay-DOH chi
translation: 你一日食幾多次？

english: When did you start taking this medicine?
transliteration: nay gay-SHI ge sik ni-JEK yeok
translation: 你幾時開始食呢隻藥？

english: Did you take your medicines today?
transliteration: nay gam-YAHT yau-MOW sik-yeok
translation: 你今日有冇食藥？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: nay jeui-GAN yau-MOW lou-sik gwoh yeok
translation: 你最近有冇漏食過藥？

english: Have you stopped any medicines recently?
transliteration: nay jeui-GAN yau-MOW ting-sik gwoh yahn-hoh yeok
translation: 你最近有冇停食過任何藥？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW lau-YI dou yahn-hoh foh-FONG-ying
translation: 你有冇留意到有任何副作用？

english: Do you take aspirin or another blood thinner?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sik aa-sih-pi-lin waak-JAY kei-TAH bok-HYUT yeok
translation: 你有冇食阿士匹靈或者其他薄血藥？

english: Do you take medicine for blood pressure?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sik hyoot-PONG yeok
translation: 你有冇食血壓藥？

english: Do you take medicine for cholesterol?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sik daam-GOOH-SOHN yeok
translation: 你有冇食膽固醇藥？

english: Do you take water pills to help you pass urine?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sik lay-yiu-yeok bong-JO pai-YIU
translation: 你有冇食利尿藥幫助排尿？

english: Have you used nitroglycerin for chest pain?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sih-GWOH yung-siu-SONG-GAAN-yau lai yi SAM-hoh-TUNG
translation: 你有冇試過用硝酸甘油嚟醫胸口痛？

english: Have you taken medication for erectile dysfunction recently?
transliteration: nay jeui-GAN yau-MOW sik-gwoh ji-LIU bok-KAI gong-NAANG-jeong-ZAANG ge yeok
translation: 你最近有冇食過治療勃起功能障礙嘅藥？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW deui yahn-hoh yeok-MAAT min-GAAN
translation: 你有冇對任何藥物敏感？

english: I am going to check your blood pressure.
transliteration: NGOH yi-GAA wui bong nay lohng hyoot-PONG
translation: 我而家會幫你量血壓。

english: I am going to check your pulse.
transliteration: NGOH yi-GAA wui bong nay lohng-maai-MAAT
translation: 我而家會幫你量脈搏。

english: I am going to measure your oxygen level.
transliteration: NGOH yi-GAA wui bong nay lohng hyoot-YEONG
translation: 我而家會幫你量血氧。

english: Please sit comfortably.
transliteration: ching cho-SOHK-dak-FU-dih
translation: 請坐得舒服啲。

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: ching yehng-WOHN
translation: 請你仰臥。

english: I am going to listen to your heart with a stethoscope.
transliteration: NGOH yi-GAA wui yung ting-TUNG teng-ha nay go-SAM
translation: 我而家會用聽筒聽吓你個心。

english: Please breathe normally.
transliteration: ching jiu-CHOHNG hohng-GAP
translation: 請照常呼吸。

english: Take a deep breath in and out.
transliteration: ching SAM-sam-sap yat-daam-HEI, joi foh-chut-LEI
translation: 請深深吸一啖氣，再呼出嚟。

english: Please hold your breath for a moment.
transliteration: ching taam-SHI biu-jyu-hei
translation: 請暫時閉住氣。

english: I am going to listen to your lungs.
transliteration: NGOH yi-GAA wui teng-ha nay ge fai
translation: 我而家會聽吓你嘅肺。

english: I am going to check for swelling in your legs.
transliteration: NGOH yi-GAA wui jim-chaak-ha nay deui-GOEK yau-MOW jung
translation: 我而家會檢查吓你對腳有冇腫。

english: I am going to press gently on your abdomen.
transliteration: NGOH yi-GAA wui hing-hing an-ha nay go-TONG
translation: 我而家會輕輕按吓你個肚。

english: Please turn onto your left side.
transliteration: ching jyun-heung joh-ZOEK-bin jaak-SAN
translation: 請轉向左邊側身瞓。

english: Please sit up.
transliteration: ching cho-SOHK-hei-SAN
translation: 請坐起身。

english: We need to do an ECG to record your heart rhythm.
transliteration: NGOH-dei yiu bong nay zouh SAM-din-toh, gei-luk nay ge SAM-leot
translation: 我哋要幫你做心電圖，記錄你嘅心律。

english: We need to take some blood tests.
transliteration: NGOH-dei yiu bong nay chou-HYUT zouh gay-geung chaak
translation: 我哋要幫你抽血做幾項檢查。

english: We are checking for signs of heart muscle damage.
transliteration: NGOH-dei wui chaak-ha yau-MOW SAM-gok sau-SOEN ge jeong-JAANG
translation: 我哋會檢查有冇心肌受損嘅跡象。

english: We would like to do an ultrasound of your heart.
transliteration: NGOH-dei soeng bong nay jiu SAM-JOHNG chiu-ying-BOR
translation: 我哋想幫你照心臟超聲波。

english: This test is called an echocardiogram.
transliteration: ni-GOH chaak-ying giu SAM-JOHNG chiu-ying-BOR
translation: 呢個檢查叫心臟超聲波。

english: You may need to wear a heart monitor.
transliteration: nay hoh-NAANG yiu daai-jyu SAM-JOHNG gaam-CHAA-kei
translation: 你可能要戴住心臟監察器。

english: We may need a chest X-ray.
transliteration: NGOH-dei hoh-NAANG yiu bong nay jiu HUNG-fai eks-GWONG
translation: 我哋可能要幫你照胸肺X光。

english: We may need a CT scan.
transliteration: NGOH-dei hoh-NAANG yiu bong nay zouh din-NOU saam
translation: 我哋可能要幫你做電腦掃描。

english: We may need to do a stress test.
transliteration: NGOH-dei hoh-NAANG yiu bong nay zouh yun-DUNG SAM-din-toh chaak-ying
translation: 我哋可能要幫你做運動心電圖檢查。

english: We may need to examine the arteries of your heart.
transliteration: NGOH-dei hoh-NAANG yiu chaak-ha nay SAM-JOHNG ge hyoot-GWUN
translation: 我哋可能要檢查你心臟嘅血管。

english: We are going to give you oxygen if you need it.
transliteration: yu-GWOH nay yau-soi-YIU, NGOH-dei wui bei ONG-hei nay
translation: 如果你有需要，我哋會畀氧氣你。

english: We need to put a small tube into a vein.
transliteration: NGOH-dei yiu hai nay tiu hyoot-GWUN fong-yap yat-tiu sai-hou-gun
translation: 我哋要喺你條血管放入一條細喉管。

english: We will give you medicine for your symptoms.
transliteration: NGOH-dei wui bei yeok nay, bong nay syu-WAAN jing-JAANG
translation: 我哋會畀藥你，幫你舒緩症狀。

english: We need to monitor your heart rhythm.
transliteration: NGOH-dei yiu gaam-CHAA nay ge SAM-leot
translation: 我哋要監察你嘅心律。

english: A cardiologist will assess you.
transliteration: SAM-JOHNG-koh yi-SANG wui bong nay ping-GAA
translation: 心臟科醫生會幫你評估。

english: You may need to stay in hospital for monitoring.
transliteration: nay hoh-NAANG yiu lau-hai yi-YUN gaam-CHAA yat-duhn sih-GAAN
translation: 你可能要留喺醫院監察一段時間。

english: We will explain the benefits and risks before any procedure.
transliteration: zouh yahn-hoh ching-jing ji-qian, NGOH-dei wui sin tung nay gaai-SIK hou-CHO jeung-CHYU
translation: 做任何程序之前，我哋會先同你解釋好處同風險。

english: Do you have any questions about the procedure?
transliteration: nay deui ni-GOH ching-jing yau-MOW man-TAI
translation: 你對呢個程序有冇問題？

english: I will explain what we have found so far.
transliteration: NGOH wui tung nay gaai-SIK dou muhn-CHIN wai-JI NGoh-dei faat-yin joh-DI mat-YE
translation: 我會同你解釋到目前為止我哋發現咗啲乜。

english: We are still waiting for some test results.
transliteration: NGOH-dei zung-dang-gan buhn-fahn chaak-ying git-GWOH
translation: 我哋仲等緊部分檢查結果。

english: Please seek urgent help if chest pain or severe breathlessness returns.
transliteration: yu-GWOH SAM-hoh-TUNG waak-JAY jin-JOENG hei-chut joi-FAN, ching lap-jik kau-YEE
translation: 如果胸口痛或者嚴重氣促返嚟，請即刻求醫。

english: Please take your medicines as prescribed.
transliteration: ching on-jau choh-fong sik-yeok
translation: 請按照處方食藥。

english: Please bring your medicines to your next appointment.
transliteration: haa-YI chi-fook-chaak ching daai-maai-DI yeok
translation: 下次覆診請帶埋啲藥。

english: We will arrange follow-up with your doctor.
transliteration: NGOH-dei wui on-PAI nay fook-chaak nay ge yi-SANG
translation: 我哋會安排你覆診你嘅醫生。

english: Do you have any questions or concerns?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW yahn-hoh man-TAI waak-JAY daam-SAM ge sih
translation: 你有冇任何問題或者擔心嘅事？

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: nay-HOU, NGoh hai nay yi-LIU teui-WU ge yat-yahn
translation: 你好，我係你醫療團隊嘅一員。

english: What brought you here today?
transliteration: nay gam-YAHT dim-GAAI lei ni-DOU
translation: 你今日點解嚟呢度？

english: I would like to ask some questions about your breathing.
transliteration: NGOH soeng man nay geung-yu hohng-GAP ge gei-tiu man-TAI
translation: 我想問你幾條關於呼吸嘅問題。

english: What is worrying you the most?
transliteration: nay jeui daam-SAM ge hai mat-YE
translation: 你最擔心嘅係乜嘢？

english: May I examine your chest and lungs?
transliteration: NGOH hoh-NAANG chaak-ha nay ge hung-HOU tung fai ma
translation: 我可以檢查吓你嘅胸口同肺嗎？

english: Please tell me if you feel uncomfortable.
transliteration: yu-GWOH nay gok-dak bat-SOHK-FOH, ching waah bei-NGOH-ji
translation: 如果你覺得唔舒服，請話畀我知。

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: nay seui-M-YIU faahn-YIK-yuhn
translation: 你需唔需要傳譯員？

english: When did your breathing problems begin?
transliteration: nay gay-SHI hoi-chi yau hohng-GAP man-TAI
translation: 你幾時開始有呼吸問題？

english: Did the problem start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: go man-TAI hai dahk-YEEN hoi-chi, ding-hai maan-MAAN CHUT-yin
translation: 個問題係突然開始，定係慢慢出現？

english: How long have you had these symptoms?
transliteration: nay yau ni-DI jing-JAANG gei-LOUH
translation: 你有呢啲症狀幾耐？

english: Are your symptoms getting better or worse?
transliteration: nay di jing-JAANG hai hou-JOENG ding-hai ok-WA
translation: 你啲症狀係好轉定係惡化？

english: Do the symptoms come and go?
transliteration: di jing-JAANG wui-MOW sih-YAU sih-MOU
translation: 啲症狀會唔會時有時無？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW sih-GWOH ni-GOH man-TAI
translation: 你以前有冇試過呢個問題？

english: Did your symptoms begin after a cold or infection?
transliteration: nay ge jing-JAANG hai-MAI gam-MAAN waak-JAY gam-YEEM ji-hau hoi-chi
translation: 你嘅症狀係咪感冒或者感染之後開始？

english: What were you doing when the symptoms began?
transliteration: jing-JAANG hoi-chi goh-JAHN nay hai-DOU zouh-gan mat-YE
translation: 症狀開始嗰陣你喺度做緊乜？

english: Do you have a cough?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW haak
translation: 你有冇咳？

english: How long have you been coughing?
transliteration: nay haak joh gei-LOUH
translation: 你咳咗幾耐？

english: Is your cough dry or do you bring up mucus?
transliteration: nay haak hai-GOHN haak, ding-hai wui haak-DI taam chut-LEI
translation: 你咳係乾咳，定係會咳啲痰出嚟？

english: Is your cough worse in the morning?
transliteration: nay jiu-SAN haak-dak yahn-M-yahn-CHOENG
translation: 你朝早咳得嚴唔嚴重？

english: Is your cough worse at night?
transliteration: nay yeh-MAAN haak-dak yahn-M-yahn-CHOENG
translation: 你夜晚咳得嚴唔嚴重？

english: Does coughing wake you from sleep?
transliteration: nay wui-MOW haak-sing
translation: 你會唔會咳醒？

english: Does exercise make you cough?
transliteration: zouh yun-DUNG wui-MOW ling nay haak
translation: 做運動會唔會令你咳？

english: Does cold air make you cough?
transliteration: ngdong hung-HEI wui-MOW ling nay haak
translation: 凍空氣會唔會令你咳？

english: Does lying down make your cough worse?
transliteration: fan-DAI wui-MOW ling nay haak-dak gang yahn-M
translation: 瞓低會唔會令你咳得更嚴重？

english: Do you cough so hard that you vomit?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sih-GWOH haak-dou OU
translation: 你有冇試過咳到嘔？

english: Is the cough improving or worsening?
transliteration: nay ge haak hai hou-JOENG-gan ding-hai yahn-JOENG joh
translation: 你嘅咳係好轉緊定係嚴重咗？

english: Do you cough up phlegm or mucus?
transliteration: nay wui-MOW haak-DI taam chut-LEI
translation: 你會唔會咳啲痰出嚟？

english: What colour is the phlegm?
transliteration: di taam hai-MAT yahn-SIK
translation: 啲痰係咩顏色？

english: Is the phlegm clear, white, yellow, or green?
transliteration: di taam hai tau-MING, baak-SIK, wong-SIK, ding-hai lohk-SIK
translation: 啲痰係透明、白色、黃色，定係綠色？

english: How much phlegm do you bring up?
transliteration: nay haak gay-DOH taam chut-LEI
translation: 你咳幾多痰出嚟？

english: Is the phlegm thick or thin?
transliteration: di taam hai-CHAU ding-hai sai
translation: 啲痰係稠定係稀？

english: Have you noticed blood in your phlegm?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW lau-YI dou di taam yip-BIN yau hyoot
translation: 你有冇留意到啲痰入面有血？

english: Are you coughing up bright red blood?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW haak-DI sin-HUNG-sik ge hyoot chut-LEI
translation: 你有冇咳啲鮮紅色嘅血出嚟？

english: How much blood have you coughed up?
transliteration: nay haak joh gay-DOH hyoot chut-LEI
translation: 你咳咗幾多血出嚟？

english: Are you having trouble breathing right now?
transliteration: nay yi-GAA hohng-GAP yau-MOW kwan-NAAN
translation: 你而家呼吸有冇困難？

english: Do you feel short of breath at rest?
transliteration: nay sau-SIK ge sih-HAU dou wui-MOW gok-dak hei-CHUT
translation: 你休息嘅時候都會唔會覺得氣促？

english: Does walking make you short of breath?
transliteration: haang-LOU wui-MOW ling nay hei-CHUT
translation: 行路會唔會令你氣促？

english: Can you climb a flight of stairs without stopping?
transliteration: nay hoh-NAANG yat-hau-hei haang-SHONG yat-CHANG laau-TAI, joon-DOENG bat-seui-TING-DAI ma
translation: 你可以一口氣行上一層樓梯，中途唔使停低嗎？

english: How far can you walk before you need to stop?
transliteration: nay haang gei-YUHN zau yiu-TING-DAI
translation: 你行幾遠就要停低？

english: Is it harder to breathe when you lie flat?
transliteration: nay fan-PENG ge sih-HAU wui-MOW gok-dak gang-NAAN hohng-GAP
translation: 你瞓平嘅時候會唔會覺得更難呼吸？

english: Do you wake up at night struggling to breathe?
transliteration: nay wui-MOW yeh-MAAN fan-gaak ge sih-HAU yin-WAI hohng-GAP kwan-NAAN ying-CHO
translation: 你會唔會夜晚瞓覺時因為呼吸困難而醒？

english: Do you feel you cannot take a full breath?
transliteration: nay wui-MOW gok-dak sap-bat-DOH yat-daam-jing-JAENG ge hei
translation: 你會唔會覺得吸唔到一啖完整嘅氣？

english: Do you hear a whistling sound when breathing?
transliteration: nay hohng-GAP ge sih-HAU yau-MOW teng-dou hyu-hyu sing
translation: 你呼吸嘅時候有冇聽到「咻咻」聲？

english: Does your chest feel tight?
transliteration: nay gok-bat-gok-dak hung-HOU ai-jyu
translation: 你覺唔覺得胸口翳住？

english: Is your breathing worse than usual today?
transliteration: nay gam-YAHT ge hohng-GAP hai-MAI bei ping-SIH cha
translation: 你今日呼吸係咪比平時差？

english: Do you have chest pain?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW hung-HOU-TUNG
translation: 你有冇胸口痛？

english: Does it hurt when you take a deep breath?
transliteration: nay sam-SAP hei ge sih-HAU wui-MOW TUNG
translation: 你深呼吸嘅時候會唔會痛？

english: Does coughing make the chest pain worse?
transliteration: haak-sau wui-MOW ling hung-HOU-TUNG dak gang yahn-M
translation: 咳嗽會唔會令胸口痛得更嚴重？

english: Where exactly does it hurt?
transliteration: nay bin-GOH wai-jih TUNG, hoh-YEE gong-dak ching-CHO-DI ma
translation: 你邊個位置痛？可以講得清楚啲嗎？

english: Do you have a fever or chills?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW faat-SIU waak-JAY faat-LAANG
translation: 你有冇發燒或者發冷？

english: Have you been sweating at night?
transliteration: nay yeh-MAAN yau-MOW chut-HAN
translation: 你夜晚有冇出汗？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW m-LOUNG-yi sau-fai daan-hai tai-JAENG ging joh
translation: 你有冇冇刻意減肥但體重輕咗？

english: Are you more tired than usual?
transliteration: nay hai-MAI bei ping-SIH gang-GWAI
translation: 你係咪比平時更加攰？

english: Do you have a runny or blocked nose?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW lau-bi-SUI waak-JAY bi-SAANG
translation: 你有冇流鼻水或者鼻塞？

english: Has your voice changed or become hoarse?
transliteration: nay ba-SENG yau-MOW bin, waak-JAY bin-SAA joh
translation: 你把聲有冇變，或者變沙咗？

english: Are you struggling to speak because of breathlessness?
transliteration: nay wui-MOW yin-WAI hei-CHUT yi-gong-bat-dou-YE
translation: 你會唔會因為氣促而講唔到嘢？

english: Did your breathing difficulty start very suddenly?
transliteration: nay ge hohng-GAP kwan-NAAN hai-MAI dahk-YEEN hoi-chi ge
translation: 你嘅呼吸困難係咪突然開始嘅？

english: Have you fainted or felt about to faint?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW yuhn-DAI, waak-JAY gok-dak zau-LEI yuhn
translation: 你有冇暈低，或者覺得就嚟暈？

english: Have your lips or fingers turned blue?
transliteration: nay ge jeui-CHOHN waak-JAY sau-JI yau-MOW bin-LAAM
translation: 你嘅嘴唇或者手指有冇變藍？

english: Do you have severe chest pain right now?
transliteration: nay yi-GAA yau-MOW hou-yahn-M ge hung-HOU-TUNG
translation: 你而家有冇好嚴重嘅胸口痛？

english: Have you had swelling or pain in one leg?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sih-GWOH yat-jek-GOEK jung waak-JAY TUNG
translation: 你有冇試過一隻腳腫或者痛？

english: Have you recently had surgery or been on a long journey?
transliteration: nay jeui-GAN yau-MOW zouh-gwoh sau-seot, waak-JAY heui-GWOH chang-TOH-lui-HANG
translation: 你最近有冇做過手術，或者去過長途旅行？

english: Have you had swelling of your face or tongue?
transliteration: nay faai-MIN waak-JAY tiu-LEI yau-MOW jung
translation: 你塊面或者條脷有冇腫？

english: Did you inhale smoke, fumes, or chemicals?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW kap-yap gwoh yin waak-JAY yin-MOU waak-JAY faa-hok-maat-jat
translation: 你有冇吸入過煙、煙霧或者化學物質？

english: Have you ever been diagnosed with asthma?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW kok-jaan gwoh oi-SIU
translation: 你以前有冇確診過哮喘？

english: Do you have episodes of wheezing?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sih-GWOH chyun-MING
translation: 你有冇試過喘鳴？

english: Do dust, pollen, or pets trigger your symptoms?
transliteration: chan, faa-FAN waak-JAY jung-MAAT wui-MOW ling nay di jing-JAANG faat-ZOK
translation: 塵、花粉或者寵物會唔會令你啲症狀發作？

english: Does exercise trigger your breathing problems?
transliteration: zouh yun-DUNG wui-MOW ling nay hohng-GAP yau man-TAI
translation: 做運動會唔會令你呼吸有問題？

english: Have you ever needed emergency treatment for asthma?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW yin-WAI oi-SIU ji-HEUI gap-JING-SAT ji-LIU
translation: 你以前有冇因為哮喘而要去急症室治療？

english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for asthma?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW yin-WAI oi-SIU yi-GOEU YUN
translation: 你以前有冇因為哮喘而入過醫院？

english: Do you have eczema or seasonal allergies?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sap-JAAN waak-JAY gai-JIET-sing min-GAAN
translation: 你有冇濕疹或者季節性敏感？

english: Have you had a serious allergic reaction?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sih-GWOH yahn-M ge gwoh-MIN faan-ying
translation: 你有冇試過嚴重嘅過敏反應？

english: Have you been diagnosed with COPD or emphysema?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW kok-jaan maan-SING joek-SAAI fei-bing (COPD) waak-JAY fai hei-JOHNG
translation: 你有冇確診慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）或者肺氣腫？

english: Do you have chronic bronchitis?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW maan-SING ji-GUN-yim
translation: 你有冇慢性支氣管炎？

english: Do you have a cough most days?
transliteration: nay hai-MAI daai-boh-FUN yaht-jih dou wui haak
translation: 你係咪大部分日子都會咳？

english: Do you often have flare-ups of your lung condition?
transliteration: nay ge fai-bing wui-MOW sahng-sahng faat-ZOK
translation: 你嘅肺病會唔會成日發作？

english: Have you needed steroids or antibiotics for breathing flare-ups?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW yin-WAI hohng-GAP man-TAI faat-ZOK ji yiu yung-LOUH-CHOHN waak-JAY hong-SANG-so
translation: 你有冇因為呼吸問題發作而要用類固醇或者抗生素？

english: Do you use oxygen at home?
transliteration: nay hai uk-KAY yau-MOW yung ONG-hei
translation: 你喺屋企有冇用氧氣？

english: Have you ever had a collapsed lung?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW sih-GWOH fai-taa-HAAN
translation: 你以前有冇試過肺塌陷？

english: Have you ever had a blood clot in your lungs?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW sih-GWOH fai-boh hyoot-SING
translation: 你以前有冇試過肺部血栓？

english: Have you recently had a chest infection?
transliteration: nay jeui-GAN yau-MOW sih-GWOH fai-boh gam-YEEM
translation: 你最近有冇試過肺部感染？

english: Have you ever had pneumonia?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW sih-GWOH fai-YIM
translation: 你以前有冇試過肺炎？

english: Have you ever had tuberculosis, also called TB?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW waan-GWOH fai-kit-hoh, yik-GIU TB
translation: 你以前有冇患過肺結核，亦叫TB？

english: Have you been in close contact with someone with TB?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW tung fai-kit-hoh waan-jaak ge yahn gan-GAU ji-CHOEK
translation: 你有冇同肺結核患者近距離接觸過？

english: Have you been coughing for more than three weeks?
transliteration: nay haak joh yau-MOW chaau-GWOH saam-GOH laih-baai
translation: 你咳咗有冇超過三個星期？

english: Have you had fever, night sweats, or weight loss?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW faat-SIU, yeh-MAAN chut-HAN waak-JAY tai-JAENG ging
translation: 你有冇發燒、夜汗或者體重減輕？

english: Have you taken medication to treat TB?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW sik-gwoh yeok yi fai-kit-hoh
translation: 你有冇食過藥醫肺結核？

english: Have you completed your TB treatment?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW waan-sing fai-kit-hoh liu-CHING
translation: 你有冇完成肺結核療程？

english: Has anyone at home been coughing recently?
transliteration: uk-KAY yau-MOW-yahn jeui-GAN haak-sau
translation: 屋企有冇人最近咳嗽？

english: Do you currently smoke cigarettes?
transliteration: nay yi-GAA yau-MOW sik-YEEN
translation: 你而家有冇食煙？

english: Have you smoked in the past?
transliteration: nay yiht-CHOHNG yau-MOW sik-gwoh-YEEN
translation: 你以前有冇食過煙？

english: How many cigarettes do you smoke per day?
transliteration: nay mui-YAHT sik gay-DOH ji-YEEN
translation: 你每日食幾多支煙？

english: For how many years have you smoked?
transliteration: nay sik joh gei-DOH-NEEN-YEEN
translation: 你食咗幾多年煙？

english: When did you quit smoking?
transliteration: nay gei-SHI gaai-YEEN
translation: 你幾時戒煙？

english: Do you vape or use electronic cigarettes?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW kap din-JI-YEEN
translation: 你有冇吸電子煙？

english: Are you exposed to cigarette smoke at home?
transliteration: nay hai uk-KAY yau-MOW kap-dou yi-SAU-YEEN
translation: 你喺屋企有冇吸到二手煙？

english: Are you exposed to dust, fumes, or chemicals at work?
transliteration: nay faan-GUNG ge sih-HAU yau-MOW jip-CHOEK dou chan, yin-MOU waak-JAY faa-hok-maat-jat
translation: 你返工嘅時候有冇接觸到塵、煙霧或者化學物質？

english: Have you been exposed to asbestos?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW jip-CHOEK gwoh sek-MIN
translation: 你有冇接觸過石棉？

english: Do you use a wood stove or indoor fire for cooking or heating?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW yung chaai-lou waak-JAY sih-NAAP fo-lou jyu-CHOHNG waak-JAY keui-NYUN
translation: 你有冇用柴爐或者室內火爐煮食或者取暖？

english: Do you snore loudly?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW daai-SENG bi-hon
translation: 你有冇大聲鼻鼾？

english: Has anyone noticed that you stop breathing during sleep?
transliteration: yau-MOW-yahn lau-YI dou nay fan-gaak ge sih-HAU wui-TING-CHO hohng-GAP
translation: 有冇人留意到你瞓覺時會停止呼吸？

english: Do you wake up gasping or choking?
transliteration: nay wui-MOW fan-YING ge sih-HAU chyun-HEI waak-JAY hou-chi hing-jyun gam
translation: 你會唔會瞓醒時喘氣或者好似哽親咁？

english: Do you feel sleepy during the day?
transliteration: nay yaht-DOU wui-MOW gok-dak ngaan-CHOHN
translation: 你日頭會唔會覺得眼瞓？

english: Have you been diagnosed with sleep apnea?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW kok-jaan gwoh seui-MIN-jeot-HEI-SING
translation: 你有冇確診過睡眠窒息症？

english: Do you use a CPAP machine at night?
transliteration: nay yeh-MAAN yau-MOW yung CPAP hohng-GAP-kei
translation: 你夜晚有冇用CPAP呼吸機？

english: Do you have trouble using your CPAP mask?
transliteration: nay yung CPAP min-JAAU yau-MOW kwan-NAAN
translation: 你用CPAP面罩有冇困難？

english: What medicines do you take for your breathing?
transliteration: nay sik-MAT yeok lai ji-LIU hohng-GAP man-TAI
translation: 你食咩藥嚟治療呼吸問題？

english: Do you use an inhaler?
transliteration: nay yau-MOW yung kap-yap-kei
translation: 你有冇用吸入器？

english: Which inhalers do you use?
transliteration: nay yung bin-gei-jung kap-yap-kei
translation: 你用邊幾種吸入器？

english: How many times a day do you use your inhaler?
transliteration: nay mui-YAHT yung gay-DOH-chi kap-yap-kei
translation: 你每日用幾多次吸入器？

english: When did you last use your inhaler?
transliteration: nay shong-YAT-chi yung kap-yap-kei hai-gei-SHI
translation: 你上一次用吸入器係幾時？

english: Does your inhaler help your breathing?
transliteration: nay yung-gwoh kap-yap-kei ji-hau hohng-GAP yau-MOW hou-DI
translation: 你用吸入器之後呼吸有冇好啲？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: nay jeui-GAN yau-MOW lou-sik yeok
translation: 你最近有冇漏食藥？

english: Do you use a spacer with your inhaler?
transliteration: nay yung kap-yap-kei ge sih-HAU yau-MOW pei-hoh chyu-MOU-gong
translation: 你用吸入器嘅時候有冇配合儲霧罐？

english: Can you show me how you use your inhaler?
transliteration: nay hoh-YEE m-si-m-si ge sih-HOU, dim-YEUNG yung kap-yap-kei
translation: 你可唔可以示範一次點樣用吸入器？

english: Do you rinse your mouth after using your steroid inhaler?
transliteration: nay yung-yuhn-LOUH-CHOHN kap-yap-kei ji-hau yau-MOW syu-MOU
translation: 你用完類固醇吸入器之後有冇漱口？

english: Have you recently taken antibiotics or steroid tablets?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mo sik gwo kong sang so je wa lai guet syun yeuk pin
translation: 你最近有冇食過抗生素或者類固醇藥片？

english: Are you allergic to any medicines?
transliteration: nay deui yam ho yeuk mat yau mo man gan
translation: 你對任何藥物有冇敏感？

english: Do you have any other medical conditions?
transliteration: nay yau mo kei ta beng
translation: 你有冇其他病？

english: Have you ever had heart disease or heart failure?
transliteration: nay yi chin yau mo sam jong beng je wa sam jong seoi jip
translation: 你以前有冇心臟病或者心臟衰竭？

english: Have you ever had surgery on your chest or lungs?
transliteration: nay yi chin yau mo zou gwo hung je wa fai bou sau seot
translation: 你以前有冇做過胸或者肺部手術？

english: Have you ever been admitted to intensive care for breathing problems?
transliteration: nay yi chin yau mo yan wai fu kap man tai yap gwo sam chit ji li bou
translation: 你以前有冇因為呼吸問題入過深切治療部？

english: Has anyone in your family had asthma or lung disease?
transliteration: nay uk kay yau mo yan yau siu chyun je wa fai beng
translation: 你屋企有冇人有哮喘或者肺病？

english: Has anyone in your family had lung cancer?
transliteration: nay uk kay yau mo yan waan gwo fai ngaam
translation: 你屋企有冇人患過肺癌？

english: Have you recently travelled outside the country?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mo hui gwo ngoi dei leui haan
translation: 你最近有冇去過外地旅行？

english: I am going to listen to your lungs with a stethoscope.
transliteration: ngo yi ga wui yung teng tung teng ha nay ge fai
translation: 我而家會用聽筒聽下你嘅肺。

english: Please sit upright.
transliteration: ching cho jak
translation: 請坐直。

english: Please loosen your shirt so I can examine your chest.
transliteration: ching sung hoi gin seui deng ngo gim cha nay go hung hau
translation: 請鬆開件衫，等我檢查你個胸口。

english: Please breathe in deeply through your mouth.
transliteration: ching yung go hau sam sam kap yat dam hei
translation: 請用個口深深吸一啖氣。

english: Please breathe out slowly.
transliteration: ching maan maan fu hei
translation: 請慢慢呼氣。

english: Please hold your breath for a moment.
transliteration: ching jam si yan jue mai hou fu kap
translation: 請暫時忍住唔好呼吸。

english: Please cough for me.
transliteration: ching kau yat seng bei ngo teng
translation: 請咳一聲畀我聽。

english: I am going to check your oxygen level with this finger clip.
transliteration: ngo yi ga wui yung ni go sau zi gap gim cha nay hyut yeh yap min ge yeung hei seoi ping
translation: 我而家會用呢個手指夾檢查你血液入面嘅氧氣水平。

english: I am going to count how many breaths you take in a minute.
transliteration: ngo yi ga wui sou yat sou nay yat fan jung fu kap gei do chi
translation: 我而家會數一數你一分鐘呼吸幾多次。

english: I am going to gently tap on your back.
transliteration: ngo yi ga wui hing hing paak ha nay go bui zek
translation: 我而家會輕輕拍下你個背脊。

english: Does it hurt when I press here?
transliteration: ngo on ni dou ge si hau wui mo tung
translation: 我按呢度嘅時候會唔會痛？

english: We would like to do a chest X-ray.
transliteration: ngo dei seung bong nay ziu hung fai X gwong
translation: 我哋想幫你照胸肺X光。

english: Have you had a chest X-ray before?
transliteration: nay yi chin ziu gwo hung fai X gwong mei
translation: 你以前照過胸肺X光未？

english: We may need a CT scan of your chest.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang yiu bong nay zou hung bou din nou sou chyun
translation: 我哋可能要幫你做胸部電腦掃描。

english: We would like to check your blood oxygen level.
transliteration: ngo dei seung gim cha nay hyut yeh yap min ge yeung hei seoi ping
translation: 我哋想檢查你血液入面嘅氧氣水平。

english: We need to take a blood sample.
transliteration: ngo dei seui yiu chou hyut
translation: 我哋需要抽血。

english: We would like to test a sample of your sputum.
transliteration: ngo dei seung faa yim nay ge taam
translation: 我哋想化驗你嘅痰。

english: We would like to measure how well your lungs work.
transliteration: ngo dei seung gim cha nay ge fai gong nang
translation: 我哋想檢查你嘅肺功能。

english: Please blow out as hard and fast as you can into this tube.
transliteration: ching ban lik yau faai yau daai lik gam heung ni tiu gun chui hei
translation: 請盡力又快又大力咁向呢條管吹氣。

english: We may need to do a sleep study.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang yiu bong nay zou seui min chek si
translation: 我哋可能要幫你做睡眠測試。

english: We may need to look inside your airways with a small camera.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang yiu yung sai ging tau tai ha nay ge hei gun yap min
translation: 我哋可能要用細鏡頭睇下你嘅氣管入面。

english: We will give you oxygen to help you breathe.
transliteration: ngo dei wui bei yeung hei nay bong nay fu kap
translation: 我哋會畀氧氣你，幫你呼吸。

english: This inhaler helps open your airways.
transliteration: ni chi kap yap hei kei ho yi bong nay daa hoi hei dou
translation: 呢支吸入器可以幫你打開氣道。

english: I will show you how to use your inhaler.
transliteration: ngo wui gaau nay dim yeung yung kap yap hei kei
translation: 我會教你點樣用吸入器。

english: Please follow the dose written on your prescription.
transliteration: ching gan faang chyueng seung se wa ge zai leung fuk yeuk
translation: 請跟返處方上寫嘅劑量服藥。

english: Do not change the dose without speaking to your healthcare team.
transliteration: mei tung nay ge yi liu tyun deui taan gwo ji chin m hou goi zai leung
translation: 未同你嘅醫療團隊傾過之前，唔好改劑量。

english: Please rinse your mouth after using this steroid inhaler.
transliteration: yung yun ni chi lai guet syun kap yap hei kei ji hau ching sook hau
translation: 用完呢支類固醇吸入器之後，請漱口。

english: We can help you make a plan to stop smoking.
transliteration: ngo dei ho yi bong nay zai ding gaai yin gai waak
translation: 我哋可以幫你制定戒煙計劃。

english: Please wear a mask as instructed.
transliteration: ching on ji chi si daai hau jaau
translation: 請按照指示戴口罩。

english: Seek urgent medical care if your breathing becomes severely difficult.
transliteration: yu gwo nay fu kap bin dak fei seung kwan naan ching lap jik kau yi
translation: 如果你呼吸變得非常困難，請立即求醫。

english: Seek urgent medical care if you cough up a large amount of blood.
transliteration: yu gwo nay kau chut daai leung hyut ching lap jik kau yi
translation: 如果你咳出大量血，請立即求醫。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: nay yau mo man tai seung man
translation: 你有冇問題想問？

english: Can you tell me how you will use your inhaler at home?
transliteration: nay ho m ho yi wa ngo zi nay faan dou uk kay wui dim yeung yung kap yap hei kei
translation: 你可唔可以話我知，你返到屋企會點樣用吸入器？

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: ngo dei wui bong nay on paai fu jan
translation: 我哋會幫你安排覆診。

english: We may refer you to a lung specialist.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang wui jyun gaai nay hui tai fai fo juen ga yi sang
translation: 我哋可能會轉介你去睇肺科專科醫生。

english: Please return if your symptoms get worse.
transliteration: yu gwo jing jong bin cha ching faan lei tai yi sang
translation: 如果症狀變差，請返嚟睇醫生。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: do je nay gam yat tung ngo taan gai
translation: 多謝你今日同我傾偈。

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: nay hou ngo hai nay yi liu tyun deui ge yat yun
translation: 你好，我係你醫療團隊嘅一員。

english: What brought you here today?
transliteration: nay gam yat dim gaai lei ni dou
translation: 你今日點解嚟呢度？

english: I would like to ask some questions about your stomach and digestion.
transliteration: ngo seung man nay gei tiu gwun yu cheung wai tung siu faa ge man tai
translation: 我想問你幾條關於腸胃同消化嘅問題。

english: What is worrying you the most?
transliteration: nay jeui dam sam ge hai me
translation: 你最擔心嘅係咩？

english: May I examine your abdomen?
transliteration: ngo ho yi gim cha nay go tou ma
translation: 我可以檢查你個肚嗎？

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: yu gwo yau yam ho dei fong tung ching wa ngo zi
translation: 如果有任何地方痛，請話我知。

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: nay seui m seui yiu chyun jik yun
translation: 你需唔需要傳譯員？

english: When did your symptoms begin?
transliteration: nay gei si hoi chi yau ni di jing jong
translation: 你幾時開始有呢啲症狀？

english: Did the problem start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: go man tai hai dat yin chut yin ding hai maan maan hoi chi
translation: 個問題係突然出現，定係慢慢開始？

english: How long have you had this problem?
transliteration: nay yau ni go man tai gei noi
translation: 你有呢個問題幾耐？

english: Is it getting better or worse?
transliteration: ching fong yau mo hou jyun waak bin cha
translation: 情況有冇好轉或者變差？

english: Does it come and go?
transliteration: jing jong wui m wui si yau si mou
translation: 症狀會唔會時有時無？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: nay yi chin yau mo si gwo ni go man tai
translation: 你以前有冇試過呢個問題？

english: Does it wake you up at night?
transliteration: ni go man tai wui m wui ling nay ye maan fan
translation: 呢個問題會唔會令你夜晚瞓醒？

english: Do you have pain in your abdomen?
transliteration: nay go tou yau mo tung
translation: 你個肚有冇痛？

english: Where exactly does it hurt?
transliteration: jeun kok lai gong bin dou tung
translation: 準確嚟講，邊度痛？

english: Please point to where it hurts most.
transliteration: ching zi yat zi jeui tung ge dei fong
translation: 請指一指最痛嘅地方。

english: Is the pain in the upper or lower abdomen?
transliteration: tung ge dei fong hai seung fuk ding haa fuk
translation: 痛嘅地方係上腹定下腹？

english: Is the pain on the right or left side?
transliteration: tung ge dei fong hai jo bin ding yau bin
translation: 痛嘅地方係左邊定右邊？

english: Is the pain around your belly button?
transliteration: tung ge dei fong hai mai hai tou chi fu gan
translation: 痛嘅地方係咪肚臍附近？

english: Does the pain spread to your back or shoulder?
transliteration: tung wui m wui jing yin dou bui bou waak jeung tau
translation: 痛會唔會伸延到背部或者膊頭？

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, burning, or cramping?
transliteration: nay gok dak go tung hai chi tung yam yam zo tung juk yit tung ding hai chau gan gam tung
translation: 你覺得個痛係刺痛、隱隱作痛、灼熱痛，定係抽筋咁痛？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: yu gwo ling fan hai wan chyun m tung sap fan hai jeui tung nay wui bei gei do fan
translation: 如果零分係完全唔痛，十分係最痛，你會畀幾多分？

english: Is the pain constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: tung hai yat jik dou hai dou ding hai si yau si mou
translation: 痛係一直都喺度，定係時有時無？

english: Did the pain move from one area to another?
transliteration: tung yau mo yiu yat go dei fong yi dou ling yat go dei fong
translation: 痛有冇由一個地方移到另一個地方？

english: Does eating make the pain better or worse?
transliteration: sik ye wui ling tung hou di ding cha di
translation: 食嘢會令痛好啲定差啲？

english: Is the pain worse after a fatty meal?
transliteration: sik yun ni ge ye ji hau tung wui m wui gang yim jung
translation: 食完油膩嘅嘢之後，痛會唔會更嚴重？

english: Does drinking milk make your symptoms worse?
transliteration: yam naai wui m wui ling nay ge jing jong gaa chung
translation: 飲奶會唔會令你嘅症狀加重？

english: Do spicy foods make your symptoms worse?
transliteration: sik laat ye wui m wui ling nay ge jing jong gaa chung
translation: 食辣嘢會唔會令你嘅症狀加重？

english: Does the pain improve after passing stool?
transliteration: daai bin ji hau tung wui m wui hou di
translation: 大便之後，痛會唔會好啲？

english: Does passing gas relieve the pain?
transliteration: fong pet ji hau tung wui m wui gaam hing
translation: 放屁之後，痛會唔會減輕？

english: Does movement or coughing make the pain worse?
transliteration: yuk dung waak kau sok wui m wui ling tung gaa chung
translation: 郁動或者咳嗽會唔會令痛加重？

english: Does lying down make the pain worse?
transliteration: fan dai wui m wui ling tung gaa chung
translation: 瞓低會唔會令痛加重？

english: What makes the pain feel better?
transliteration: dim yeung wui ling tung syu fuk di
translation: 點樣會令痛舒服啲？

english: Do you feel nauseated or sick to your stomach?
transliteration: nay gok m gok dak zok ngaak waak wai m syu fuk
translation: 你覺唔覺得作嘔或者胃唔舒服？

english: Have you vomited?
transliteration: nay yau mo tou gwo
translation: 你有冇嘔過？

english: How many times have you vomited today?
transliteration: nay gam yat tou jo gei do chi
translation: 你今日嘔咗幾多次？

english: Can you keep food and fluids down?
transliteration: nay sik ye tung yam seui lok m lok dou tou
translation: 你食嘢同飲水落唔落到肚？

english: Is there blood in your vomit?
transliteration: nay tou chut lei ge ye yau mo hyut
translation: 你嘔出嚟嘅嘢有冇血？

english: Does your vomit look like coffee grounds?
transliteration: nay tou chut lei ge ye chi m chi gaa fe za
translation: 你嘔出嚟嘅嘢似唔似咖啡渣？

english: Is your vomit green or yellow?
transliteration: nay tou chut lei ge ye hai luk sik ding wong sik
translation: 你嘔出嚟嘅嘢係綠色定黃色？

english: Do you vomit after eating?
transliteration: nay sik yun ye ji hau wui m wui tou
translation: 你食完嘢之後會唔會嘔？

english: When did you last vomit?
transliteration: nay seung yat chi tou hai gei si
translation: 你上一次嘔係幾時？

english: How often do you have a bowel movement?
transliteration: nay tung seung gei noi daai bin yat chi
translation: 你通常幾耐大便一次？

english: Have your bowel habits changed recently?
transliteration: nay jeui gan ge daai bin gwaan jaap yau mo goi bin
translation: 你最近嘅大便習慣有冇改變？

english: When was your last bowel movement?
transliteration: nay seung yat chi daai bin hai gei si
translation: 你上一次大便係幾時？

english: Is your stool hard or soft?
transliteration: nay di daai bin hai ngaang ding yun
translation: 你啲大便係硬定軟？

english: Is your stool watery or loose?
transliteration: nay di daai bin hai seoi jong ding sai laan
translation: 你啲大便係水狀定稀爛？

english: Is your stool black or tar-like?
transliteration: nay di daai bin hai hak sik chi baak yau gam ma
translation: 你啲大便係黑色，似柏油咁嗎？

english: Have you noticed red blood in your stool?
transliteration: nay yau mo lau yi dou daai bin yau sin hung sik ge hyut
translation: 你有冇留意到大便有鮮紅色嘅血？

english: Is there mucus in your stool?
transliteration: nay di daai bin yau mo nim yeh
translation: 你啲大便有冇黏液？

english: Is your stool pale or clay-coloured?
transliteration: nay di daai bin hai m hai ngaan sik hou hin chi ni tou sik
translation: 你啲大便係咪顏色好淺，似泥土色？

english: Is your stool greasy or difficult to flush?
transliteration: nay di daai bin hai m hai yau ngaai waak je hou naan chau hei
translation: 你啲大便係咪油膩，或者好難沖走？

english: Do you feel you have completely emptied your bowels?
transliteration: nay gok m gok dak di daai bin yi ging wan chyun paai ching
translation: 你覺唔覺得啲大便已經完全排清？

english: Do you have difficulty controlling your bowel movements?
transliteration: nay yau mo si gwo yan m jue yiu daai bin
translation: 你有冇試過忍唔住要大便？

english: Do you have diarrhea?
transliteration: nay yau mo tou se
translation: 你有冇肚瀉？

english: How many loose stools have you had today?
transliteration: nay gam yat heui jo gei do chi sai laan ge daai bin
translation: 你今日去咗幾多次稀爛嘅大便？

english: How long have you had diarrhea?
transliteration: nay tou se jo gei noi
translation: 你肚瀉咗幾耐？

english: Do you have cramps before passing stool?
transliteration: nay daai bin chin wui m wui tou chau gan
translation: 你大便前會唔會肚抽筋？

english: Do you feel an urgent need to use the toilet?
transliteration: nay hai m hai hou gap yiu heui chi so
translation: 你係咪好急要去廁所？

english: Are you constipated?
transliteration: nay yau mo bin bei
translation: 你有冇便秘？

english: Do you strain when passing stool?
transliteration: nay daai bin go jan yiu m yiu hou yung lik
translation: 你大便嗰陣要唔要好用力？

english: Have you passed gas today?
transliteration: nay gam yat yau mo fong pet
translation: 你今日有冇放屁？

english: Are you taking laxatives or stool softeners?
transliteration: nay yau mo sik tung bin yeuk waak yun bin yeuk
translation: 你有冇食通便藥或者軟便藥？

english: Has anyone around you also had diarrhea?
transliteration: nay san bin yau mo yan dou tou se
translation: 你身邊有冇人都肚瀉？

english: Do you have heartburn or burning in your chest?
transliteration: nay yau mo wai juk yit waak hung hau yau juk yit gam
translation: 你有冇胃灼熱，或者胸口有灼熱感？

english: Do you have acid coming up into your throat?
transliteration: yau mo wai syun yung seung hau lang
translation: 有冇胃酸湧上喉嚨？

english: Do you have a sour taste in your mouth?
transliteration: nay hau yap min yau mo syun mei
translation: 你口入面有冇酸味？

english: Do you burp frequently?
transliteration: nay sing yat daa heik ma
translation: 你成日打嗝嗎？

english: Do you have trouble swallowing food?
transliteration: nay tun ye yau mo kwan naan
translation: 你吞嘢有冇困難？

english: Is swallowing painful?
transliteration: tun ye wui m wui tung
translation: 吞嘢會唔會痛？

english: Is it harder to swallow solids or liquids?
transliteration: tun gwat tai sik mat ding jik tai biu gaau naan
translation: 吞固體食物定液體比較困難？

english: Does food ever feel stuck in your chest?
transliteration: yau mo si gwo gok dak sik mat kaak hai hung hau
translation: 有冇試過覺得食物卡喺胸口？

english: Do you cough or choke when swallowing?
transliteration: nay tun ye go jan wui m wui kau waak hei dou
translation: 你吞嘢嗰陣會唔會咳或者嗆到？

english: Do you feel full after eating only a small amount?
transliteration: nay sik siu siu ye zau gok dak baau ma
translation: 你食少少嘢就覺得飽嗎？

english: Does your abdomen feel bloated or swollen?
transliteration: nay go tou yau mo gok dak jeung waak jung
translation: 你個肚有冇覺得脹或者腫？

english: Are you passing more gas than usual?
transliteration: nay fong pet yau mo bei ping si do
translation: 你放屁有冇比平時多？

english: Have you lost your appetite?
transliteration: nay yau mo mou sai wai hau
translation: 你有冇冇晒胃口？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: nay yau mo mou hok yi gaai fai daan tai jung hing zo
translation: 你有冇冇刻意減肥但體重輕咗？

english: Have you gained weight unexpectedly?
transliteration: nay yau mo mou yun mou gu go jo
translation: 你有冇無緣無故重咗？

english: Have you changed your diet recently?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mo goi bin yam sik gwaan jaap
translation: 你最近有冇改變飲食習慣？

english: Do you avoid any foods because of symptoms?
transliteration: nay yau mo yan wai yau jing jong yi bei hoi mou di sik mat
translation: 你有冇因為有症狀而避開某啲食物？

english: How much water do you drink each day?
transliteration: nay mui yat yam gei do seoi
translation: 你每日飲幾多水？

english: When did you last eat or drink?
transliteration: nay seung chi sik ye waak yam ye hai gei si
translation: 你上次食嘢或者飲嘢係幾時？

english: Have you ever had liver disease or hepatitis?
transliteration: nay yi chin yau mo gon beng waak gon yim
translation: 你以前有冇肝病或者肝炎？

english: Have your eyes or skin turned yellow?
transliteration: nay zek ngaan waak bai fu yau mo bin wong
translation: 你隻眼或者皮膚有冇變黃？

english: Is your urine darker than usual?
transliteration: nay ge niu yau mo bei ping si sam sik
translation: 你嘅尿有冇比平時深色？

english: Do you have itching all over your body?
transliteration: nay chyun san yau mo han yeung
translation: 你全身有冇痕癢？

english: Have you had gallstones?
transliteration: nay yau mo saang gwo daam sek
translation: 你有冇生過膽石？

english: Have you had your gallbladder removed?
transliteration: nay yau mo zou gwo chit cheui daam nang ge sau seot
translation: 你有冇做過切除膽囊嘅手術？

english: Have you ever had pancreatitis?
transliteration: nay yi chin yau mo waan gwo yee jong yim
translation: 你以前有冇患過胰臟炎？

english: Have you noticed swelling in your abdomen or legs?
transliteration: nay yau mo lau yi dou tou waak goeng jung
translation: 你有冇留意到肚或者腳腫？

english: Do you bruise or bleed easily?
transliteration: nay hai m hai hou yi fong yu waak lau hyut
translation: 你係咪好容易瘀或者流血？

english: Do you have pain around your anus?
transliteration: nay gong mun fu gan yau mo tung
translation: 你肛門附近有冇痛？

english: Do you have hemorrhoids or piles?
transliteration: nay yau mo ji chong
translation: 你有冇痔瘡？

english: Do you notice blood on the toilet paper?
transliteration: nay yau mo hai chi so ji seung gin dou hyut
translation: 你有冇喺廁紙上見到血？

english: Do you have itching around your anus?
transliteration: nay gong mun fu gan yau mo han
translation: 你肛門附近有冇痕？

english: Have you noticed a lump near your anus?
transliteration: nay yau mo lau yi dou gong mun fu gan yau yat laap ye
translation: 你有冇留意到肛門附近有粒嘢？

english: Is there any discharge from your anus?
transliteration: nay gong mun yau mo fan bai lau chut
translation: 你肛門有冇分泌物流出？

english: Do you have pain when passing stool?
transliteration: nay daai bin go jan wui m wui tung
translation: 你大便嗰陣會唔會痛？

english: Have you ever had an ulcer in your stomach?
transliteration: nay yi chin yau mo saang gwo wai kwai yeuk
translation: 你以前有冇生過胃潰瘍？

english: Have you been diagnosed with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis?
transliteration: yau mo yi sang chan dyun nay yau hak loeng ji beng waak kwai yeung sing git cheung yim
translation: 有冇醫生診斷你有克隆氏症或者潰瘍性結腸炎？

english: Have you ever had irritable bowel syndrome?
transliteration: nay yi chin yau mo waan gwo cheung yi gik jung hap jing
translation: 你以前有冇患過腸易激綜合症？

english: Have you had surgery on your abdomen?
transliteration: nay yau mo zou gwo fuk bou sau seot
translation: 你有冇做過腹部手術？

english: Have you had your appendix removed?
transliteration: nay yau mo zou gwo chit cheui mong cheung ge sau seot
translation: 你有冇做過切除盲腸嘅手術？

english: Has anyone in your family had bowel or stomach cancer?
transliteration: nay uk kay yan yau mo waan gwo cheung ngaam waak wai ngaam
translation: 你屋企人有冇患過腸癌或者胃癌？

english: Have you had a colonoscopy before?
transliteration: nay yi chin yau mo zou gwo daai cheung ging
translation: 你以前有冇做過大腸鏡？

english: Do you have any food allergies or intolerances?
transliteration: nay yau mo deui mau di sik mat man gan waak m noi sau
translation: 你有冇對某啲食物敏感或者唔耐受？

english: Have you travelled recently?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mo heui leui haan
translation: 你最近有冇去旅行？

english: Have you eaten any food that may have been spoiled?
transliteration: nay yau mo sik gwo ho nang bin waai zo ge sik mat
translation: 你有冇食過可能變壞咗嘅食物？

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: nay ping si ding si sik di me yeuk
translation: 你平時定時食啲咩藥？

english: Do you take ibuprofen, naproxen, or aspirin?
transliteration: nay yau mo sik ibuprofen naproxen waak aspirin
translation: 你有冇食 ibuprofen、naproxen 或者 aspirin？

english: Do you take blood thinners?
transliteration: nay yau mo sik bok hyut yeuk
translation: 你有冇食薄血藥？

english: Have you taken antibiotics recently?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mo sik gwo kong sang so
translation: 你最近有冇食過抗生素？

english: Have you started any new medicine or supplement?
transliteration: nay yau mo hoi chi sik san yeuk waak bou chung zai
translation: 你有冇開始食新藥或者補充劑？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: nay yau mo yam zau
translation: 你有冇飲酒？

english: How much alcohol do you usually drink in a week?
transliteration: nay ping si yat go sing kei yam gei do zau
translation: 你平時一個星期飲幾多酒？

english: Have you ever had problems because of alcohol?
transliteration: nay yi chin yau mo si gwo yan wai yam zau yi chut man tai
translation: 你以前有冇試過因為飲酒而出問題？

english: Is your abdominal pain severe right now?
transliteration: nay yi ga go tou tung dak yam m yam jung
translation: 你而家個肚痛得嚴唔嚴重？

english: Is your abdomen hard or very tender to touch?
transliteration: nay go tou mo lok heui hai m hai ngaang waak hou tung
translation: 你個肚摸落去係咪硬或者好痛？

english: Have you fainted or felt very dizzy?
transliteration: nay yau mo wan dai waak gok dak hou wan
translation: 你有冇暈低或者覺得好暈？

english: Are you vomiting blood?
transliteration: nay yau mo tou hyut
translation: 你有冇嘔血？

english: Are you passing black, tarry stool?
transliteration: nay yau mo he hak sik chi baak yau ge daai bin
translation: 你有冇痾黑色、似柏油嘅大便？

english: Are you passing a large amount of blood in your stool?
transliteration: nay daai bin yau mo daai leung chut hyut
translation: 你大便有冇大量出血？

english: Are you unable to pass stool or gas?
transliteration: nay hai m hai chyun chyun daai m chut bin waak fong m dou pet
translation: 你係咪完全痾唔出大便或者放唔到屁？

english: Have you stopped passing urine or are you urinating much less?
transliteration: nay hai m hai mou zoi siu bin waak siu bin siu zo hou do
translation: 你係咪冇再小便，或者小便少咗好多？

english: Do you have fever with severe abdominal pain?
transliteration: nay yau mo faat siu tung si yau tou tung dak hou yam jung
translation: 你有冇發燒，同時肚痛得好嚴重？

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
transliteration: nay yau mo ho nang waai yun
translation: 你有冇可能懷孕？

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: ching nay jeung ngo
translation: 請你仰臥。

english: Please bend your knees slightly.
transliteration: ching nay mai mai kuk hei sai tau
translation: 請你微微屈起膝頭。

english: Please lift your shirt so I can examine your abdomen.
transliteration: ching nay laai hei gin seui deng ngo gim cha nay go tou
translation: 請你拉起件衫，等我檢查你個肚。

english: I am going to listen to your abdomen.
transliteration: ngo yi ga wui teng ha nay go tou ge seng
translation: 我而家會聽下你個肚嘅聲。

english: I am going to press gently on your abdomen.
transliteration: ngo yi ga wui hing hing on nay go tou
translation: 我而家會輕輕按你個肚。

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: ngo on ni dou go jan yu gwo tung zau wa ngo zi
translation: 我按呢度嗰陣，如果痛就話我知。

english: Does it hurt more when I let go?
transliteration: ngo fong sau go jan wui m wui gang ga tung
translation: 我放手嗰陣會唔會更加痛？

english: Please take a deep breath.
transliteration: ching nay sam fu kap
translation: 請你深呼吸。

english: I may need to examine your rectum, and I will explain why first.
transliteration: ngo ho nang seui yiu gim cha nay ge jik cheung ji chin wui sin gaai sik yun yan
translation: 我可能需要檢查你嘅直腸，之前會先解釋原因。

english: We would like to do some blood tests.
transliteration: ngo dei seung bong nay yim hyut
translation: 我哋想幫你驗血。

english: We need a stool sample.
transliteration: ngo dei seui yiu yat fan daai bin yeung bun
translation: 我哋需要一份大便樣本。

english: Please collect a stool sample in this container.
transliteration: ching nay jeung daai bin yeung bun fong yap ni go jung hei
translation: 請你將大便樣本放入呢個容器。

english: We may need an ultrasound of your abdomen.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang seui yiu bong nay ziu fuk bou chiu seng bo
