translation: 我哋可能需要幫你照腹部超聲波。

english: We may need a CT scan of your abdomen.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang seui yiu bong nay ziu fuk bou din nou sou chyun
translation: 我哋可能需要幫你照腹部電腦掃描。

english: A gastroscopy uses a small camera to look inside your food pipe and stomach.
transliteration: wai ging wui yung yat chi sai sai ge ging tau tai nay ge sik dou tung wai yap min
translation: 胃鏡會用一支細細嘅鏡頭，睇你嘅食道同胃入面。

english: A colonoscopy uses a camera to look inside your large intestine.
transliteration: daai cheung ging wui yung ging tau tai nay ge daai cheung yap min
translation: 大腸鏡會用鏡頭睇你嘅大腸入面。

english: You may need to take bowel preparation before the colonoscopy.
transliteration: zou daai cheung ging ji chin nay ho nang seui yiu sik ching cheung yeuk
translation: 做大腸鏡之前，你可能需要食清腸藥。

english: You may need to avoid eating or drinking before the procedure.
transliteration: zou gim cha ji chin nay ho nang seui yiu bei min sik ye waak yam ye
translation: 做檢查之前，你可能需要避免食嘢或者飲嘢。

english: We will explain the risks and ask for your consent before the procedure.
transliteration: zou gim cha ji chin ngo dei wui gaai sik fong him bing jing kau nay tung yi
translation: 做檢查之前，我哋會解釋風險，並徵求你同意。

english: We will give you fluids to prevent dehydration.
transliteration: ngo dei wui bei nay bou chung seoi fan bei min to seoi
translation: 我哋會畀你補充水分，避免脫水。

english: Take small sips of water frequently.
transliteration: ching nay mat mat yam mui chi yam siu siu seoi
translation: 請你密密飲，每次飲少少水。

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: ching nay on faang chyueng sik ni ji yeuk
translation: 請你按照處方食呢隻藥。

english: This medicine may help reduce stomach acid.
transliteration: ni ji yeuk ho nang ho yi gaam siu wai syun
translation: 呢隻藥可能可以減少胃酸。

english: Avoid foods that make your symptoms worse.
transliteration: bei min sik ling nay jing jong gaa chung ge sik mat
translation: 避免食令你症狀加重嘅食物。

english: Do not take painkillers such as ibuprofen unless your clinician advises it.
transliteration: ceoi fei yi wu yan yun gung gin fou dak ji wai m hou sik ibuprofen ni lui zi tung yeuk
translation: 除非醫護人員建議，否則唔好食 ibuprofen 呢類止痛藥。

english: We may refer you to a digestive system specialist.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang wui jyun gaai nay hui tai siu faa hai tung juen ga yi sang
translation: 我哋可能會轉介你去睇消化系統專科醫生。

english: If you develop severe pain or bleeding, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: YU-GWO NAY HOI-CHI YAU YIN-JUNG TUNG-CHOH HAW-JEH CHUT-HYUT, CHING JIK-KAH HAY-CHOH-EE.
translation: 如果你開始有嚴重痛楚或者出血，請即刻去求醫。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH YE-SHEUNG-MAN?
translation: 你有冇嘢想問？

english: Can you tell me what symptoms would make you seek urgent help?
transliteration: NAY HOH-M-HOH-YI WAH-BEI-NGOH-JEE, YAU-ME-SHING-JEUNG HOI-LING-NAY JIK-KAH HAY-CHOH-JOO?
translation: 你可唔可以話畀我知，有咩症狀會令你即刻去求助？

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI WUI-BONG-NAY ON-PAI FUH-JAN.
translation: 我哋會幫你安排覆診。

english: Please return if your symptoms get worse.
transliteration: YU-GWO NAY-GEH SHING-JEUNG GAA-JOONG, CHING WUI-LAI TAI-EE-SHANG.
translation: 如果你嘅症狀加重，請返嚟睇醫生。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: DOH-JEH-NAY GAM-YAT TUNG-NGOH KING-GAI.
translation: 多謝你今日同我傾偈。

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: NAY-HOH, NGOH-HAI NAY EE-LIUH TUHN-DEI-GEH YAT-YUHN.
translation: 你好，我係你醫療團隊嘅一員。

english: What brought you here today?
transliteration: NAY GAM-YAT DIM-GAI-LAI-LEE-DOH?
translation: 你今日點解嚟呢度？

english: I would like to ask some questions about your urinary health.
transliteration: NGOH SEUNG-MAN-NAY GEI-TIUH GWAHN-YU BAI-NIUH GIN-KONG-GEH MAN-TAI.
translation: 我想問你幾條關於泌尿健康嘅問題。

english: Some questions may be personal; is that okay?
transliteration: YAU-DEI MAN-TAI HOH-NANG BAI-GAU SAI-YAN, GAM-YEUNG HOH-YI-MOH?
translation: 有啲問題可能比較私人，咁樣可以嗎？

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: NGOH HOH-YI BONG-NAY-JOHK GIN-CHA-MOH?
translation: 我可以幫你做檢查嗎？

english: Would you like a chaperone present for the examination?
transliteration: GIN-CHA-GEH SIH-HAU, NAY SEUNG-M-SEUNG YAU KEI-TA EE-WUH YUN-YUHN PEI-JOO-NAY?
translation: 檢查嘅時候，你想唔想有其他醫護人員陪住你？

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: NAY SUI-M-SUI-YIU CHUHN-YIK-YUHN?
translation: 你需唔需要傳譯員？

english: When did the problem begin?
transliteration: NEE-GOH MAN-TAI GEI-SHIH HOI-CHI?
translation: 呢個問題幾時開始？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: HAI TUT-YAN HOI-CHI, DING-HAI MAN-MAN HOI-CHI?
translation: 係突然開始，定係慢慢開始？

english: How long have you had these symptoms?
transliteration: NAY YAU-NEE-DEI SHING-JEUNG GEI-DOH-LOH?
translation: 你有呢啲症狀幾耐喇？

english: Are the symptoms getting better or worse?
transliteration: DEE SHING-JEUNG YAU-MOH HOH-JUEN, DING-HAI CHAA-JOH?
translation: 啲症狀有冇好轉，定係差咗？

english: Does the problem come and go?
transliteration: NEE-GOH MAN-TAI WUI-M-WUI SIH-YAU-SIH-MOH?
translation: 呢個問題會唔會時有時無？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: NAY YI-CHIN YAU-MOH SIH-GWO NEE-GOH MAN-TAI?
translation: 你以前有冇試過呢個問題？

english: What concerns you most about these symptoms?
transliteration: NEE-DEI SHING-JEUNG YUH-MEEN, NAY JEUI-DAM-SUM-GEH HAI-ME?
translation: 呢啲症狀入面，你最擔心嘅係咩？

english: Are you urinating more often than usual?
transliteration: NAY HUI SIOU-BIN-GEH CHI-SOOU YAU-MOH-BI-PING-SIH DOH?
translation: 你去小便嘅次數有冇比平時多？

english: Please point to the area that hurts.
transliteration: CHING NAY JI-YAT-JI TUNG-GEH WAI-JI.
translation: 請你指一指痛嘅位置。

english: I will press gently on your lower abdomen.
transliteration: NGOH WUI HAI NAY HAA-BUH-BOH CHING-CHING ON-NAY.
translation: 我會輕輕按你下腹部。

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: NGOH ON-NEE-DOH-GEH-SIH, YU-GWO TUNG JIU-WAH-NGOH-JEE.
translation: 我按呢度嘅時候，如果痛就話我知。

english: I am going to tap gently on your back near the kidneys.
transliteration: NGOH WUI HAI NAY BOI-BIK GAN-GAN-GAN-JONG-GEH WAI-JI CHING-CHING HAUK-GEI-HA.
translation: 我會喺你背脊近腎臟嘅位置輕輕敲幾下。

english: I may need to examine your genital area; I will explain and ask permission first.
transliteration: NGOH HOH-NANG YIU-GIN-CHA NAY-GEH SANG-JIK-GEE-BUH-WAI; NGOH-WUI-SIN-GAI-SI-CHING-CHOH, JOI-MAN-NAY HOH-M-HOH-YI.
translation: 我可能要檢查你嘅生殖器部位；我會先解釋清楚，再問你可唔可以。

english: Please tell me immediately if anything hurts.
transliteration: YU-GWO YAU-ANY-GOH-WAI-JI TUNG, CHING JIK-KAH WAH-NGOH-JEE.
translation: 如果有任何地方痛，請即刻話我知。

english: We can pause or stop the examination at any time.
transliteration: GIN-CHA-GIUN-GAAN NAY SUH-CHI HOH-YI-GIU-NGOH TING-YAT-TING HAW-JEH TING-CHI.
translation: 檢查期間你隨時可以叫我暫停或者停止。

english: A prostate examination may be helpful; I will explain it first.
transliteration: GIN-CHA CHIN-LIT-SIN HOH-NANG WU-YIU-CHUH, NGOH WUI-SIN-GAI-SI-CHING-CHOH.
translation: 檢查前列腺可能會有幫助，我會先解釋清楚。

english: The prostate examination may involve a gloved finger in the rectum.
transliteration: GIN-CHA CHIN-LIT-SIN-SIH, HOH-NANG-YIU DAI-SAU-TOH-YUNG-SAU-JI-GING-LIK-JI-CHANG-DOI-CHONG-CHANG.
translation: 檢查前列腺時，可能要戴手套用手指放入直腸。

english: Is it okay to proceed with this examination?
transliteration: NAY TUNG-M-TUNG-YI NGOH-DEI GAI-JOOK-JO GAM-NEE-GOH GIN-CHA?
translation: 你同唔同意我哋繼續做呢個檢查？

english: Would you like a chaperone for this examination?
transliteration: NAY SEUNG-M-SEUNG YAU-YAN PEI-JOO-NAY GAI-NEE-GOH GIN-CHA?
translation: 你想唔想有人陪住你做呢個檢查？

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: CHING NAY JUEN-SAN-SIK-FAN.
translation: 請你轉身側瞓。

english: Please bend your knees toward your chest.
transliteration: CHING NAY GEUNG-TAU WUK-MAI HEUNG-SUNG-KAU.
translation: 請你將膝頭屈埋向胸口。

english: I will check for swelling or tenderness in the scrotum.
transliteration: NGOH WUI GIN-CHA YAM-TOH YAU-MOH JUNG, HAW-JEH ON-LOH-HEI WUI-M-WUI TUNG.
translation: 我會檢查陰囊有冇腫或者按落去會唔會痛。

english: Please cough while I examine your groin.
transliteration: NGOH GIN-CHA NAY KWA-HAA-GEH-SIH, CHING NAY HAAK-YAT-SING.
translation: 我檢查你胯下嘅時候，請你咳一聲。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI SUI-YIU YAT-FAN NIU-YAP-MOOHN.
translation: 我哋需要一份尿液樣本。

english: Please collect urine in this clean container.
transliteration: CHING NAY YUNG-NEE-GOH GON-JING-GEH YONG-GEE LAU-NIU.
translation: 請你用呢個乾淨嘅容器留尿。

english: We will test your urine for infection and blood.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI WUI YIM-NAY-GEH NIU YAU-MOH GAAM-YIM TUNG HYUT.
translation: 我哋會驗你嘅尿有冇感染同血。

english: We may send the urine for a culture.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI HOH-NANG WUI-JEUEN NIU-YAP-SUNG-CHUI-HOEN-GUEN.
translation: 我哋可能會將尿液送去做細菌培養。

english: We would like to check your kidney function with blood tests.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI SEUNG YUNG-YIM-HYUT GIN-CHA NAY-GEH GAN-GUNG.
translation: 我哋想用驗血檢查你嘅腎功能。

english: We may arrange an ultrasound of your kidneys and bladder.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI HOH-NANG WUI ON-PAI-NAY JIU GAN-JONG TUNG GOH-BOH-JOHNG CHIU-SING-BO.
translation: 我哋可能會安排你照腎臟同膀胱超聲波。

english: We may need a CT scan to look for kidney stones.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI HOH-NANG SUI-YIU BONG-NAY JIU CT, TAI-HAA YAU-MOH GAN-SEK.
translation: 我哋可能需要幫你照 CT，睇下有冇腎石。

english: We may check how much urine remains in your bladder after you urinate.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI HOH-NANG WUI GIN-CHA NAY SIOU-BIN-JE GOH-BOH-JOHNG JUNG-SING GEI-DOH-NIU.
translation: 我哋可能會檢查你小便之後膀胱仲剩幾多尿。

english: We may need a camera examination of the bladder called cystoscopy.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI HOH-NANG SUI-YIU YUNG GOH-BOH-JOHNG-GING GIN-CHA NAY-GEH GOH-BOH-JOHNG.
translation: 我哋可能需要用膀胱鏡檢查你嘅膀胱。

english: We may need to give you antibiotics.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI HOH-NANG SUI-YIU BEI ONG-SING-SOO NAY SIK.
translation: 我哋可能需要畀抗生素你食。

english: Please take this medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: CHING NAY GAN-JOOK CHU-FOHNG SIK-NEE-JUN YEUK.
translation: 請你跟足處方食呢隻藥。

english: You may need a catheter to drain your bladder.
transliteration: NAY HOH-NANG SUI-YIU YUNG NIU-HAU PAI-JAU GOH-BOH-JOHNG YUH-MEEN-GEH NIU.
translation: 你可能需要用尿喉排走膀胱入面嘅尿。

english: We will explain the catheter procedure and ask for your consent.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI WUI GAI-SI-CHA NIU-HAU-GEH GWO-CHING, JOI JING-CHAU NAY TUNG-YI.
translation: 我哋會解釋插尿喉嘅過程，再徵求你同意。

english: Please keep the catheter bag below the level of your bladder.
transliteration: CHING JOENG NIU-HAU-DOH-FONG HAI DAI-GWO GOH-BOH-JOHNG-GEH WAI-JI.
translation: 請將尿喉袋放喺低過膀胱嘅位置。

english: You may need to strain your urine to collect a stone.
transliteration: NAY HOH-NANG YIU YUNG LOH-WONG SAI-NIU, SAU-JIP GAN-SEK.
translation: 你可能要用濾網篩尿，收集腎石。

english: We may refer you to a urologist.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI HOH-NANG WUI JUEN-GAA NAY HUI-TAI BAI-NIU-KOH EE-SHANG.
translation: 我哋可能會轉介你去睇泌尿科醫生。

english: We may refer you to a kidney specialist.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI HOH-NANG WUI JUEN-GAA NAY HUI-TAI GAN-JONG JUH-JOHN EE-SHANG.
translation: 我哋可能會轉介你去睇腎臟專科醫生。

english: If you cannot urinate or develop severe pain or fever, seek urgent care.
transliteration: YU-GWO NAY NIU-M-CHUT, HAW-JEH HOI-CHI GAU-TUNG HAW-JEH FAAT-SIU, CHING JIK-KAH HAY-CHOH-EE.
translation: 如果你尿唔出，或者開始劇痛或者發燒，請即刻求醫。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH MAN-TAI SEUNG-MAN?
translation: 你有冇問題想問？

english: Can you tell me which symptoms would need urgent medical attention?
transliteration: NAY HOH-M-HOH-YI WAH-NGOH-JEE, YAU-DEI-ME SHING-JEUNG YIU JIK-KAH HAY-CHOH-EE?
translation: 你可唔可以話我知，有啲咩症狀要即刻求醫？

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI WUI-BONG-NAY ON-PAI FUH-JAN.
translation: 我哋會幫你安排覆診。

english: Please return if your symptoms worsen.
transliteration: YU-GWO NAY-GEH SHING-JEUNG OHK-WAA, CHING WUI-LAI TAI-EE-SHANG.
translation: 如果你嘅症狀惡化，請返嚟睇醫生。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: DOH-JEH-NAY GAM-YAT TUNG-NGOH KING-GAI.
translation: 多謝你今日同我傾偈。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: NAY GAM-YAT DIM-GAI-LAI TAI-EE-SHANG?
translation: 你今日點解嚟睇醫生？

english: When did your symptoms start?
transliteration: NAY GEI-SHIH HOI-CHI YAU-NEE-DEI SHING-JEUNG?
translation: 你幾時開始有呢啲症狀？

english: Have your symptoms been getting worse?
transliteration: NAY-DEI SHING-JEUNG YAU-MOH YUHH-LAI-YUHH YIN-JUNG?
translation: 你啲症狀有冇愈嚟愈嚴重？

english: Do you have any other symptoms?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH KEI-TA SHING-JEUNG?
translation: 你有冇其他症狀？

english: May I ask about your medical history?
transliteration: NGOH HOH-M-HOH-YI MAN-HAA NAY-GEH BING-LIK?
translation: 我可唔可以問下你嘅病歷？

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: NGOH HOH-M-HOH-YI GIN-CHA NAY?
translation: 我可唔可以檢查你？

english: Would you like an interpreter?
transliteration: NAY SUI-M-SUI-YIU CHUHN-YIK-YUHN?
translation: 你需唔需要傳譯員？

english: Have you been diagnosed with diabetes?
transliteration: EE-SHANG YAU-MOH JEN-DUHN NAY YAU TONG-NIU-BING?
translation: 醫生有冇診斷你有糖尿病？

english: Do you have type 1 or type 2 diabetes?
transliteration: NAY YAU YAT-YING DING YI-YING TONG-NIU-BING?
translation: 你有一型定二型糖尿病？

english: How long have you had diabetes?
transliteration: NAY YAU TONG-NIU-BING GEI-DOH-LOH?
translation: 你有糖尿病幾耐？

english: Are you more thirsty than usual?
transliteration: NAY HAI-M-HAI-BI-PING-SIH GANG-HOU-KOIH?
translation: 你係咪比平時更口渴？

english: Are you urinating more often?
transliteration: NAY HAI-M-HAI SIOU-BIN DOH-JOH?
translation: 你係咪小便多咗？

english: Do you wake up at night to urinate?
transliteration: NAY-YEH-MAN WUI-M-WUI HEI-SAN SIOU-BIN?
translation: 你夜晚會唔會起身小便？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH-MOH-GOH-YI JIN-FEI, DAN-HAI TAI-JUNG GING-JOH?
translation: 你有冇冇刻意減肥但體重輕咗？

english: Do you feel more hungry than usual?
transliteration: NAY HAI-M-HAI-BI-PING-SIH GANG-YUNG-YI DOH?
translation: 你係咪比平時更容易肚餓？

english: Have you noticed blurred vision?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH GOK-DOU SIH-LIK MOH-WUH?
translation: 你有冇覺得視力模糊？

english: Do you feel unusually tired?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH GOK-DOU DAK-BIT GUI?
translation: 你有冇覺得特別攰？

english: Have you had frequent infections?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH SENG-YAT-GAM-YIM?
translation: 你有冇成日感染？

english: Do your wounds take a long time to heal?
transliteration: NAY-DEI SEUNG-KAU HAI-M-HAI YIU HOU-NOI CHIN-JI MAI-HOU?
translation: 你啲傷口係咪要好耐先至埋口？

english: Do you check your blood sugar at home?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH HAI-OH-KEY YIM HYUT-TONG?
translation: 你有冇喺屋企驗血糖？

english: How often do you check your blood sugar?
transliteration: NAY GEI-DOH-LOH YIM-YAT-CHI HYUT-TONG?
translation: 你幾耐驗一次血糖？

english: What was your last blood sugar reading?
transliteration: NAY SHEUNG-YAT-CHI YIM-DOU-GEH HYUT-TONG HAI GEI-DOH?
translation: 你上次驗到嘅血糖係幾多？

english: Do you use a continuous glucose monitor?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH YUNG LIEN-SOOK HYUT-TONG GIN-JAK-GEE?
translation: 你有冇用連續血糖監測器？

english: Have you brought your glucose readings?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH DAAI-MAI NAY-GEH HYUT-TONG DOHK-SOO?
translation: 你有冇帶埋你嘅血糖讀數？

english: Have you had an HbA1c blood test?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH YIM-GWO HB-A1C?
translation: 你有冇驗過 HbA1c？

english: We will check your blood sugar now.
transliteration: NGOH-DEI YI-GOH-HAI BONG-NAY YIM HYUT-TONG.
translation: 我哋而家幫你驗血糖。

english: Your blood sugar is higher than the target.
transliteration: NAY-GEH HYUT-TONG GO-GWO MOO-BIU SOENG-PING.
translation: 你嘅血糖高過目標水平。

english: Have you ever had low blood sugar?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH SIH-GWO DAI-HYUT-TONG?
translation: 你有冇試過低血糖？

english: Do you get shaky or sweaty when your sugar is low?
transliteration: NAY DAI-HYUT-TONG-GOH-JAN WUI-M-WUI SAU-JAN HAW-JEH CHUT-HAN?
translation: 你低血糖嗰陣會唔會手震或者出汗？

english: Do you feel dizzy or confused when your sugar is low?
transliteration: NAY DAI-HYUT-TONG-GOH-JAN WUI-M-WUI GOK-DOU TAU-WUN HAW-JEH SAN-JI-M-CHING?
translation: 你低血糖嗰陣會唔會覺得頭暈或者神志唔清？

english: Have you ever fainted because of low blood sugar?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH SIH-GWO YAN-WAI DAI-HYUT-TONG WUN-DOI?
translation: 你有冇試過因為低血糖暈低？

english: What do you do when your blood sugar is low?
transliteration: SUE-TONG-DAY-GAW-JUN, NAY-WOO-DIM-ZOH?
translation: 血糖低嗰陣，您會點做？

english: Do you carry something sugary with you?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-SUI-SUN-DAI-DEEM-TIM-YEH?
translation: 您會唔會隨身帶啲甜嘢？

english: Have you had very high blood sugar recently?
transliteration: NAY-JUI-GAN-SHI-GWO-SUE-TONG-HOU-GOU-MAH?
translation: 您最近試過血糖好高嗎？

english: Have you had nausea, vomiting, or stomach pain?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-ZOK-AU, AU-TU-HAK-JE-DU-TUNG?
translation: 您有冇作嘔、嘔吐或者肚痛？

english: Are you breathing faster or deeper than usual?
transliteration: NAY-FU-KAP-YAU-MAU-BEI-PING-SHI-FAI-ZO-HAK-JE-SHAM-ZO?
translation: 您呼吸有冇比平時快咗或者深咗？

english: Have you ever been hospitalized for diabetic ketoacidosis?
transliteration: NAY-YEE-CHIN-YAU-MAU-YAN-WAI-TONG-NIU-BING-TUNG-JING-SOON-JUNG-DU-JU-GWO-YUN?
translation: 您以前有冇因為糖尿病酮症酸中毒住過院？

english: What medicines do you take for diabetes?
transliteration: NAY-SIK-GAN-MEH-YEUK-LAI-KUNG-JAI-TONG-NIU-BING?
translation: 您食緊咩藥嚟控制糖尿病？

english: Do you take diabetes tablets?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SIK-TONG-NIU-BING-YEUK-PIEN?
translation: 您有冇食糖尿病藥片？

english: Do you use insulin?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-YAN-DOU-SOON?
translation: 您有冇用胰島素？

english: How many units of insulin do you take?
transliteration: NAY-MUI-CHI-DAA-GEI-DO-GOH-DAN-WAI-YAN-DOU-SOON?
translation: 您每次打幾多個單位胰島素？

english: When do you take your insulin?
transliteration: NAY-GEI-SHI-DAA-YAN-DOU-SOON?
translation: 您幾時打胰島素？

english: Did you take your insulin today?
transliteration: NAY-GUM-YAT-YAU-MAU-DAA-YAN-DOU-SOON?
translation: 您今日有冇打胰島素？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: NAY-JUI-GAN-YAU-MAU-LOU-SIK-GWO-YEUK?
translation: 您最近有冇漏食過藥？

english: Do you use an insulin pen or pump?
transliteration: NAY-YUNG-YAN-DOU-SOON-BUT-DING-HAI-YAN-DOU-SOON-PAM?
translation: 您用胰島素筆定係胰島素泵？

english: Where do you inject your insulin?
transliteration: NAY-HAI-BIN-DOU-DAA-YAN-DOU-SOON?
translation: 您喺邊度打胰島素？

english: Do you rotate your injection sites?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-LUN-LAU-HAI-M-BUT-TUNG-WAI-JI-DAA-JAM?
translation: 您會唔會輪流喺唔同位置打針？

english: Have you had side effects from your medicines?
transliteration: NAY-SIK-YEUK-YAU-MAU-CHUT-YIN-FU-JOK?
translation: 您食藥有冇出現副作用？

english: Would you like me to show you how to inject insulin?
transliteration: NAY-SEUNG-M-SEUNG-NGO-SHI-FAN-DIM-YEUNG-DAA-YAN-DOU-SOON?
translation: 您想唔想我示範點樣打胰島素？

english: Do you have numbness or tingling in your feet?
transliteration: NAY-JEK-GOEK-YAU-MAU-MA-BEI-HAK-JE-CHI-TUNG-GE-GAM-GAK?
translation: 您隻腳有冇麻痺或者刺痛嘅感覺？

english: Do you have burning pain in your feet?
transliteration: NAY-JEK-GOEK-YAU-MAU-JOK-YIT-CHI-TUNG?
translation: 您隻腳有冇灼熱刺痛？

english: Have you noticed any sores on your feet?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-LAU-YI-DOU-JEK-GOEK-YAU-MAU-SUN-KAU?
translation: 您有冇留意到隻腳有冇損口？

english: Do you check your feet every day?
transliteration: NAY-MUI-YAT-DOU-WOO-CHA-GUM-SEUNG-GOEK-MAH?
translation: 您每日都會檢查雙腳嗎？

english: Have you had a diabetic eye examination?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-ZOU-GWO-TONG-NIU-BING-NGAN-JING-GUM-CHA?
translation: 您有冇做過糖尿病眼睛檢查？

english: Has diabetes affected your kidneys?
transliteration: TONG-NIU-BING-YAU-MAU-YING-HEUNG-NAY-GE-KAN?
translation: 糖尿病有冇影響您嘅腎？

english: Have you had a heart attack or stroke?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SHI-GWO-SAM-JONG-BING-FAAT-HAK-JE-JUNG-FUNG?
translation: 您有冇試過心臟病發或者中風？

english: I am going to check the feeling in your feet.
transliteration: NGO-YI-GA-WUI-GUM-CHA-NAY-JEK-GOEK-GE-GAM-GAK.
translation: 我而家會檢查您隻腳嘅感覺。

english: Can you feel this on your toes?
transliteration: NAY-GEUK-JI-GAM-GAK-DO-NI-DO-GE-CHUK-PUNG-MAH?
translation: 您腳趾感覺到呢度嘅觸碰嗎？

english: Have you ever had a thyroid problem?
transliteration: NAY-YEE-CHIN-YAU-MAU-SHI-GWO-GA-JONG-SAU-YAU-MAN-TAI?
translation: 您以前有冇試過甲狀腺有問題？

english: Do you have an underactive thyroid?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GA-JONG-SAU-GUNG-NANG-DI-HA?
translation: 您有冇甲狀腺功能低下？

english: Do you have an overactive thyroid?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GA-JONG-SAU-GUNG-NANG-HANG-JIN?
translation: 您有冇甲狀腺功能亢進？

english: Do you feel unusually cold?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GOK-DUK-BE-DOUNG?
translation: 您有冇覺得特別怕凍？

english: Do you feel unusually hot or sweaty?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GOK-DUK-YIT-HAK-JE-SANG-YAT-CHUT-HAN?
translation: 您有冇覺得特別熱或者成日出汗？

english: Have you noticed your heart racing?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GOK-SAM-TIU-DAK-HOU-FAAI?
translation: 您有冇覺得心跳得好快？

english: Have you noticed shaking in your hands?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-LAU-YI-DOU-SEUNG-SAU-JUN?
translation: 您有冇留意到雙手震？

english: Have you been constipated?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-BIN-BI?
translation: 您有冇便秘？

english: Have you been having frequent bowel movements?
transliteration: NAY-JUI-GAN-YAU-MAU-SANG-YAT-DAI-BIN?
translation: 您最近有冇成日大便？

english: Have you noticed swelling in your neck?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-LAU-YI-DOU-GENG-BUK-JUNG-HEUNG?
translation: 您有冇留意到頸部腫起？

english: Is it difficult to swallow?
transliteration: NAY-SUN-YEH-YAU-MAU-KWAN-NAN?
translation: 您吞嘢有冇困難？

english: Has your voice become hoarse?
transliteration: NAY-BA-SEUNG-YAU-MAU-BIN-SHA?
translation: 您把聲有冇變沙？

english: Do you take thyroid medication?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SIK-GA-JONG-SAU-YEUK?
translation: 您有冇食甲狀腺藥？

english: Have you had thyroid surgery or radioactive iodine treatment?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-ZOU-GWO-GA-JONG-SAU-SAU-SUT-HAK-JE-FONG-SHE-YING-DI-GI-LIU-CHI-LIU-LI?
translation: 您有冇做過甲狀腺手術或者放射性碘治療？

english: Has your weight changed recently?
transliteration: NAY-JUI-GAN-TAI-JUNG-YAU-MAU-BIN?
translation: 您最近體重有冇變？

english: How much weight have you gained or lost?
transliteration: NAY-JUNG-ZO-HAK-JE-HAI-ZO-GEI-DO?
translation: 您重咗或者輕咗幾多？

english: Has your appetite changed?
transliteration: NAY-GE-WAI-KAU-YAU-MAU-BIN?
translation: 您嘅胃口有冇變？

english: What do you usually eat in a day?
transliteration: NAY-PING-SHI-YAT-TIN-TUNG-CHANG-SIK-DEEM-YEH?
translation: 您平時一日通常食啲咩？

english: How often do you exercise?
transliteration: NAY-GEI-NOI-ZOU-YAT-CHI-WAN-DUNG?
translation: 您幾耐做一次運動？

english: Do you drink sugary drinks?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-YUM-TIM-YUM-BAN?
translation: 您有冇飲甜飲品？

english: Have you tried making changes to your diet?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SHI-GWO-GOI-BIN-YUM-SIK-GUN-JA?
translation: 您有冇試過改變飲食習慣？

english: Would you like help with weight management?
transliteration: NAY-SEUNG-M-SEUNG-YAU-YAN-BONG-NAY-GUN-LAI-MAN-YA-TUNG?
translation: 您想唔想有人幫您管理體重？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you ever broken a bone after a minor fall?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SHI-GWO-HING-HING-DI-DIE-DOU-JIU-JAM-GWAT?
translation: 您有冇試過輕輕跌倒就整斷骨？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been told you have osteoporosis?
transliteration: YAU-MAU-YAN-TUNG-NAY-GONG-GWO-NAY-YAU-GWAT-JAT-SUUNG-SUNG?
translation: 有冇人同您講過您有骨質疏鬆？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had a bone density scan?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-JIU-GWO-GWAT-JAT-MAT-DOU?
translation: 您有冇照過骨質密度？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you take calcium or vitamin D?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SIK-GOI-PIEN-HAK-JE-WAI-TA-MING-D?
translation: 您有冇食鈣片或者維他命D？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had kidney stones?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SANG-GWO-KAN-SHEK?
translation: 您有冇生過腎石？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you have muscle cramps or spasms?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GEI-ROUK-CHAU-GAN-HAK-JE-JING-WAAN?
translation: 您有冇肌肉抽筋或者痙攣？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you have tingling around your mouth or fingers?
transliteration: NAY-JUI-BIN-HAK-JE-SAU-JI-YAU-MAU-MA-BEI-HAK-JE-CHI-TUNG?
translation: 您嘴邊或者手指有冇麻痺或者刺痛？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been diagnosed with a parathyroid problem?
transliteration: YEE-SANG-YAU-MAU-JAN-DU-GWO-NAY-YAU-FU-GA-JONG-SAU-MAN-TAI?
translation: 醫生有冇診斷過您有副甲狀腺問題？

english: Have you ever had a problem with your adrenal glands?
transliteration: NAY-YEE-CHIN-YAU-MAU-SHI-GWO-KAN-SEUNG-SIN-YAU-MAN-TAI?
translation: 您以前有冇試過腎上腺有問題？

english: Do you take steroid medicines such as prednisone?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SIK-LEUI-GOO-SO-YEUK, LII-LEE-PREDNISONE?
translation: 您有冇食類固醇藥，例如 prednisone？

english: How long have you been taking steroids?
transliteration: NAY-SIK-LEUI-GOO-SO-SIK-ZO-GEI-NOI?
translation: 您食類固醇食咗幾耐？

english: Have you recently stopped taking steroids?
transliteration: NAY-JUI-GAN-YAU-MAU-TING-SIK-LEUI-GOO-SO?
translation: 您最近有冇停食類固醇？

english: Do you feel dizzy when you stand up?
transliteration: NAY-KEI-YAT-SUN-GAW-JUN-WOO-M-WOO-TOU-WAN?
translation: 您企起身嗰陣會唔會頭暈？

english: Have you noticed darker patches of skin?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-LAU-YI-DOU-PEI-FU-YAU-DI-WAI-JI-YIN-SIK-SHAM-ZO?
translation: 您有冇留意到皮膚有啲位置顏色深咗？

english: Do you crave salty foods?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-DUK-BIT-SEUNG-SIK-HAAM-YEH?
translation: 您會唔會特別想食鹹嘢？

english: Have you noticed easy bruising or purple stretch marks?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-FAAT-YIN-JI-GEI-YI-SAI-YU-BEUNG-HAK-JE-YAU-JI-SIK-GE-YIN-SUN-MAN?
translation: 您有冇發現自己容易瘀傷或者有紫色嘅妊娠紋？

english: Do you have an emergency steroid plan?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GAN-KIP-CHING-KWONG-YUNG-GE-LEUI-GOO-SO-YING-KIP-GAI-WA?
translation: 您有冇緊急情況用嘅類固醇應急計劃？

english: Have you had persistent headaches or changes in vision?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-CHI-SUK-TOU-TUNG-HAK-JE-SHI-LIK-YAU-BIN?
translation: 您有冇持續頭痛或者視力有變？

english: Have your periods become irregular or stopped?
transliteration: NAY-GE-YUET-JING-YAU-MAU-BIN-DAK-M-SAT-LUI, HAK-JE-TING-ZO?
translation: 您嘅月經有冇變得唔規律，或者停咗？

english: Have you noticed unexpected milk discharge from your breasts?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-LAU-YI-DOU-YU-FONG-MOU-YUN-GU-LAU-CHUT-NAI?
translation: 您有冇留意到乳房無緣無故流出奶？

english: Have you noticed changes in sexual desire?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-LAU-YI-DOU-SIK-YUK-YAU-BIN?
translation: 您有冇留意到性慾有變？

english: Have you had problems with erections?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-BOT-YING-KUN-NAN?
translation: 您有冇勃起困難？

english: Have you noticed increased facial or body hair?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-LAU-YI-DOU-MIN-HAK-JE-SUN-SEUNG-GE-MOU-FAAT-DO-ZO?
translation: 您有冇留意到面或者身上嘅毛髮多咗？

english: Have you noticed unusual acne or hair loss?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-WOO-GU-SANG-AM-JAU-HAK-JE-LAT-TOU-FAAT?
translation: 您有冇無故生暗瘡或者甩頭髮？

english: Have you had difficulty becoming pregnant?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SHI-GWO-HOU-NAN-WAI-YUN?
translation: 您有冇試過好難懷孕？

english: Are you taking any hormone treatment?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-YUNG-GAN-HO-YUN-JI-LIU?
translation: 您有冇用緊荷爾蒙治療？

english: Does anyone in your family have diabetes?
transliteration: NAY-UK-KEI-YAU-MAU-YAN-YAU-TONG-NIU-BING?
translation: 您屋企有冇人有糖尿病？

english: Does anyone in your family have thyroid disease?
transliteration: NAY-UK-KEI-YAU-MAU-YAN-YAU-GA-JONG-SAU-BING?
translation: 您屋企有冇人有甲狀腺病？

english: Do you have high blood pressure or high cholesterol?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GOU-HUET-ONG-HAK-JE-GOU-DOM-GOO-LAI?
translation: 您有冇高血壓或者高膽固醇？

english: Do you have any kidney or heart problems?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-KAN-HAK-JE-SAM-JONG-MAN-TAI?
translation: 您有冇腎或者心臟問題？

english: Have you had any surgery?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-ZOU-GWO-SAU-SUT?
translation: 您有冇做過手術？

english: Are you pregnant or planning a pregnancy?
transliteration: NAY-YI-GA-YAU-MAU-WAI-YUN, HAK-JE-GAI-WA-WAI-YUN?
translation: 您而家有冇懷孕，或者計劃懷孕？

english: Do you smoke or drink alcohol?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-AP-YIN-HAK-JE-YUM-JAU?
translation: 您有冇吸煙或者飲酒？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-YEUK-MAT-GAN?
translation: 您有冇藥物敏感？

english: I am going to measure your height and weight.
transliteration: NGO-YI-GA-WUI-LONG-NAY-GE-SUN-GOU-TUNG-TAI-JUNG.
translation: 我而家會量您嘅身高同體重。

english: I am going to check your blood pressure.
transliteration: NGO-YI-GA-WUI-LONG-NAY-GE-HUET-ONG.
translation: 我而家會量您嘅血壓。

english: Please hold your hands out in front of you.
transliteration: CHING-NAY-SEUNG-SAU-HERUNG-CHIN-SAT.
translation: 請您雙手向前伸直。

english: I am checking whether your hands are shaking.
transliteration: NGO-YI-GA-GUM-CHA-HA-NAY-SEUNG-SAU-YAU-MAU-JUN.
translation: 我而家檢查下您雙手有冇震。

english: Please tilt your head back slightly.
transliteration: CHING-NAY-SHO-WAI-TAI-GOU-SIU-SIU-GOH-TOU.
translation: 請您稍為抬高少少個頭。

english: Please swallow while I examine your neck.
transliteration: NGO-GUM-CHA-NAY-GENG-BUK-GAW-JUN, CHING-NAY-SUN-YAT-HA-GO-SUI.
translation: 我檢查您頸部嗰陣，請您吞一下口水。

english: I am going to feel your thyroid gland.
transliteration: NGO-YI-GA-WUI-MO-HA-NAY-GE-GA-JONG-SAU.
translation: 我而家會摸下您嘅甲狀腺。

english: Please follow my finger with your eyes.
transliteration: CHING-NAY-YUNG-NGAN-MONG-JU-NGO-GE-SAU-JI-YUK.
translation: 請您用眼望住我隻手指郁。

english: I am going to examine your feet for sores.
transliteration: NGO-YI-GA-WUI-GUM-CHA-NAY-JEK-GOEK-YAU-MAU-SUN-KAU.
translation: 我而家會檢查您隻腳有冇損口。

english: Please tell me when you feel this touch.
transliteration: NAY-GOK-DO-NGO-GE-SHI, CHING-WA-NGO-JI.
translation: 您覺得我掂到您嘅時候，請話我知。

english: I am going to check your reflexes.
transliteration: NGO-YI-GA-WUI-GUM-CHA-NAY-GE-FAN-SHEK-FAN-YING.
translation: 我而家會檢查您嘅反射反應。

english: We need a blood test to check your thyroid hormones.
transliteration: NGO-DEI-YIU-YIN-HUET, GUM-CHA-NAY-GE-GA-JONG-SAU-HO-YUN.
translation: 我哋要驗血，檢查您嘅甲狀腺荷爾蒙。

english: We will check your HbA1c to assess your average blood sugar.
transliteration: NGO-DEI-WUI-GUM-CHA-NAY-GE H-B-A-one-C, TAI-HA-NAY-PING-GUN-SUE-TONG-GEI-DO.
translation: 我哋會檢查您嘅 HbA1c，睇下您平均血糖幾多。

english: We need to check your kidney function.
transliteration: NGO-DEI-YIU-GUM-CHA-NAY-GE-KAN-GUNG-NANG.
translation: 我哋要檢查您嘅腎功能。

english: We will check your cholesterol.
transliteration: NGO-DEI-WUI-GUM-CHA-NAY-GE-DOM-GOO-LAI.
translation: 我哋會檢查您嘅膽固醇。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: NGO-DEI-SUI-YIU-NAY-TI-GUNG-NIU-YIK-YEUNG-BUN.
translation: 我哋需要您提供尿液樣本。

english: You may need an ultrasound of your thyroid.
transliteration: NAY-YAU-GAN-YIU-JIU-GA-JONG-SAU-CHIU-SHENG-BO.
translation: 您可能需要照甲狀腺超聲波。

english: We may need a bone density scan.
transliteration: NGO-DEI-YAU-GAN-YIU-JIU-GWAT-JAT-MAT-DOU.
translation: 我哋可能要照骨質密度。

english: Please follow the fasting instructions for this test.
transliteration: CHING-GAN-JU-NI-GO-GUM-CHA-GE-GAM-SIK-JI-SI.
translation: 請跟住呢個檢查嘅禁食指示。

english: We will review your medications together.
transliteration: NGO-DEI-WUI-TUNG-NAY-YAT-CHI-TAI-HA-NAY-SIK-GAN-GE-YEUK.
translation: 我哋會同你一齊睇吓你食緊嘅藥。

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: CHING-ON-JIU-CHU-FONG-SIK-GAN-JEK-LEI-YEUK.
translation: 請按照處方食呢隻藥。

english: Do not change your insulin dose without guidance.
transliteration: MEI-DAK-DOU-JI-DOU-JIN-CHIN, M-HOU-JI-GAI-YAN-DOU-SOON-JAI-LONG.
translation: 未得到指導之前，唔好自行改胰島素劑量。

english: Do not stop long-term steroids suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: MEI-YAU-YEE-SANG-GIN-YI-JIN-CHIN, M-HOU-TAT-YIN-TING-SIK-CHUNG-KI-LEUI-GOO-SO.
translation: 未有醫生建議之前，唔好突然停食長期類固醇。

english: We can arrange a visit with a diabetes educator.
transliteration: NGO-DEI-HO-YI-BONG-NAY-ON-PAI-GIN-TONG-NIU-BING-GAU-YUK-YUN.
translation: 我哋可以幫你安排見糖尿病教育員。

english: Please bring your medicines and glucose readings next time.
transliteration: HA-CHI-CHING-DAI-MA-NAY-DI-YEUK-TUNG-HUET-TONG-DUK-SO.
translation: 下次請帶埋你啲藥同血糖讀數。

english: We will discuss a plan that works for you.
transliteration: NGO-DEI-WUI-YAT-CHI-TAN-YAT-GOH-SIK-HAI-NAY-GE-GAI-WA.
translation: 我哋會一齊傾一個適合你嘅計劃。

english: Are you very drowsy or confused?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-HOU-NGAN-TUN-HAK-JE-SHAN-JI-MAN-LUN?
translation: 你有冇好眼瞓或者神志混亂？

english: Are you vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-AU-DO-YUM-M-LAK-SUI?
translation: 你有冇嘔到飲唔落水？

english: Do you have severe weakness or fainting?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-YIM-JUNG-FAAT-LAI-HAK-JE-WAN-DAI?
translation: 你有冇嚴重乏力或者暈低？

english: Seek urgent medical help if you become confused or faint.
transliteration: YU-GWO-NAY-SHAN-JI-MAN-LUN-HAK-JE-WAN-DAI, CHING-JIK-KAT-KAU-YEE.
translation: 如果你神志混亂或者暈低，請即刻求醫。

english: When is your next follow-up appointment?
transliteration: NAY-HA-CHI-FU-GAN-HAI-GEI-SHI?
translation: 你下次覆診係幾時？

english: Do you have any questions about the plan?
transliteration: NAY-DEUI-GO-GAI-WA-YAU-MAU-MAN-TAI-SEUNG-MAN?
translation: 你對呢個計劃有冇問題想問？

english: What would you like help with today?
transliteration: GUM-YAT-YAU-MEH-SEUNG-NGO-BONG-NAY?
translation: 今日有咩想我幫你？

english: How have you been feeling lately?
transliteration: NAY-JUI-GAN-GOK-DAK-DIM-YA?
translation: 你最近覺得點呀？

english: Is it okay if I ask some personal questions?
transliteration: NGO-MAN-NAY-GEI-TIU-SI-YUN-MAN-TAI, HO-MAH?
translation: 我問你幾條私人問題，可以嗎？

english: You can tell me if a question feels uncomfortable.
transliteration: YU-GWO-YAU-DI-MAN-TAI-LING-NAY-M-SHU-FU, NAY-HO-YI-WA-BEI-NGO-JI.
translation: 如果有啲問題令你唔舒服，你可以話畀我知。

english: I will listen without judging you.
transliteration: NGO-WUI-TENG-NAY-GONG, M-WUI-PAN-LEUI-NAY.
translation: 我會聽你講，唔會批評你。

english: Would you prefer to speak with an interpreter?
transliteration: NAY-SEUNG-M-SEUNG-WAN-CHU-YI-YUN-BONG-SAU?
translation: 你想唔想搵傳譯員幫手？

english: I will explain the limits of confidentiality.
transliteration: NGO-WUI-GAI-SIK-BAU-MAT-GE-HAN-JAI.
translation: 我會解釋保密嘅限制。

english: Is there anything important you want me to know?
transliteration: YAU-MAU-MEH-JUNG-YIU-GE-SHI-SEUNG-WA-BEI-NGO-JI?
translation: 有冇咩重要嘅事想話畀我知？

english: When did these feelings or symptoms begin?
transliteration: NI-DI-GAM-GAK-WAAN-JING-HAI-GEI-SHI-KOI-CHI-GE?
translation: 呢啲感覺或者症狀係幾時開始嘅？

english: Did anything happen around the time they started?
transliteration: KOI-CHI-GO-JUN-JAU-MAU-FAAT-SANG-GWO-MEH-SHI?
translation: 開始嗰陣前後有冇發生過咩事？

english: Have things been getting better or worse?
transliteration: CHING-FONG-YAU-MAU-HOU-JO-HAK-JE-BIN-CHA?
translation: 情況有冇好轉或者變差？

english: How often do you feel this way?
transliteration: NAY-GEI-NOI-WUI-YAU-YAT-CHI-NI-JUNG-GAM-GAK?
translation: 你幾耐會有一次呢種感覺？

english: How much is this affecting your daily life?
transliteration: NI-GIN-SHI-DEUI-NAY-YAT-CHANG-SANG-WOONG-YING-YAU-GEI-DAI?
translation: 呢件事對你日常生活影響有幾大？

english: Are you able to go to work or school?
transliteration: NAY-JUNG-HO-YI-FAN-GUNG-HAK-JE-FAN-HOK-MAH?
translation: 你仲可以返工或者返學嗎？

english: Are you managing your usual responsibilities?
transliteration: NAY-JUNG-YING-FU-DOU-PING-SHI-YIU-ZOU-GE-SHI-MAH?
translation: 你仲應付到平時要做嘅事嗎？

english: What has helped you cope so far?
transliteration: DO-YI-GA-WAI-JI, YAU-MEH-BONG-DOU-NAY-YING-FU-NI-DI-CHING-KWONG?
translation: 到而家為止，有咩幫到你應付呢啲情況？

english: Have you been feeling sad or down?
transliteration: NAY-JUI-GAN-YAU-MAU-GOK-DAK-SHONG-SAM-HAK-JE-SAM-CHING-DI-LOK?
translation: 你最近有冇覺得傷心或者心情低落？

english: Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
transliteration: YEE-CHIN-JUNG-YI-ZOU-GE-YEH, NAY-YI-GA-YAU-MAU-M-JING-YI?
translation: 以前鍾意做嘅嘢，你而家有冇冇興趣？

english: Do you feel hopeless about the future?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-GOK-DAK-DEUI-JEUNG-LAI-MOU-HEI-MONG?
translation: 你會唔會覺得對將來冇希望？

english: Do you feel guilty or worthless?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-GOK-DAK-NAI-GAU-HAK-JE-JEI-GEI-YAT-MOU-SHI-CHO?
translation: 你會唔會覺得內疚或者自己一無是處？

english: Do you cry more often than usual?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-BEI-PING-SHI-HAAM-DAK-DO?
translation: 你有冇比平時喊得多？

english: Has your energy been low?
transliteration: NAY-JUI-GAN-HAI-M-HAI-SANG-YAT-MOU-M-GAI-JING-SHAN?
translation: 你最近係咪成日冇乜精神？

english: Is it hard to concentrate or make decisions?
transliteration: NAY-HAI-M-HAI-HOU-NAN-JUNG-JAP-JING-SHAN-HAK-JE-ZOK-JYUET-DING?
translation: 你係咪好難集中精神或者作決定？

english: Have you noticed changes in your appetite?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-LAU-YI-DOU-WAI-KAU-YAU-BIN?
translation: 你有冇留意到胃口有變？

english: Have you noticed any changes in your weight?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-LAU-YI-DOU-TAI-JUNG-YAU-BIN?
translation: 你有冇留意到體重有變？

english: Do you often feel worried or anxious?
transliteration: NAY-HAI-M-HAI-SANG-YAT-GOK-DAK-DAN-SAM-HAK-JE-FO-LUI?
translation: 你係咪成日覺得擔心或者焦慮？

english: Is it difficult to control your worries?
transliteration: NAY-HAI-M-HAI-HOU-NAN-KUNG-JAI-GEI-GE-YAU-LUI?
translation: 你係咪好難控制自己嘅憂慮？

english: Do you feel restless or on edge?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-GOK-DAK-JO-LAP-BAT-ON-HAK-JE-SAM-SHAN-BAT-DING?
translation: 你會唔會覺得坐立不安或者心神不定？

english: Do you have sudden episodes of intense fear?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-TAT-YIN-GAN-FEI-CHONG-GING-HONG-GE-SHI-HOU?
translation: 你有冇突然間非常驚恐嘅時候？

english: During these episodes, does your heart race?
transliteration: GO-JUN-SHI-NAY-WOO-M-WOO-SAM-TIU-DAK-HOU-FAAI?
translation: 嗰陣時你會唔會心跳得好快？

english: Do you feel short of breath when anxious?
transliteration: NAY-FO-LUI-GO-JUN-WOO-M-WOO-GOK-DAK-TAU-M-DOU-HEI?
translation: 你焦慮嗰陣會唔會覺得透唔到氣？

english: Do you avoid places because you fear having a panic attack?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-YIN-WAI-GING-HONG-SING-FAAT-JOK-YI-BI-HOI-M-GEE-DO-FAANG?
translation: 你會唔會因為驚恐症發作而避開某啲地方？

english: Do unwanted thoughts keep coming into your mind?
transliteration: YAU-DI-NAY-M-SEUNG-YIU-GE-NIM-TOU-WOO-M-WOO-BAT-TING-GAM-FU-YIN?
translation: 有啲你唔想要嘅念頭會唔會不停咁浮現？

english: Do you feel you must repeat certain actions?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-GOK-DAK-YAT-DING-YIU-JUNG-FUK-ZOU-M-GEE-DUNG-JOK?
translation: 你會唔會覺得一定要重複做某啲動作？

english: How many hours do you sleep each night?
transliteration: NAY-MUI-MAN-FUN-GEI-DO-GOH-JUNG?
translation: 你每晚瞓幾多個鐘？

english: Is it difficult to fall asleep?
transliteration: NAY-HAI-M-HAI-HOU-NAN-LOT-SOUI?
translation: 你係咪好難入睡？

english: Do you wake up often during the night?
transliteration: NAY-YE-MAN-WOO-M-WOO-SANG-YAT-SENG-GANG?
translation: 你夜晚會唔會成日醒？

english: Do you wake up earlier than you want to?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-JOU-GWO-GEI-GEI-SEUNG-YI-GEI-SHI-GANG?
translation: 你會唔會早過自己想起身嘅時間醒？

english: Do you feel rested in the morning?
transliteration: NAY-JIU-SANG-HAI-FI-GOK-DAK-JING-SHAN-MAH?
translation: 你朝早起身覺得精神嗎？

english: Do you have nightmares?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-FAT-OAK-MUM?
translation: 你有冇發惡夢？

english: Have you been sleeping much more than usual?
transliteration: NAY-JUI-GAN-YAU-MAU-LOT-DAK-BEI-PING-SHI-DOU-HOU-DO?
translation: 你最近有冇瞓得比平時多好多？

english: Do you feel tired during the day?
transliteration: NAY-YAT-TOU-WOO-M-WOO-GOK-DAK-GUI?
translation: 你日頭會唔會覺得攰？

english: Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic or excited?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SHI-GWO-YAU-DUEN-SHI-GAN-GOK-DAK-BIT-BYAU-JING-LIK-HAK-JE-HOU-HING-FUN?
translation: 你有冇試過有段時間覺得特別有精力或者好興奮？

english: Have you needed much less sleep without feeling tired?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-SHI-GWO-LOT-SIU-HOU-DO-HAK-JE-YAU-M-GOK-DAK-GUI?
translation: 你有冇試過瞓少好多但又唔覺得攰？

english: Have others said you were talking unusually fast?
transliteration: YAU-MAU-YAN-WA-GWO-NAY-GONG-YEH-FAAI-DAK-M-SUN-CHONG?
translation: 有冇人話過你講嘢快得唔尋常？

english: Have your thoughts been racing?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GOK-DAK-GOH-NAU-YAP-MIN-DI-NIM-FAAT-WAAN-DAK-HOU-FAAI?
translation: 你有冇覺得個腦入面啲諗法轉得好快？

english: Have you felt unusually confident or powerful?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GOK-DAK-JEI-GEI-BIT-BYU-SEUN-MUN-HAK-JE-HOU-YAU-NANG-LIK?
translation: 你有冇覺得自己特別有信心或者好有能力？

english: Have you spent more money than you intended?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-HAI-DU-LEUI, CHAOT-CHUT-JEI-GEI-YUN-BIN-DA-YEUNG?
translation: 你有冇使多咗錢，超出自己原本打算？

english: Have you taken unusual risks during these periods?
transliteration: NI-DUEN-SHI-GAN-NAY-YAU-MAU-ZOU-GWO-PING-SHI-M-WUI-ZOU-GE-MAU-HIM-HANG-WAI?
translation: 呢段時間你有冇做過平時唔會做嘅冒險行為？

english: How long did these periods last?
transliteration: NI-DI-SHI-HAU-CHI-CHYU-JO-GEI-NOI?
translation: 呢啲時期持續咗幾耐？

english: Have you heard voices that others cannot hear?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-TENG-DO-KEUI-TAA-YAN-TENG-M-DOU-GE-SHENG-YUM?
translation: 你有冇聽到其他人聽唔到嘅聲音？

english: Have you seen things that others cannot see?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GON-DO-KEUI-TAA-YAN-TAA-M-DOU-GE-YEH?
translation: 你有冇見到其他人睇唔到嘅嘢？

english: Do you feel that someone is watching or following you?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-GOK-DAK-YAU-YAN-GAM-SHI-HAK-JE-GAN-JUNG-NAY?
translation: 你會唔會覺得有人監視或者跟蹤你？

english: Do you feel that someone wants to harm you?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-GOK-DAK-YAU-YAN-SEUNG-SHONG-HAI-NAY?
translation: 你會唔會覺得有人想傷害你？

english: Do you feel your thoughts are being controlled?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-GOK-DAK-JEI-GEI-SI-SHEUNG-SAU-DOU-KUNG-JAI?
translation: 你會唔會覺得自己嘅思想受到控制？

english: Do the voices ever tell you to do something?
transliteration: DI-SHENG-YUM-YAU-MAU-GIU-NAY-ZOU-DI-YEH?
translation: 啲聲音有冇叫你做啲嘢？

english: What do you think these experiences mean?
transliteration: NAY-GOK-DAK-NI-DI-GING-LIK-DAI-BIU-DI-MEH?
translation: 你覺得呢啲經歷代表啲咩？

english: Do these experiences frighten you?
transliteration: NI-DI-GING-LIK-WOO-M-WOO-LING-NAY-GONG?
translation: 呢啲經歷會唔會令你驚？

english: Sometimes when people feel overwhelmed, they think about death. Has that happened to you?
transliteration: YAU-SHI-YAN-GOK-DAK-HOU-NAN-NAI, WUI-NIM-DOU-SI-MONG. NAY-YAU-MAU-SHI-GWO-GAM-NIM?
translation: 有時人覺得好難捱，會諗到死亡。你有冇試過咁諗？

english: Have you wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-HEI-MONG-JEI-GEI-SOUI-JO-JEUN-M-SAI-JOI-SING?
translation: 你有冇希望自己瞓咗之後唔使再醒？

english: Have you had thoughts of ending your life?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-NIM-GWO-GIT-SHUK-JEI-GEI-SANG-MING?
translation: 你有冇諗過結束自己嘅生命？

english: Are you having those thoughts right now?
transliteration: NAY-YI-GA-YAU-MAU-NI-DI-NIM-TOU?
translation: 你而家有冇呢啲念頭？

english: Have you thought about how you might do it?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-NIM-GWO-WUI-YUNG-MEH-FONG-FAAT-HEUI-ZOU?
translation: 你有冇諗過會用咩方法去做？

english: Have you made a plan to end your life?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GAI-WA-GIT-SHUK-JEI-GEI-SANG-MING?
translation: 你有冇計劃結束自己嘅生命？

english: Do you have access to anything you might use to hurt yourself?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-JIP-CHUK-DOU-YAT-DI-YAU-GAN-YUNG-LAI-SEUNG-HEOI-JEI-GEI-GE-YEH?
translation: 你有冇接觸到任何可能用嚟傷害自己嘅嘢？

english: Have you ever tried to end your life before?
transliteration: NAY-YEE-CHIN-YAU-MAU-SHI-GWO-GIT-SHUK-JEI-GEI-SANG-MING?
translation: 你以前有冇試過結束自己嘅生命？

english: Have you ever hurt yourself on purpose?
transliteration: NAY-YEE-CHIN-YAU-MAU-GU-YI-SEUNG-HAI-GWO-JEI-GEI?
translation: 你以前有冇故意傷害過自己？

english: What has helped you stay safe so far?
transliteration: DO-YI-GA-WAI-JI, YAU-MEH-BONG-DOU-NAY-QUE-BAO-JEI-GEI-ON-CHUEN?
translation: 到而家為止，有咩幫到你確保自己安全？

english: Is there someone you trust whom we can contact?
transliteration: YAU-MAU-NAY-SUN-DAK-GWO-GE-YAN, NGO-DEI-HO-YI-LIN-LOK?
translation: 有冇你信得過嘅人，我哋可以聯絡？

english: I am concerned about your safety and want to help you stay safe.
transliteration: NGO-DAN-SAM-NAY-GE-ON-CHUEN, SEUNG-BONG-NAY-QUE-BAO-ON-CHUEN.
translation: 我擔心你嘅安全，想幫你確保安全。

english: Do you feel safe where you live?
transliteration: NAY-HAI-JU-GE-DOU-FANG-GOK-DAK-ON-CHUEN-MAH?
translation: 你喺住嘅地方覺得安全嗎？

english: Has anyone threatened or hurt you?
transliteration: YAU-MAU-YAN-WAI-HIP-GWO-NAY-HAK-JE-SEUNG-HAI-GWO-NAY?
translation: 有冇人威脅過你或者傷害過你？

english: Are you afraid of anyone at home?
transliteration: NAY-HAI-UK-KEI-YAU-MAU-GING-BIN-GOH?
translation: 你喺屋企有冇驚邊個？

english: Have you had thoughts of hurting someone else?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-NIM-GWO-SEUNG-HAI-KWAI-TAA-YAN?
translation: 你有冇諗過傷害其他人？

english: Is there a particular person you are thinking about hurting?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-NIM-JYU-SEUNG-HAI-MAU-YAT-GOH-YAN?
translation: 你有冇諗住傷害某一個人？

english: Do you have a plan to hurt anyone?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GAI-WA-SEUNG-HAI-ANY-YAN?
translation: 你有冇計劃傷害任何人？

english: Are there children or other vulnerable people at home?
transliteration: UK-KEI-YAU-MAU-SIU-PANG-YAU-HAK-JE-KEUI-TAA-SUI-YIU-BIT-SHU-GAU-JIU-GE-YAN?
translation: 屋企有冇小朋友或者其他需要特別照顧嘅人？

english: Have you experienced something frightening or traumatic?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-GING-LIK-GWO-YAT-DI-LING-YAN-GING-HONG-HAK-JE-CHUONG-SEUNG-GE-SHI?
translation: 你有冇經歷過一啲令人驚慌或者創傷嘅事？

english: You do not have to share details before you are ready.
transliteration: NAY-MEI-JUN-BEI-HOU-YEE-CHIN, M-SAI-GONG-CHIANG-CHING.
translation: 你未準備好之前，唔使講詳情。

english: Do memories of that experience come back unexpectedly?
transliteration: GO-GIN-SHI-GE-GEI-YIK-WOO-M-WOO-TAT-YIN-WAN-WAN-LAI?
translation: 嗰件事嘅記憶會唔會突然返返嚟？

english: Do you have nightmares about what happened?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-FAAT-GWO-GUN-YU-GO-GIN-SHI-GE-UM-MUM?
translation: 你有冇發過關於嗰件事嘅惡夢？

english: Do you avoid reminders of what happened?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-BI-HOI-LING-NAY-NIM-HEI-GO-GIN-SHI-GE-YAN-WA-SHI?
translation: 你會唔會避開令你諗起嗰件事嘅人或事？

english: Do you feel constantly on guard or unsafe?
transliteration: NAY-WOO-M-WOO-SANG-YAT-TAI-GOU-GING-KIP, HAK-JE-GOK-DAK-M-ON-CHUEN?
translation: 你會唔會成日提高警覺，或者覺得唔安全？

english: Do you sometimes feel disconnected from yourself or your surroundings?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-SHI-WOO-M-WOO-GOK-DAK-TUNG-JEI-GEI-HAK-JE-JAU-WAI-GE-WAAN-JING-HOU-CHI-TOT-JO-JIP?
translation: 你有時會唔會覺得同自己或者周圍嘅環境好似脫咗節？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: NAY-YAU-MAU-YUM-JAU?
translation: 你有冇飲酒？

english: How often and how much do you drink?
transliteration: nay gei noi yam yat chi jau?
translation: 你幾耐飲一次酒？每次飲幾多？

english: Have you wanted to cut down on drinking?
transliteration: nay yau mou nam gwo siu yam di jau?
translation: 你有冇諗過少飲啲酒？

english: Has anyone expressed concern about your drinking?
transliteration: yau mou yan tung nay gong gwo, dam sam nay yam jau?
translation: 有冇人同你講過，擔心你飲酒？

english: Do you use cannabis?
transliteration: nay yau mou kap sik dai ma?
translation: 你有冇吸食大麻？

english: Do you use cocaine, opioids, or other drugs?
transliteration: nay yau mou yung ho ka yan, aa pin lui yeuk mat, waak jeh kei taa duk ban?
translation: 你有冇用可卡因、鴉片類藥物，或者其他毒品？

english: Have you ever injected drugs?
transliteration: nay yau mou si gwo yung jam daa duk ban?
translation: 你有冇試過用針打毒品？

english: When did you last use alcohol or other substances?
transliteration: nay seung yat chi yam jau waak jeh yung kei taa yeuk mat hai gei si?
translation: 你上一次飲酒或者用其他藥物係幾時？

english: Do you feel shaky or unwell when you stop using them?
transliteration: nay ting yung go di ye zi hau, wui m wui sau jin waak jeh gok dak m syu fuk?
translation: 你停用嗰啲嘢之後，會唔會手震或者覺得唔舒服？

english: Have you ever had a seizure during withdrawal?
transliteration: nay yau mou si gwo ting yung zi hau din gan faat zok?
translation: 你有冇試過停用之後癲癇發作？

english: Would you like support to reduce or stop using substances?
transliteration: nay seung m seung yau yan bong nay gaam siu waak jeh ting ji yung yeuk mat?
translation: 你想唔想有人幫你減少或者停止用藥物？

english: How do you feel about your eating habits?
transliteration: nay dim tai gei ge yam sik gwaan jaap?
translation: 你點睇自己嘅飲食習慣？

english: Do you worry a lot about your weight or body shape?
transliteration: nay wui m wui sing yat dam sam ji gei gei jung waak jeh san ying?
translation: 你會唔會成日擔心自己嘅體重或者身形？

english: Have you been skipping meals or restricting food?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mou m sik jing faan, waak jeh yi yi siu sik ye?
translation: 你最近有冇唔食正餐，或者刻意少食嘢？

english: Do you sometimes feel unable to stop eating?
transliteration: nay yau mou si gwo gok dak gei sik ye ting m dou?
translation: 你有冇試過覺得自己食嘢停唔到？

english: Have you made yourself vomit after eating?
transliteration: nay yau mou si gwo sik yun ye zi hau ji gei ceui tou?
translation: 你有冇試過食完嘢之後自己催吐？

english: Have you been exercising to compensate for eating?
transliteration: nay yau mou wai zo dai siu sik ye ji zou wan dung?
translation: 你有冇為咗抵消食嘢而做運動？

english: Have you had trouble paying attention?
transliteration: nay yau mou si gwo hou naan zaap zung zing san?
translation: 你有冇試過好難集中精神？

english: Do you often forget appointments or tasks?
transliteration: nay hai mai sing yat m gei dak yue wui waak jeh yiu zou ge si?
translation: 你係咪成日唔記得約會或者要做嘅事？

english: Have you noticed changes in your memory?
transliteration: nay yau mou lau yi dou gei gei jau bin faa?
translation: 你有冇留意到自己嘅記憶有變化？

english: Do you find it difficult to organize tasks?
transliteration: nay gok dak on paai si cing hou kun naan maa?
translation: 你覺得安排事情好困難嗎？

english: Have you been feeling confused?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mou gok dak hou wan lyun?
translation: 你最近有冇覺得好混亂？

english: Has anyone noticed a change in your behaviour?
transliteration: yau mou yan lau yi dou nay ge hang wai yau bin faa?
translation: 有冇人留意到你嘅行為有變化？

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: nay ho m ho yi waa bei ngo zi nay ge cyun meng?
translation: 你可唔可以話畀我知你嘅全名？

english: Can you tell me today’s date?
transliteration: nay ho m ho yi waa bei ngo zi gam yat hai gei yuet gei hou?
translation: 你可唔可以話畀我知今日係幾月幾號？

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: nay ho m ho yi waa bei ngo zi ngo dei yi gaa hai bin dou?
translation: 你可唔可以話畀我知我哋而家喺邊度？

english: I will say three words; please repeat them.
transliteration: ngo wui gong saam go zi, cing nay gan zeu gong yat chi.
translation: 我會講三個字，請你跟住講一次。

english: Please try to remember those words for later.
transliteration: cing nay si haa gei zyu go gei go zi, ciu di ngo wui joi man nay.
translation: 請你試下記住嗰幾個字，遲啲我會再問你。

english: Can you tell me those three words now?
transliteration: nay yi gaa ho m ho yi gong fan go saam go zi bei ngo teng?
translation: 你而家可唔可以講返嗰三個字畀我聽？

english: Can you spell a word backwards?
transliteration: nay ho m ho yi jeung yat go zi dou zyun cyun ceut lei?
translation: 你可唔可以將一個字倒轉串出嚟？

english: What do you think is causing these difficulties?
transliteration: nay gok dak ni di kun naan hai me jan yau sing ge?
translation: 你覺得呢啲困難係咩原因造成嘅？

english: How would you describe your mood today?
transliteration: nay gam yat ge sam cing dim yeung?
translation: 你今日嘅心情點樣？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever seen a psychiatrist or counsellor?
transliteration: nay yi cin yau mou gin gwo zing san fo yi sang waak jeh fu dou yuen?
translation: 你以前有冇見過精神科醫生或者輔導員？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health care?
transliteration: nay yi cin yau mou wai hai zing san gin hong man tai yap gwo yuen?
translation: 你以前有冇因為精神健康問題入過院？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Has anyone in your family had mental health difficulties?
transliteration: nay uk kei yan yau mou yan yau gwo zing san gin hong fong min ge kun naan?
translation: 你屋企人有冇人有過精神健康方面嘅困難？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Do you have any medical conditions?
transliteration: nay yau mou jam ho gin hong man tai?
translation: 你有冇任何健康問題？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who do you live with?
transliteration: nay tung bin go yat hei zyu?
translation: 你同邊個一齊住？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who can you turn to for support?
transliteration: nay yau me yan ho yi wan lei bong sau?
translation: 你有咩人可以搵嚟幫手？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you had recent financial or housing difficulties?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mou ging zai waak jeh zyu uk fong min ge kun naan?
translation: 你最近有冇經濟或者住屋方面嘅困難？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Are your relationships causing you stress?
transliteration: nay ge yan zai gwaan hai yau mou ling nay gok dak yau zaap lik?
translation: 你嘅人際關係有冇令你覺得有壓力？

english: What medicines are you taking now?
transliteration: nay yi gaa sik gan di me yeuk?
translation: 你而家食緊啲咩藥？

english: Do you take antidepressant medication?
transliteration: nay yau mou sik hong yat youk yeuk?
translation: 你有冇食抗抑鬱藥？

english: Do you take medicine for anxiety?
transliteration: nay yau mou sik ji liu kiu lau ge yeuk?
translation: 你有冇食治療焦慮嘅藥？

english: Do you take antipsychotic medication?
transliteration: nay yau mou sik hong zing san beng yeuk?
translation: 你有冇食抗精神病藥？

english: Do you take a mood stabilizer?
transliteration: nay yau mou sik cing seoi wan ding zai?
translation: 你有冇食情緒穩定劑？

english: Do you take sleeping pills or benzodiazepines?
transliteration: nay yau mou sik on min yeuk waak jeh bun yi dang zo lau yeuk mat?
translation: 你有冇食安眠藥或者苯二氮䓬類藥物？

english: What dose do you take and how often?
transliteration: nay mui chi sik gei do zai leung? gei noi sik yat chi?
translation: 你每次食幾多劑量？幾耐食一次？

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: nay sik ni zek yeuk sik zo gei noi?
translation: 你食呢隻藥食咗幾耐？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mou lou sik gwo yeuk?
translation: 你最近有冇漏食過藥？

english: Has the medicine been helping?
transliteration: ni zek yeuk yau mou bong dou nay?
translation: 呢隻藥有冇幫到你？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: nay yau mou lau yi dou jam ho fu zok yung?
translation: 你有冇留意到任何副作用？

english: Have you stopped any medication recently?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mou ting gwo jam ho yeuk?
translation: 你最近有冇停過任何藥？

english: What are your goals for treatment?
transliteration: nay hei mong ji liu ho yi daat dou me muk biu?
translation: 你希望治療可以達到咩目標？

english: Would you be interested in talking therapy or counselling?
transliteration: nay yau mou hing ceoi zou sam lei ji liu waak jeh fu dou?
translation: 你有冇興趣做心理治療或者輔導？

english: We can discuss medication options together.
transliteration: ngo dei ho yi yat hei teng haa yau me yeuk mat syun zaak.
translation: 我哋可以一齊傾下有咩藥物選擇。

english: Some medicines take several weeks to work fully.
transliteration: yau di yeuk yiu gei go sing kei sin wui yun cyun gin hau.
translation: 有啲藥要幾個星期先會完全見效。

english: Please speak with your clinician before stopping medication.
transliteration: ting yeuk zi cin, cing sin tung nay ge yi wu yan yuen teng haa.
translation: 停藥之前，請先同你嘅醫護人員傾下。

english: Would you like us to involve a trusted family member?
transliteration: nay seung m seung ngo dei wan yat wai nay seon yam ge gaa yan yat hei bong sau?
translation: 你想唔想我哋搵一位你信任嘅家人一齊幫手？

english: We can make a plan for what to do if symptoms worsen.
transliteration: yu gwo zing zong ok faa, ngo dei ho yi yat hei gai waak dim yeung ying deoi.
translation: 如果症狀惡化，我哋可以一齊計劃點樣應對。

english: What concerns do you have about treatment?
transliteration: nay deoi ji liu yau me dam sam?
translation: 你對治療有咩擔心？

english: Do you feel safe going home today?
transliteration: nay gok dak gam yat faan uk kei on cyun maa?
translation: 你覺得今日返屋企安全嗎？

english: Who could you call if you felt unsafe?
transliteration: yu gwo nay gok dak m on cyun, ho yi daa bei bin go?
translation: 如果你覺得唔安全，可以打畀邊個？

english: Can we identify warning signs that things are getting worse?
transliteration: ngo dei ho m ho yi yat hei jan cing co, me cing fong dai biu si cing si hoi ci bin waai?
translation: 我哋可唔可以一齊認清楚，咩情況代表事情開始變差？

english: If you are in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
transliteration: yu gwo nay zik si san cyu wai him, cing cam kau gan gap hip zo.
translation: 如果你即時身處危險，請尋求緊急協助。

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: ngo dei ho yi bong nay on paai fu zan.
translation: 我哋可以幫你安排覆診。

english: Would you like information about local support services?
transliteration: nay seung m seung yiu bun dei zi wun fuk mou ge zi liu?
translation: 你想唔想要本地支援服務嘅資料？

english: Is there anything else you would like to ask?
transliteration: nay zung yau mou kei taa ye seung man?
translation: 你仲有冇其他嘢想問？

english: I am going to ask some questions about your symptoms.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa seung man nay gei tiu gwaan yu zing zong ge man tai.
translation: 我而家想問你幾條關於症狀嘅問題。

english: When did your symptoms first begin?
transliteration: nay jeui coi gei si hoi ci yau ni di zing zong?
translation: 你最初幾時開始有呢啲症狀？

english: Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: ni di zing zong hai dat yin hoi ci, ding hai maan maan ceut yin?
translation: 呢啲症狀係突然開始，定係慢慢出現？

english: What were you doing when this started?
transliteration: hoi ci go zan nay hai dou zou gan me?
translation: 開始嗰陣你喺度做緊咩？

english: Are the symptoms constant or do they come and go?
transliteration: ni di zing zong hai yat zik dou yau, ding hai si yau si mou?
translation: 呢啲症狀係一直都有，定係時有時無？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: mui chi faat zok wui ci zuk gei noi?
translation: 每次發作會持續幾耐？

english: How many times a day or week does this happen?
transliteration: ni zung cing yat yat waak jeh yat sing kei wui faat sang gei do chi?
translation: 呢種情況一日或者一星期會發生幾多次？

english: Are your symptoms getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: nay ge zing zong yau mou hou zyun, ok faa, waak jeh mou bin?
translation: 你嘅症狀有冇好轉、惡化，或者冇變？

english: Have you ever had this problem before?
transliteration: nay yi cin yau mou si gwo yau ni go man tai?
translation: 你以前有冇試過有呢個問題？

english: Does anything make it better or worse?
transliteration: yau mou di me wui ling cing fong hou di waak jeh caa di?
translation: 有冇啲咩會令情況好啲或者差啲？

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel unwell during the examination.
transliteration: gim caa kei gaan yu gwo nay gok dak m syu fuk, cing zik hak waa bei ngo zi.
translation: 檢查期間如果你覺得唔舒服，請即刻話畀我知。

english: Did you suddenly develop weakness on one side of your body?
transliteration: nay yau mou dat yin gok dak san tai yat bin mou lik?
translation: 你有冇突然覺得身體一邊冇力？

english: Did one side of your face suddenly droop?
transliteration: nay yau mou dat yin gok dak bun bin min daap zo lok lei?
translation: 你有冇突然覺得半邊面耷咗落嚟？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble speaking?
transliteration: nay yau mou dat yin gong ye yau kun naan?
translation: 你有冇突然講嘢有困難？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble understanding speech?
transliteration: nay yau mou dat yin teng m ming yan dei gong ye?
translation: 你有冇突然聽唔明人哋講嘢？

english: Did you suddenly lose vision in one or both eyes?
transliteration: nay yau mou dat yin yat zek ngaan waak jeh leung zek ngaan dou tai m dou?
translation: 你有冇突然一隻眼或者兩隻眼都睇唔到？

english: Did you suddenly lose your balance or coordination?
transliteration: nay yau mou dat yin sat heung ban waak jeh sau gei m hip tiu?
translation: 你有冇突然失去平衡或者手腳唔協調？

english: What time were you last completely well?
transliteration: nay seung yat chi cyun cyun mou si gei dim?
translation: 你上一次完全冇事係幾點？

english: Did the symptoms go away completely?
transliteration: di zing zong yau mou cyun cyun siu sat?
translation: 啲症狀有冇完全消失？

english: Did you have the worst headache of your life?
transliteration: nay yau mou si gwo tau tung dak hai yat sang yan zeui yim zung?
translation: 你有冇試過頭痛得係一生人最嚴重？

english: Did the headache reach maximum intensity within seconds or a minute?
transliteration: tau tung yau mou hai gei mziu waak jeh yat fan zung noi tung dou zeui ging?
translation: 頭痛有冇喺幾秒或者一分鐘內痛到最勁？

english: Do you have a fever with a stiff neck?
transliteration: nay yau mou faat siu tung ging gang?
translation: 你有冇發燒同頸梗？

english: Have you had a new seizure or lost consciousness?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mou sau chi din gan faat zok waak jeh sat heung zi gok?
translation: 你最近有冇首次癲癇發作或者失去知覺？

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mou dat yin naan yi hung zi siu bin waak jeh dai bin?
translation: 你最近有冇突然難以控制小便或者大便？

english: Do you have numbness around your groin or buttocks?
transliteration: nay syu gan waak jeh cyun bou zau wai yau mou maa bai?
translation: 你鼠蹊或者臀部周圍有冇麻痺？

english: Where exactly is your headache?
transliteration: nay tau tung ge kok zaak wai hai bin dou?
translation: 你頭痛嘅確切位置喺邊度？

english: Is the pain on one side or both sides of your head?
transliteration: nay tau ge yat bin tung, ding hai leung bin dou tung?
translation: 你頭嘅一邊痛，定係兩邊都痛？

english: Does the pain spread to your neck, face, or behind your eyes?
transliteration: tung co yau mou maan yin dou ging, min, waak jeh ngaan wo hau bin?
translation: 痛楚有冇蔓延到頸、面，或者眼窩後面？

english: Is the pain throbbing, pressing, stabbing, or burning?
transliteration: tung co hai yat tiu yat tiu, aat zyu, ci tung, ding hai zok tung?
translation: 痛楚係一跳一跳、壓住、刺痛，定係灼痛？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: yu gwo ling fan hai cyun cyun m tung, sap fan hai zeui tung, nay ge tung yau gei tung?
translation: 如果零分係完全唔痛，十分係最痛，你嘅痛有幾痛？

english: Does light or noise bother you during the headache?
transliteration: tau tung go zan, gwong waak jeh seng wui m wui ling nay gok dak m syu fuk?
translation: 頭痛嗰陣，光或者聲會唔會令你覺得唔舒服？

english: Do you feel nauseated or vomit with the headache?
transliteration: tau tung go zan, nay wui m wui gok dak zok ou waak jeh ou tou?
translation: 頭痛嗰陣，你會唔會覺得作嘔或者嘔吐？

english: Do you see flashing lights or zigzag lines before the headache?
transliteration: tau tung zi cin, nay yau mou gin dou sim gwong waak jeh gei ngaak ying ge sin?
translation: 頭痛之前，你有冇見到閃光或者鋸齒形嘅線？

english: Does physical activity make the headache worse?
transliteration: zou wan dung wui m wui ling tau tung gaa kap?
translation: 做運動會唔會令頭痛加劇？

english: Does coughing, straining, or bending make it worse?
transliteration: hau, yung lik, waak jeh waan dai san, wui m wui ling go tau tung dak gang leoi?
translation: 咳、用力，或者彎低身，會唔會令個頭痛得更犀利？

english: Is the headache worse when lying down or standing up?
transliteration: fan dai waak jeh kei hei san go zan, tau tung wui m wui gang leoi?
translation: 瞓低或者企起身嗰陣，頭痛會唔會更犀利？

english: Does the headache wake you from sleep?
transliteration: tau tung yau mou tung sing nay?
translation: 頭痛有冇痛醒你？

english: Have your headaches changed recently?
transliteration: nay jeui gan di tau tung yau mou bin faa?
translation: 你最近啲頭痛有冇變化？

english: How many days each month do you have a headache?
transliteration: nay mui go yuet yau gei do yat wui tau tung?
translation: 你每個月有幾多日會頭痛？

english: How often do you take painkillers for headaches?
transliteration: nay gei noi sik yat chi zi tung yeuk lei yi tau tung?
translation: 你幾耐食一次止痛藥嚟醫頭痛？

english: Do you feel the room spinning or do you feel faint?
transliteration: nay wui m wui gok dak sing go fong hai dou zyun, waak jeh gok dak wan dai?
translation: 你會唔會覺得成個房喺度轉，或者覺得暈低？

english: Do you feel unsteady when walking?
transliteration: nay haang lou go zan wui m wui gok dak kei m wan?
translation: 你行路嗰陣會唔會覺得企唔穩？

english: Does turning your head trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: zyun tau wui m wui ling nay tau wan?
translation: 轉頭會唔會令你頭暈？

english: Does standing up trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: kei hei san wui m wui ling nay tau wan?
translation: 企起身會唔會令你頭暈？

english: Does the dizziness last seconds, minutes, hours, or longer?
transliteration: tau wan wui ci zuk gei noi? gei mziu, gei fan zung, gei go zung, ding hai gang noi?
translation: 頭暈會持續幾耐？幾秒、幾分鐘、幾個鐘，定係更耐？

english: Do you have ringing in your ears or hearing loss?
transliteration: nay yi zai yau mou yung yung seng, waak jeh teng lik yau mou bin caa?
translation: 你耳仔有冇嗡嗡聲，或者聽力有冇變差？

english: Have you fallen because of the dizziness?
transliteration: nay yau mou si gwo yin wai tau wan dit dai?
translation: 你有冇試過因為頭暈跌低？

english: Can you walk without assistance?
transliteration: nay zi gei haang lou dak m dak, m sai yan fu?
translation: 你自己行路得唔得，唔使人扶？

english: Do you feel weakness in your arms or legs?
transliteration: nay zek sau waak jeh zek goek gok m gok dak mou lik?
translation: 你隻手或者隻腳覺唔覺得冇力？

english: Is one side weaker than the other?
transliteration: yat bin hai mai bei ling yat bin mou lik?
translation: 一邊係咪比另一邊冇力？

english: Do you have trouble lifting your arms above your head?
transliteration: nay yau mou kun naan jeung seung sau giu gwo tau ding?
translation: 你有冇困難將雙手舉過頭頂？

english: Do you have trouble standing up from a chair?
transliteration: nay yau mou kun naan yau jeung yee dou kei hei san?
translation: 你有冇困難由張椅度企起身？

english: Do you trip because your foot drags?
transliteration: nay wui m wui yin wai zek goek tyun zyu haang lei waan can?
translation: 你會唔會因為隻腳拖住行而絆親？

english: Do you drop objects from your hands?
transliteration: nay wui m wui sing yat ling m wan ye, di ye dit lok dei?
translation: 你會唔會成日拎唔穩嘢，啲嘢跌落地？

english: Does the weakness get worse with repeated activity?
transliteration: cung fuk zou ye wui m wui ling mou lik ge cing fong gang caa?
translation: 重複做嘢會唔會令冇力嘅情況更差？

english: Does resting improve the weakness?
transliteration: jau sik zi hau, mou lik ge cing fong wui m wui hou di?
translation: 休息之後，冇力嘅情況會唔會好啲？

english: Have you noticed muscle twitching or cramps?
transliteration: nay yau mou lau yi dou geuk yuk tiu, waak jeh cau gan?
translation: 你有冇留意到肌肉跳，或者抽筋？

english: Have your muscles become smaller over time?
transliteration: nay yau mou gok dak di yuk yuk maan maan bin sai?
translation: 你有冇覺得啲肌肉慢慢變細？

english: Do you have numbness or tingling anywhere?
transliteration: nay san tai yau mou bin dou maa bai waak jeh ci ci dei?
translation: 你身體有冇邊度麻痺或者刺刺哋？

english: Where does the numbness begin and where does it spread?
transliteration: maa bai hai bin dou hoi ci, yau wui jat saan heui bin dou?
translation: 麻痺係由邊度開始，又會擴散去邊度？

english: Is the numbness in both hands or both feet?
transliteration: nay hai mai leung zek sau waak jeh leung zek goek dou maa bai?
translation: 你係咪兩隻手或者兩隻腳都麻痺？

english: Do you feel burning or electric-shock-like pain?
transliteration: nay yau mou zok jit waak jeh hou ciuk dim gam ge tung?
translation: 你有冇灼熱或者好似觸電咁嘅痛？

english: Does the pain travel from your back down your leg?
transliteration: di tung wui m wui yau bui gei yat lou lok dou zek goek?
translation: 啲痛會唔會由背脊一路落到隻腳？

english: Can you feel hot and cold normally?
transliteration: nay ping si fan m fan dak yit tung dung?
translation: 你平時分唔分到熱同凍？

english: Does touching the skin cause unusual pain?
transliteration: dim dou pei fu wui m wui ling nay gok dak yi cheung gam tung?
translation: 掂到皮膚會唔會令你覺得異常咁痛？

english: Have you ever had a seizure or fit?
transliteration: nay yi cin yau mou si gwo din gan faat zok waak jeh cau gan?
translation: 你以前有冇試過癲癇發作或者抽筋？

english: Did anyone see what happened during the episode?
transliteration: faat zok go zan, yau mou yan gin dou faat sang me si?
translation: 發作嗰陣，有冇人見到發生咩事？

english: Did your arms or legs shake uncontrollably?
transliteration: nay zek sau waak jeh zek goek yau mou hung ji m dou gam zaan?
translation: 你隻手或者隻腳有冇控制唔到咁震？

english: Did you lose awareness of your surroundings?
transliteration: nay go zan yau mou m zi dou san bin faat sang gan me si?
translation: 你嗰陣有冇唔知道身邊發生緊咩事？

english: Did you bite your tongue?
transliteration: nay yau mou ngai can tiu lei?
translation: 你有冇咬親條脷？

english: Did you lose control of your bladder?
transliteration: nay yau mou sat gan, hung zi m dou siu bin?
translation: 你有冇失禁，控制唔到小便？

english: Were you confused or sleepy afterward?
transliteration: zi hau nay yau mou gok dak mai mai fu fu, waak jeh hou ngaan fan?
translation: 之後你有冇覺得迷迷糊糊，或者好眼瞓？

english: Did you notice a strange smell, feeling, or warning before the episode?
transliteration: faat zok zi cin, nay yau mou man dou gei gwaai ge hei mei, gok dak gei gwaai, waak jeh yau di jiuziu?
translation: 發作之前，你有冇聞到奇怪嘅氣味、覺得奇怪，或者有啲預兆？

english: How long did it take to return to normal?
transliteration: nay gwo zo gei noi sin zi wui fuk jing seung?
translation: 你過咗幾耐先至恢復正常？

english: Have you missed any doses of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: nay yau mou lou sik gwo din gan yeuk?
translation: 你有冇漏食過癲癇藥？

english: Do your hands shake when resting or when using them?
transliteration: nay deoi sau hai jau sik go zan, waak jeh yung gan go zan wui m wui zaan?
translation: 你對手喺休息嗰陣，或者用緊嗰陣會唔會震？

english: Does the shaking affect one hand or both?
transliteration: zaan hai ying heung yat zek sau ding leung zek sau?
translation: 震係影響一隻手定兩隻手？

english: Has your handwriting become smaller?
transliteration: nay se zou yau mou bin dak sai zo?
translation: 你寫字有冇變得細咗？

english: Do you feel stiff or move more slowly?
transliteration: nay yau mou gok dak san tai ging ngaang, waak jeh yuk dak maan zo?
translation: 你有冇覺得身體僵硬，或者郁得慢咗？

english: Have you had difficulty starting to walk?
transliteration: nay yau mou si gwo hei bou haang lou yau kun naan?
translation: 你有冇試過起步行路有困難？

english: Do you freeze or feel stuck while walking?
transliteration: nay haang lou go zan wui m wui dat yin haang m yung, hou ci ka zyu gam?
translation: 你行路嗰陣會唔會突然行唔郁，好似卡住咁？

english: Have you noticed changes in your voice or facial expression?
transliteration: nay yau mou lau yi dou seng sin waak jeh min bou biu cing yau bin?
translation: 你有冇留意到聲線或者面部表情有變？

english: Have you been forgetting recent conversations or appointments?
transliteration: nay yau mou sing yat m gei dak jeui gan teng gwo ge git, waak jeh yue hou zo ge si?
translation: 你有冇成日唔記得最近傾過嘅偈，或者約好咗嘅事？

english: Do you have trouble finding the right words?
transliteration: nay yau mou si gwo wan m dou am ge zi ngaan?
translation: 你有冇試過搵唔到啱嘅字眼？

english: Have you become lost in familiar places?
transliteration: nay yau mou hai suk sik ge dei fong mai lou?
translation: 你有冇喺熟悉嘅地方迷路？

english: Do you have difficulty managing medicines or finances?
transliteration: nay yau mou kun naan gwaan lei yeuk mat waak jeh coi mou?
translation: 你有冇困難管理藥物或者財務？

english: Have you noticed changes in your mood or behaviour?
transliteration: nay yau mou lau yi dou cing seoi waak jeh hang wai yau bin?
translation: 你有冇留意到情緒或者行為有變？

english: Do you have trouble concentrating?
transliteration: nay yau mou zaap zung m dou zing san?
translation: 你有冇集中唔到精神？

english: Has your speech become slurred?
transliteration: nay gong ye yau mou bin dak hau ci m cing?
translation: 你講嘢有冇變得口齒唔清？

english: Do you have trouble swallowing food or liquids?
transliteration: nay tun ye waak jeh yam ye yau mou kun naan?
translation: 你吞嘢或者飲嘢有冇困難？

english: Do you see double?
transliteration: nay yau mou tai ye zung ying?
translation: 你有冇睇嘢重影？

english: Does the double vision go away when you cover one eye?
transliteration: ze dang yat zek ngaan zi hau, zung ying wui m wui siu sat?
translation: 遮住一隻眼之後，重影會唔會消失？

english: Have you noticed a drooping eyelid?
transliteration: nay yau mou lau yi dou ngaan pei daap dai zo?
translation: 你有冇留意到眼皮耷低咗？

english: Do you have numbness or pain in your face?
transliteration: nay faai min yau mou maa bai waak jeh tung?
translation: 你塊面有冇麻痺或者痛？

english: Have you noticed weakness on one side of your face?
transliteration: nay yau mou lau yi dou faai min yat bin mou lik?
translation: 你有冇留意到塊面一邊冇力？

english: Have you noticed changes in your hearing?
transliteration: nay yau mou lau yi dou teng lik yau bin?
translation: 你有冇留意到聽力有變？

english: Do you choke or cough when swallowing?
transliteration: nay tun ye go zan wui m wui gang can waak jeh haak?
translation: 你吞嘢嗰陣會唔會哽親或者咳？

english: Have you ever had a stroke or a mini-stroke?
transliteration: nay yi cin yau mou zung fung, waak jeh si gwo siu zung fung?
translation: 你以前有冇中風，或者試過小中風？

english: Have you ever had a head injury or concussion?
transliteration: nay yi cin yau mou zing can go tau, waak jeh nou zing dung?
translation: 你以前有冇整親個頭，或者腦震盪？

english: Have you ever had meningitis or a brain infection?
transliteration: nay yi cin yau mou waan gwo nou mok yin waak jeh nou bou gam jim?
translation: 你以前有冇患過腦膜炎或者腦部感染？

english: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol?
transliteration: nay yau mou tong niu beng, gou yat aat, waak jeh daam gwat zung?
translation: 你有冇糖尿病、高血壓，或者膽固醇高？

english: Does anyone in your family have migraines, seizures, or a neurological condition?
transliteration: nay uk kei yan yau mou yan yau pin tau tung, din gan, waak jeh san ging hai tung?
translation: 你屋企人有冇人有偏頭痛、癲癇，或者神經系統嘅病？

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: nay ping si yau sik di me yeuk?
translation: 你平時有食啲咩藥？

english: What is the name and dose of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: nay sik go zek din gan yeuk giu me meng? mui chi sik gei do?
translation: 你食嗰隻癲癇藥叫咩名？每次食幾多？

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: nay sik ni zek yeuk sik zo gei noi?
translation: 你食呢隻藥食咗幾耐？

english: Have you recently started, stopped, or changed a medicine?
transliteration: nay jeui gan yau mou hoi ci sik, ting sik, waak jeh zyun zo yat zek yeuk?
translation: 你最近有冇開始食、停食，或者轉咗一隻藥？

english: Has this medicine helped your symptoms?
transliteration: ni zek yeuk yau mou bong dou nay di zing zong?
translation: 呢隻藥有冇幫到你啲症狀？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: nay yau mou lau yi dou yau me fu zok yung?
translation: 你有冇留意到有咩副作用？

english: Do you drink alcohol or use recreational drugs?
transliteration: nay yau mou yam jau waak jeh yung siu haan yeuk mat?
translation: 你有冇飲酒或者用消遣性藥物？

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: nay ho m ho yi waa ngo zi nay ge cyun meng?
translation: 你可唔可以話我知你嘅全名？

english: Can you tell me today's date?
transliteration: nay ho m ho yi waa ngo zi gam yat hai gei yuet gei hou?
translation: 你可唔可以話我知今日係幾月幾號？

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: nay ho m ho yi waa ngo zi ngo dei yi gaa hai bin dou?
translation: 你可唔可以話我知我哋而家喺邊度？

english: Please repeat these three words after me.
transliteration: cing gan zeu ngo cung fuk gong ni saam go zi.
translation: 請跟住我重複講呢三個字。

english: Please remember these words; I will ask you again later.
transliteration: cing gei zyu ni gei go zi, ngo ciu di wui joi man nay.
translation: 請記住呢幾個字，我遲啲會再問你。

english: Please name this object.
transliteration: cing gong ceut ni gin mat gin ge meng cing.
translation: 請講出呢件物件嘅名稱。

english: Please follow this two-step instruction.
transliteration: cing gan zeu ni go fan leung bou zou ge zi si zou.
translation: 請跟住呢個分兩步做嘅指示做。

english: Please read this sentence aloud.
transliteration: cing daai seng duk ceut ni geoi geoi.
translation: 請大聲讀出呢句句子。

english: Please write a complete sentence.
transliteration: cing se yat geoi cyun zing ge geoi zi.
translation: 請寫一句完整嘅句子。

english: Please copy this drawing.
transliteration: cing ziu zyu ni fu tou waa yat bin.
translation: 請照住呢幅圖畫一遍。

english: I am going to check your eye movements and facial muscles.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui gim caa nay deoi ngaan ge yuk dung tung min bou gei yuk.
translation: 我而家會檢查你對眼嘅郁動同面部肌肉。

english: Please look straight ahead.
transliteration: cing mong zyu cin min.
translation: 請望住前面。

english: Follow my finger with your eyes without moving your head.
transliteration: tau m hou yuk, yung ngaan gan zyu ngo zek sau zi yuk.
translation: 頭唔好郁，用眼跟住我隻手指郁。

english: Please cover one eye.
transliteration: cing ze dang yat zek ngaan.
translation: 請遮住一隻眼。

english: Tell me when you can see my moving finger.
transliteration: ngo zek sau zi yuk gan go zan, nay tai dou ge si waa ngo zi.
translation: 我隻手指郁緊嗰陣，你睇到嘅時候話我知。

english: I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui yung dang ziu yap nay zek ngaan.
translation: 我而家會用燈照入你隻眼。

english: Please raise your eyebrows.
transliteration: cing ning gou mei mou.
translation: 請擰高眉毛。

english: Please close your eyes tightly.
transliteration: cing yung lik hap maai ngaan.
translation: 請用力合埋眼。

english: Please smile and show your teeth.
transliteration: cing siu yat siu, lou ceut di nga.
translation: 請笑一笑，露出啲牙。

english: Please puff out your cheeks.
transliteration: cing gu hei leung bin min jyu.
translation: 請鼓起兩邊面珠。

english: Does this feel the same on both sides of your face?
transliteration: nay faai min leung bin ge gam gok hai mai yat yeung?
translation: 你塊面兩邊嘅感覺係咪一樣？

english: Please open your mouth and say ah.
transliteration: cing jeung hoi hau, gong aa.
translation: 請張開口，講「啊」。

english: Please stick out your tongue.
transliteration: cing san ceut tiu lei.
translation: 請伸出條脷。

english: Please shrug your shoulders against my hands.
transliteration: cing ding zyu ngo seung sau, sung gou bok tau.
translation: 請頂住我雙手，聳高膊頭。

english: Please turn your head against my hand.
transliteration: cing ding zyu ngo zek sau zyun tau.
translation: 請頂住我隻手轉頭。

english: Please hold both arms straight out in front of you.
transliteration: CHING nei SEUNG sau heung CHIN sing JIK
translation: 請你雙手向前伸直。

english: Turn your palms upward and close your eyes.
transliteration: sau jeung heung SEUNG, gan JYU BAI maai ngaan
translation: 手掌向上，跟住閉埋眼。

english: Please squeeze my fingers.
transliteration: CHING nei ngak GAN ngo ge sau ji
translation: 請你握緊我嘅手指。

english: Please push against my hand.
transliteration: CHING nei YUNG lik teoi JYU ngo JEK sau
translation: 請你用力推住我隻手。

english: Please pull against my hand.
transliteration: CHING nei YUNG lik laai JYU ngo JEK sau
translation: 請你用力拉住我隻手。

english: Please lift your leg off the bed.
transliteration: CHING nei taai HEI JEK GOEK, LEI HOI JEUNG chong
translation: 請你抬起隻腳，離開張床。

english: Please bend your knee.
transliteration: CHING nei WAT kuk SAT tau
translation: 請你屈曲膝頭。

english: Please straighten your knee.
transliteration: CHING nei SING jik SAT tau
translation: 請你伸直膝頭。

english: Please pull your toes up toward your head.
transliteration: CHING nei jeung GOEK ji heung SEUNG kiu, ji heung ji GEI go tau
translation: 請你將腳趾向上翹，指向自己個頭。

english: Please push your foot down like pressing a pedal.
transliteration: CHING nei heung HAA chaai JEK goek, hou chi chaai GOEK jit gam
translation: 請你向下踩隻腳，好似踩腳掣咁。

english: Please relax while I move your arm.
transliteration: ngo yuk nei JEK sau bei GO jeung, CHING nei fong sung
translation: 我郁你隻手臂嗰陣，請你放鬆。

english: Please close your eyes while I check your sensation.
transliteration: ngo bong nei gim CHAAM gam GOK jeung, CHING nei BAI maai ngaan
translation: 我幫你檢查感覺嗰陣，請你閉埋眼。

english: Can you feel me touching you here?
transliteration: ngo HAI ni dou dim nei, nei gam GOK dou maa?
translation: 我喺呢度掂你，你感覺到嗎？

english: Does it feel the same on the left and right?
transliteration: JO bin tung YAU bin ge gam GOK yat YEUNG maa?
translation: 左邊同右邊嘅感覺一樣嗎？

english: Tell me whether this feels sharp or dull.
transliteration: waa ngo ji ni go gam GOK hai JIM ding DEON
translation: 話我知呢個感覺係尖定鈍。

english: Tell me whether this feels warm or cold.
transliteration: waa ngo ji ni go gam GOK hai nyun ding GUNG
translation: 話我知呢個感覺係暖定凍。

english: Tell me which way I move your finger or toe.
transliteration: waa ngo ji ngo jeung nei JEK sau ji waak ze GOEK ji yuk heung bin go fong heung
translation: 話我知我將你隻手指或者腳趾郁向邊個方向。

english: I am going to tap your knee gently to check your reflexes.
transliteration: ngo wui HING HING haau nei ge SAT tau, gim CHAAM faan SIK
translation: 我會輕輕敲你嘅膝頭，檢查反射。

english: Please let your arm or leg relax.
transliteration: CHING nei fong sung JEK sau bei waak ze JEK GOEK
translation: 請你放鬆隻手臂或者隻腳。

english: Please touch your nose and then my finger.
transliteration: CHING nei mo YAT mo go bei, gan JYU mo ngo JEK sau ji
translation: 請你摸一摸個鼻，跟住摸我隻手指。

english: Please do that again a little faster.
transliteration: CHING nei JOI zou YAT chi, faai SIU SIU
translation: 請你再做一次，快少少。

english: Please tap your hands on your thighs, turning them over quickly.
transliteration: CHING nei YUNG sau jeung HAI daai TUI seung paak DA, faai di FAAN JUEN sau jeung
translation: 請你用手掌喺大髀上拍打，快啲反轉手掌。

english: Please slide your heel down your other shin.
transliteration: CHING nei YUNG GOEK hang YUN JYU ling YAT bin ge siu teoi heung HAA waat
translation: 請你用腳踭沿住另一邊嘅小腿向下滑。

english: Please stand with your feet together.
transliteration: CHING nei SEUNG goek hap maai KEI
translation: 請你雙腳合埋企。

english: Please close your eyes while standing; I will stay beside you.
transliteration: CHING nei KEI HAI dou BAI maai ngaan, ngo wui lau HAI nei san bin
translation: 請你企喺度閉埋眼，我會留喺你身邊。
