english: Please walk across the room and back.
transliteration: CHING nei haang gwo gaan fong, JOI haang faan JUEN tau
translation: 請你行過間房，再行返轉頭。

english: Please walk heel to toe in a straight line.
transliteration: CHING nei GOEK hang TIP JYU GOEK ji, YUN YAT jik sin haang
translation: 請你腳踭貼住腳趾，沿一直線行。

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: CHING nei YUNG GOEK hang haang
translation: 請你用腳踭行。

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: CHING nei YUNG GOEK ji haang
translation: 請你用腳趾行。

english: Please turn around and walk back.
transliteration: CHING nei JUEN san, haang faan JUEN tau
translation: 請你轉身，行返轉頭。

english: We may need a CT scan of your head.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang yiu bong nei jiu tau bou din NO sin
translation: 我哋可能要幫你照頭部電腦掃描（CT）。

english: We may need an MRI scan of your brain or spine.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang yiu bong nei jiu nou bou waak ze gei wui ciu so
translation: 我哋可能要幫你照腦部或者脊椎磁力共振（MRI）。

english: An EEG records the electrical activity of your brain.
transliteration: nou din tou wui gei luk nei go nou ge din wut dung
translation: 腦電圖（EEG）會記錄你個腦嘅電活動。

english: A nerve conduction study checks how your nerves send signals.
transliteration: san ging cyun dou CEST hai gim CHAAM nei ge san ging dim YEUNG cyun sung seon hou
translation: 神經傳導測試會檢查你嘅神經點樣傳送訊號。

english: A lumbar puncture takes a small sample of fluid from your lower back.
transliteration: yiu cyun cyun ci wui HAI nei haa bei cau juk siu leung ye tai joeng bun
translation: 腰椎穿刺會喺你下背抽取少量液體樣本。

english: I will explain the benefits and risks before any procedure.
transliteration: zou anyat sing cin, ngo wui sin tung nei gaai sik hou cyu tung fung him
translation: 做任何程序之前，我會先同你解釋好處同風險。

english: Do you have any questions before we proceed?
transliteration: gai JYU zi cin, nei YAU mou man tai soeng man?
translation: 繼續之前，你有冇問題想問？

english: We will discuss the results and next steps with you.
transliteration: ngo dei wui tung nei tou LUN git gwo tung haa yat bou
translation: 我哋會同你討論結果同下一步。

english: Please take your medicines exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: CHING nei wan cyun on ZIU cyu fong fuk yiu
translation: 請你完全按照處方服藥。

english: Do not stop seizure medicines suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: MEI YAU yi sang gin yi zi cin, M HOU dat yin ting sik kung zi DIN kit ge yiu
translation: 未有醫生建議之前，唔好突然停食控制癲癇嘅藥。

english: Seek emergency care for sudden weakness, trouble speaking, or a severe sudden headache.
transliteration: YUK gwo dat yin sau GOEK mou lik, gong je waai naan, waak ze dat yin gik lik tau tong, CHING lap kok heoi gap zing sat
translation: 如果突然手腳無力、講嘢困難，或者突然劇烈頭痛，請即刻去急症室。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: ngo dei wui bong nei on paai fuk zan
translation: 我哋會幫你安排覆診。

english: What questions do you have for me?
transliteration: nei YAU me man tai soeng man ngo?
translation: 你有咩問題想問我？

english: Hello. I am here to examine your eyes.
transliteration: nei hou, ngo HAI dou bong nei gim CHAAM ngaan ging
translation: 你好，我喺度幫你檢查眼睛。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: gam yat me si LING nei lai tai yi sang?
translation: 今日咩事令你嚟睇醫生？

english: Please sit here.
transliteration: CHING co HAI ni dou
translation: 請坐喺呢度。

english: Which eye is bothering you?
transliteration: bin JEK ngaan M syu fuk?
translation: 邊隻眼唔舒服？

english: Is it one eye or both eyes?
transliteration: hai YAT JEK ngaan ding LOENG JEK ngaan?
translation: 係一隻眼定兩隻眼？

english: When did the problem start?
transliteration: go man tai gei SI hoi ci?
translation: 個問題幾時開始？

english: May I examine your eyes?
transliteration: ngo ho M ho gim CHAAM nei JEK ngaan?
translation: 我可以檢查你隻眼嗎？

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: YUK gwo YAU anyat dou fong tong, CHING waa ngo ji
translation: 如果有任何地方痛，請話我知。

english: How long has this been happening?
transliteration: ni go cing fong juk ZO gei noi?
translation: 呢個情況持續咗幾耐？

english: How many days has this been happening?
transliteration: ni go cing fong juk ZO gei do yat?
translation: 呢個情況持續咗幾多日？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: hai dat yin hoi ci, ding hai maan maan hoi ci?
translation: 係突然開始，定係慢慢開始？

english: Is it constant, or does it come and go?
transliteration: hai YAT jik YAU, ding hai si YAU si mou?
translation: 係一直都有，定係時有時無？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: mui ci faat ZOK wui juk ZO gei noi?
translation: 每次發作會持續幾耐？

english: Does it last seconds, minutes, hours, or days?
transliteration: mui ci wui juk ZO gei miu, gei fan zung, gei go zung, ding hai gei yat?
translation: 每次會持續幾秒、幾分鐘、幾個鐘，定係幾日？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: cing fong YAU mou hou juen, ok faa, ding hai mou bin?
translation: 情況有冇好轉、惡化，定係冇變？

english: Has this happened before?
transliteration: ji cin YAU mou SI gwo gam?
translation: 以前有冇試過咁？

english: Did you wake up with this problem?
transliteration: nei fan SING go zan YI ging YAU ni go man tai maa?
translation: 你瞓醒嗰陣已經有呢個問題嗎？

english: Did it start after an injury or procedure?
transliteration: hai M hai sau soeng waak ze zou jyut sau seot zi hau hoi ci?
translation: 係咪受傷或者做完手術之後開始？

english: Has your vision changed?
transliteration: nei ge si lik YAU mou goi bin?
translation: 你嘅視力有冇改變？

english: Is your vision blurry?
transliteration: nei tai ye M M?
translation: 你睇嘢矇唔矇？

english: Did you suddenly lose vision?
transliteration: nei YAU mou dat yin tai M dou ye?
translation: 你有冇突然睇唔到嘢？

english: Did your vision return to normal?
transliteration: nei ge si lik YAU mou wui fuk zing seung?
translation: 你嘅視力有冇恢復正常？

english: Is your vision loss complete or partial?
transliteration: nei hai wan cyun tai M dou, ding hai bou fan tai M dou?
translation: 你係完全睇唔到，定係部分睇唔到？

english: Is the centre of your vision affected?
transliteration: nei zing zung gaan ge si yeh YAU mou sau jing hoeng?
translation: 你正中間嘅視野有冇受影響？

english: Is your side vision affected?
transliteration: nei ze bin ge si yeh YAU mou sau jing hoeng?
translation: 你側邊嘅視野有冇受影響？

english: Is the top or bottom part of your vision missing?
transliteration: nei tai ye ge seung min waak ze haa min YAU mou YAT bou fan tai M dou?
translation: 你睇嘢嘅上面或者下面有冇一部分睇唔到？

english: Do you see flashes of light?
transliteration: nei YAU mou gin dou sim gwong?
translation: 你有冇見到閃光？

english: Do you see new floating spots or cobwebs?
transliteration: nei YAU mou gin dou san ceot yin ge fau dim waak ze ci ZI zyu mong ge ying?
translation: 你有冇見到新出現嘅浮點或者似蜘蛛網嘅影？

english: Do you see a curtain or shadow over your vision?
transliteration: nei YAU mou gok dak YAU fuk lim waak ze yam jing ze mong zyu si sin?
translation: 你有冇覺得有幅簾或者陰影遮住視線？

english: Do straight lines look bent or wavy?
transliteration: zik sin tai lok wui M wui waan ZO waak ze bo long gam?
translation: 直線睇落會唔會彎咗或者波浪咁？

english: Do you see two images of one object?
transliteration: nei wui M wui gin dou tung yat YEUNG ye YAU loeng go ying zoeng?
translation: 你會唔會見到同一樣嘢有兩個影像？

english: Does the double vision go away when you close either eye?
transliteration: nei hap maai anyat JEK ngaan, cung ying wui M wui siu sat?
translation: 你合埋任何一隻眼，重影會唔會消失？

english: Do you see halos around lights?
transliteration: nei YAU mou gin dou dang gwong zyu wai YAU gwong gyun?
translation: 你有冇見到燈光周圍有光圈？

english: Is it harder to see at night?
transliteration: nei ye maan hai M hai bei gaau naan tai ye?
translation: 你夜晚係咪比較難睇嘢？

english: Does bright light bother your eyes?
transliteration: koeng gwong wui M wui ling nei JEK ngaan M syu fuk?
translation: 強光會唔會令你隻眼唔舒服？

english: Do your eyes hurt?
transliteration: nei JEK ngaan tong M tong?
translation: 你隻眼痛唔痛？

english: Where exactly does it hurt? Please point.
transliteration: kok sat hai bin dou tong? CHING nei ji YAT ji
translation: 確實係邊度痛？請你指一指。

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: YUK gwo ling fan hai M tong, sap fan hai zeoi tong, nei ge tong YAU gei tong?
translation: 如果零分係唔痛，十分係最痛，你嘅痛有幾痛？

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, or burning?
transliteration: go tong hai ci tong, DEON tong, ding hai zoek tong?
translation: 個痛係刺痛、鈍痛，定係灼痛？

english: Does the pain worsen when you move your eyes?
transliteration: yuk ngaan kau go zan, tong wui M wui gaap geoi?
translation: 郁眼球嗰陣，痛會唔會加劇？

english: Do you have a headache or nausea?
transliteration: nei YAU mou tau tong waak ze zok ngau?
translation: 你有冇頭痛或者作嘔？

english: Are your eyes red?
transliteration: nei JEK ngaan hung M hung?
translation: 你隻眼紅唔紅？

english: Do your eyes itch?
transliteration: nei JEK ngaan han M han?
translation: 你隻眼痕唔痕？

english: Do your eyes feel dry or gritty?
transliteration: nei JEK ngaan gok dak gon, waak ze hou ci YAU sa jap ZO ngaan gam maa?
translation: 你隻眼覺得乾，或者好似有沙入咗眼咁嗎？

english: Are your eyes watering?
transliteration: nei JEK ngaan YAU mou lau ngaan seoi?
translation: 你隻眼有冇流眼水？

english: Is there sticky discharge or pus?
transliteration: YAU mou nim nim ge fan mat waak ze nong?
translation: 有冇黏黏嘅分泌物或者膿？

english: Are your eyelids swollen or drooping?
transliteration: nei ngaan pei YAU mou zung waak ze dap dai?
translation: 你眼皮有冇腫或者耷低？

english: Do you have pain around, above, or below the eye?
transliteration: nei ngaan ging zyu wai, seung min waak ze haa min YAU mou tong?
translation: 你眼睛周圍、上面或者下面有冇痛？

english: Did anything hit or scratch your eye?
transliteration: YAU mou ye zong dou waak ze gwaa soeng nei JEK ngaan?
translation: 有冇嘢撞到或者刮傷你隻眼？

english: Did something get into your eye?
transliteration: YAU mou ye jap ZO nei JEK ngaan?
translation: 有冇嘢入咗你隻眼？

english: Did any chemical splash into your eye?
transliteration: YAU mou faa hok ban jit jap nei JEK ngaan?
translation: 有冇化學品濺入你隻眼？

english: Have you rinsed your eye with water?
transliteration: nei YAU mou YUNG seoi cau sai JEK ngaan?
translation: 你有冇用水沖洗隻眼？

english: Do you wear contact lenses?
transliteration: nei YAU mou daai jan ging ngaan ging?
translation: 你有冇戴隱形眼鏡？

english: Do you sleep while wearing contact lenses?
transliteration: nei daai zyu jan ging ngaan ging fan gaau maa?
translation: 你戴住隱形眼鏡瞓覺嗎？

english: When did you last wear your contact lenses?
transliteration: nei soeng yat ci daai jan ging ngaan ging hai gei SI?
translation: 你上次戴隱形眼鏡係幾時？

english: Do you swim or shower with contact lenses in?
transliteration: nei daai zyu jan ging ngaan ging yau seoi waak ze cau leung maa?
translation: 你戴住隱形眼鏡游水或者沖涼嗎？

english: Have you recently started any new eye drops?
transliteration: nei zeoi gan YAU mou hoi ci YUNG san ge ngaan yiu seoi?
translation: 你最近有冇開始用新嘅眼藥水？

english: Do you wear glasses?
transliteration: nei YAU mou daai ngaan geng?
translation: 你有冇戴眼鏡？

english: Have you recently changed your glasses prescription?
transliteration: nei zeoi gan YAU mou wuun gwo ngaan geng dou sou?
translation: 你最近有冇換過眼鏡度數？

english: Have you had eye surgery or laser treatment?
transliteration: nei YAU mou zou gwo ngaan bou sau seot waak ze gaa gwong zi liu?
translation: 你有冇做過眼部手術或者激光治療？

english: Have you ever had this eye condition before?
transliteration: nei ji cin YAU mou SI gwo YAU ni zung ngaan beng?
translation: 你以前有冇試過有呢種眼病？

english: Have you been told you have glaucoma (kala motia)?
transliteration: YAU mou yi sang waa nei YAU cing gwong ngaan (kala motia)?
translation: 有冇醫生話你有青光眼（kala motia）？

english: Have you been told you have cataracts (chitta motia)?
transliteration: YAU mou yi sang waa nei YAU baak noi zoeng (chitta motia)?
translation: 有冇醫生話你有白內障（chitta motia）？

english: Does anyone in your family have glaucoma?
transliteration: nei uk kei yan YAU mou yan YAU cing gwong ngaan?
translation: 你屋企人有冇人有青光眼？

english: Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
transliteration: nei YAU mou tong ni beng waak ze gou hyut aat?
translation: 你有冇糖尿病或者高血壓？

english: What medications or eye drops do you use?
transliteration: nei YUNG gan di me yiu waak ze ngaan yiu seoi?
translation: 你用緊啲咩藥或者眼藥水？

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
transliteration: nei deoi anyat zung yiu mat YAU mou min gam?
translation: 你對任何藥物有冇敏感？

english: When was your last eye examination?
transliteration: nei seung YAT ci YIM ngaan hai gei SI?
translation: 你上一次驗眼係幾時？

english: Please show me which eye.
transliteration: CHING nei ji bei ngo tai hai bin JEK ngaan
translation: 請你指畀我睇係邊隻眼。

english: Look here.
transliteration: mong ni dou
translation: 望呢度。

english: Look straight ahead.
transliteration: mong zing cin min
translation: 望正前面。

english: Open your eyes.
transliteration: CHING zoeng hoi ngaan
translation: 請張開眼。

english: Close your eyes.
transliteration: CHING BAI maai ngaan
translation: 請閉埋眼。

english: Keep both eyes open.
transliteration: loeng JEK ngaan dou zoeng hoi
translation: 兩隻眼都張開。

english: Put your glasses on.
transliteration: CHING daai seung ngaan geng
translation: 請戴上眼鏡。

english: Please remove your glasses.
transliteration: CHING zeoi dai ngaan geng
translation: 請除低眼鏡。

english: Cover your left eye.
transliteration: zeoi zyu JO ngaan
translation: 遮住左眼。

english: Cover your right eye.
transliteration: zeoi zyu YAU ngaan
translation: 遮住右眼。

english: Read the smallest line you can see.
transliteration: CHING duk ceot nei tai dou zeoi sai go hong ji
translation: 請讀出你睇到最細嗰行字。

english: Look through this small hole.
transliteration: tau gwo ni go sai lung mong ceot heoi
translation: 透過呢個細窿望出去。

english: How many fingers do you see?
transliteration: nei gin dou gei do JEK sau ji?
translation: 你見到幾多隻手指？

english: Can you see my hand moving?
transliteration: nei gin M gin dou ngo JEK sau yuk gan?
translation: 你見唔見到我隻手郁緊？

english: Can you see the light?
transliteration: nei gin M gin dou dang dang?
translation: 你見唔見到盞燈？

english: I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui YUNG dang gwong nei JEK ngaan
translation: 我而家會用燈照你隻眼。

english: Please look at the wall behind me.
transliteration: CHING mong zyu ngo hau min fuk coeng
translation: 請望住我後面幅牆。

english: Do not look directly at the light.
transliteration: M HOU zik zip mong zyu dang dang
translation: 唔好直接望住盞燈。

english: Look at my finger without moving your head.
transliteration: M HOU yuk go tau, mong zyu ngo JEK sau ji
translation: 唔好郁個頭，望住我隻手指。

english: Look up.
transliteration: heung SEUNG mong
translation: 向上望。

english: Look down.
transliteration: heung HAA mong
translation: 向下望。

english: Look left.
transliteration: heung JO mong
translation: 向左望。

english: Look right.
transliteration: heung YAU mong
translation: 向右望。

english: Is the double vision worse in this direction?
transliteration: heung ni go fong heung mong, cung ying wui M wui gang gaaai jim zung?
translation: 向呢個方向望，重影會唔會更加嚴重？

english: Raise your eyebrows.
transliteration: CHING yeung hei mei maau
translation: 請揚起眉毛。

english: Keep looking at my nose, not my hand.
transliteration: mong zyu ngo go bei, M HOU mong ngo JEK sau
translation: 望住我個鼻，唔好望我隻手。

english: Raise your hand when you see my fingers.
transliteration: gin dou ngo di sau ji zau giu sau
translation: 見到我啲手指就舉手。

english: Tell me when you see the light.
transliteration: gin dou dang dang zau waa ngo ji
translation: 見到盞燈就話我知。

english: Do you see the same on both sides?
transliteration: JO YAU loeng bin gin dou ge ye YAT M yat yeung?
translation: 左右兩邊見到嘅嘢一唔一樣？

english: I am going to check the pressure in your eye.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui gim CHAAM nei JEK ngaan ge aat lik
translation: 我而家會檢查你隻眼嘅壓力。

english: You may feel a light touch on your eye.
transliteration: nei JEK ngaan ho nang wui gam dou hing hing dim YAT dim
translation: 你隻眼可能會感覺到輕輕掂一掂。

english: Please keep still and try not to blink.
transliteration: CHING bou ci M HOU yuk, zeoi leung M HOU zaap ngaan
translation: 請保持唔好郁，盡量唔好眨眼。

english: Place your chin here and your forehead against the bar.
transliteration: CHING jeung haa baai fong HAI ni dou, ngo tau TIP zyu tiu waang laang
translation: 請將下巴放喺呢度，額頭貼住條橫桿。

english: Open your eyes wide.
transliteration: CHING zeoi leung zoeng daai JEK ngaan
translation: 請盡量張大隻眼。

english: Please do not pull your head back.
transliteration: CHING M HOU suk hau go tau
translation: 請唔好縮後個頭。

english: The light will be bright.
transliteration: dang dang wui hou gwong
translation: 盞燈會好光。

english: I am going to touch your eyelid.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui dim YAT dim nei ge ngaan pei
translation: 我而家會掂一掂你嘅眼皮。

english: Look at my ear.
transliteration: mong zyu ngo JEK ji
translation: 望住我隻耳。

english: I am going to put drops in your eyes.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui HAI nei loeng JEK ngaan dik ngaan yiu seoi
translation: 我而家會喺你兩隻眼滴眼藥水。

english: These drops will numb your eye and may sting briefly.
transliteration: ni di ngaan yiu seoi wui ling nei JEK ngaan maa bei, ho nang wui dyun zaam ci tong
translation: 呢啲眼藥水會令你隻眼麻痺，可能會短暫刺痛。

english: These drops will make your pupils bigger.
transliteration: ni di ngaan yiu seoi wui ling nei ge tung kong fong daai
translation: 呢啲眼藥水會令你嘅瞳孔放大。

english: Your vision may be blurry for several hours.
transliteration: nei ge si lik ho nang wui mo wu gei go zung
translation: 你嘅視力可能會模糊幾個鐘。

english: Bright light may bother you after the drops.
transliteration: dik yin ngaan yiu seoi zi hau, koeng gwong ho nang wui ling nei gok dak M syu fuk
translation: 滴完眼藥水之後，強光可能會令你覺得唔舒服。

english: Please do not rub your eyes.
transliteration: CHING M HOU chaak ngaan
translation: 請唔好捽眼。

english: Please remove your contact lenses.
transliteration: CHING zeoi dai jan ging ngaan ging
translation: 請除低隱形眼鏡。

english: We are going to take photographs of the back of your eye.
transliteration: ngo dei wui ying dai nei ngaan dai ge soeng
translation: 我哋會影低你眼底嘅相。

english: We are going to do a scan of the back of your eye.
transliteration: ngo dei wui saau miu nei ngaan dai
translation: 我哋會掃描你眼底。

english: Have you had an eye ultrasound before?
transliteration: nei ji cin YAU mou zou gwo ngaan bou siu sing bo gim CHAAM?
translation: 你以前有冇做過眼部超聲波檢查？

english: Have you had an MRI scan of your eyes or head?
transliteration: nei YAU mou zou gwo ngaan bou waak ze tau bou ge maa lik kung zan sou miu?
translation: 你有冇做過眼部或者頭部嘅磁力共振掃描？

english: You will lie still inside a noisy scanner.
transliteration: nei yiu HAI YAT bou caau naau ge saau miu hei yap mein dai, kei gaan yiu bou ci M HOU yuk
translation: 你要喺一部嘈吵嘅掃描器入面躺低，期間要保持唔好郁。

english: Please follow the light with your eyes.
transliteration: CHING YUNG ngaan gan zyu dang dang
translation: 請用眼跟住盞燈。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: gim CHAAM zou jyut la, do ze nei
translation: 檢查做完喇，多謝你。

english: We need to arrange an appointment with an eye specialist.
transliteration: ngo dei yiu on paai nei heoi tai ngaan fo zyun fo yi sang
translation: 我哋要安排你去睇眼科專科醫生。

english: I need to discuss your examination with another doctor.
transliteration: ngo seoi yiu tung ling YAT wai yi sang soeng LEON nei ge gim CHAAM git gwo
translation: 我需要同另一位醫生商量你嘅檢查結果。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to explain your results.
transliteration: ngo dei wui wan zyun yip cyun jik jyun heung nei gaai sik gim CHAAM git gwo
translation: 我哋會搵專業傳譯員向你解釋檢查結果。

english: If your vision suddenly worsens, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: YUK gwo nei ge si lik dat yin bin chaai, CHING lap kok kau yi
translation: 如果你嘅視力突然變差，請即刻求醫。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: nei YAU mou man tai soeng man?
translation: 你有冇問題想問？

english: Hello, I am here to examine your ears, nose and throat.
transliteration: nei hou, ngo yi gaa wui gim CHAAM nei ge yi, bei tung hau leng
translation: 你好，我而家會檢查你嘅耳、鼻同喉嚨。

english: What problem brought you here today?
transliteration: nei gam yat YAU me man tai yiu lai tai yi sang?
translation: 你今日有咩問題要嚟睇醫生？

english: Please point to where you feel the problem.
transliteration: M goi ji YAT ji nei gok dak YAU man tai ge wai zi
translation: 唔該指一指你覺得有問題嘅位置。

english: Is it on the right, left, or both sides?
transliteration: hai YAU bin, JO bin, ding hai loeng bin dou YAU?
translation: 係右邊、左邊，定係兩邊都有？

english: When did this start?
transliteration: ni go man tai gei SI hoi ci?
translation: 呢個問題幾時開始？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: hai dat yin hoi ci, ding hai maan maan hoi ci?
translation: 係突然開始，定係慢慢開始？

english: How long has it been happening: hours, days, weeks, or months?
transliteration: ni go cing fong juk ZO gei noi? gei go zung, gei yat, gei go sing kei, ding gei go jyut?
translation: 呢個情況持續咗幾耐？幾個鐘、幾日、幾個星期，定幾個月？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: cing fong YAU mou hou juen, ok faa, ding hai mou bin?
translation: 情況有冇好轉、惡化，定係冇變？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: nei ji cin YAU mou SI gwo ni go man tai?
translation: 你以前有冇試過呢個問題？

english: Are you having trouble breathing or swallowing your saliva?
transliteration: nei YAU mou fu kap kun naan, waak ze tun hau seoi YAU kun naan?
translation: 你有冇呼吸困難，或者吞口水有困難？

english: Are you having trouble hearing?
transliteration: nei YAU mou teng lik kun naan?
translation: 你有冇聽力困難？

english: Which ear is affected?
transliteration: bin JEK yi YAU man tai?
translation: 邊隻耳有問題？

english: Did your hearing change suddenly?
transliteration: nei ge teng lik YAU mou dat yin goi bin?
translation: 你嘅聽力有冇突然改變？

english: When was your hearing last normal?
transliteration: nei seung YAT ci teng lik zing seung hai gei SI?
translation: 你上一次聽力正常係幾時？

english: Is your hearing loss constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: nei ge teng lik man tai hai YAT jik YAU, ding hai si hou si waai?
translation: 你嘅聽力問題係一直都有，定係時好時壞？

english: Do you have trouble understanding speech, especially in noisy places?
transliteration: nei teng yan gong ye YAU mou kun naan, dak kei HAI caau ge dei fong?
translation: 你聽人講嘢有冇困難，尤其喺嘈嘅地方？

english: Do you use hearing aids?
transliteration: nei YAU mou daai zo ting hei?
translation: 你有冇戴助聽器？

english: Have you had a hearing test before?
transliteration: nei ji cin YAU mou zou gwo teng lik CEST?
translation: 你以前有冇做過聽力測試？

english: Have you been exposed to loud noise recently or at work?
transliteration: nei zeoi gan waak ze faan GUNG go zan, YAU mou zip zuk gwo hou caau ge sing yam?
translation: 你最近或者返工嗰陣，有冇接觸過好嘈嘅聲音？

english: Do you hear ringing, buzzing, or other sounds in your ears?
transliteration: nei YAU mou teng dou yi zai yap min YAU yung yung sing, ling sing waak ze kei taa sing yam?
translation: 你有冇聽到耳仔入面有嗡嗡聲、鈴聲或者其他聲音？

english: Is the sound in one ear or both ears?
transliteration: JEK yi YAU sing, hai YAT bin ding loeng bin dou YAU?
translation: 隻耳有聲，係一邊定兩邊都有？

english: Is the sound constant or intermittent?
transliteration: go zung sing hai YAT jik YAU, ding hai gaan zung sin YAU?
translation: 嗰種聲係一直都有，定係間中先有？

english: Does the sound beat in time with your heartbeat?
transliteration: go zung sing YAU mou gan zyu nei sam tiu ge zit zau?
translation: 嗰種聲有冇跟住你心跳嘅節奏？

english: Does the sound affect your sleep or daily activities?
transliteration: go zung sing YAU mou ying hoeng nei fan gaau waak ze yat seung sing wut?
translation: 嗰種聲有冇影響你瞓覺或者日常生活？

english: Does your ear feel blocked or under pressure?
transliteration: nei JEK yi YAU mou sak zyu waak ze YAU aat zyu ge gam gok?
translation: 你隻耳有冇塞住或者有壓住嘅感覺？

english: Does swallowing or yawning change the pressure?
transliteration: tun ye waak ze daa haai han wui M wui ling aat zyu ge gam gok YAU bin faa?
translation: 吞嘢或者打呵欠會唔會令壓住嘅感覺有變化？

english: Do you have ear pain?
transliteration: nei JEK yi tong M tong?
translation: 你隻耳痛唔痛？

english: Does it hurt when you touch or pull your outer ear?
transliteration: nei dim waak ze laai ngoi yi go zan wui M wui tong?
translation: 你掂或者拉外耳嗰陣會唔會痛？

english: Is fluid or pus coming out of your ear?
transliteration: nei JEK yi YAU mou lau ceot jik tai waak ze nong?
translation: 你隻耳有冇流出液體或者膿？

english: What colour is the discharge?
transliteration: lau ceot loi ge ye hai me se sik?
translation: 流出嚟嘅嘢係咩顏色？

english: Have you noticed blood coming from your ear?
transliteration: nei YAU mou lau yi dou JEK yi YAU lau hyut?
translation: 你有冇留意到隻耳有流血？

english: Do you have fever or swelling behind your ear?
transliteration: nei YAU mou faat siu, waak ze yi zai hau min zung?
translation: 你有冇發燒，或者耳仔後面腫？

english: Have you recently been swimming or gotten water in your ear?
transliteration: nei jeui gan yau mou yow sue, waak je yau sue yap jo yee?
translation: 你最近有冇游水，或者有水入咗耳？

english: Do you use cotton swabs to clean your ears?
transliteration: nei yau mou yong meen faa baang ching je yee jai?
translation: 你有冇用棉花棒清潔耳仔？

english: Did anything get stuck in your ear?
transliteration: yau mou ye sai jo hai nei jek yee yap meen?
translation: 有冇嘢塞咗喺你隻耳入面？

english: Have you had an injury or blow to your ear or head?
transliteration: nei jek yee waak je go tau jeui gan yau mou sau seung waak je jong chan?
translation: 你隻耳或者個頭最近有冇受傷或者撞親？

english: Do you feel dizzy or unsteady?
transliteration: nei yau mou tau yun waak je kei m bat wan?
translation: 你有冇頭暈或者企唔穩？

english: Does it feel as though you or the room is spinning?
transliteration: nei yau mou gok dak ji gei waak je gaan fong hai do juen?
translation: 你有冇覺得自己或者間房喺度轉？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: mooi chi faat jok wui chi juk gei noi?
translation: 每次發作會持續幾耐？

english: Does turning your head or rolling over in bed trigger it?
transliteration: juen tau waak je hai chong seung faan san wui m wui yan hei tau yun?
translation: 轉頭或者喺床上反身會唔會引起頭暈？

english: Do you have nausea or vomiting with the dizziness?
transliteration: tau yun go jan wui m wui seung ou waak je ou tou?
translation: 頭暈嗰陣會唔會想嘔或者嘔吐？

english: Do you also notice hearing loss, ringing, or ear fullness?
transliteration: nei yau mou tung si gok dak ting lik bin cha, yee ming waak je yee jai sai jyu?
translation: 你有冇同時覺得聽力變差、耳鳴或者耳仔塞住？

english: Have you fainted, had weakness, double vision, or trouble speaking?
transliteration: nei yau mou wan dai, sau geuk mo lik, tai ye jung ying waak je gong ye yau kwan naan?
translation: 你有冇暈低、手腳無力、睇嘢重影或者講嘢有困難？

english: Is your nose blocked or stuffy?
transliteration: nei go bei sai m sai?
translation: 你個鼻塞唔塞？

english: Is one nostril blocked or both?
transliteration: hai yat bin bei hung sai, ding hai leung bin dou sai?
translation: 係一邊鼻孔塞，定係兩邊都塞？

english: Do you have a runny nose?
transliteration: nei yau mou lau bei sue?
translation: 你有冇流鼻水？

english: What colour is the mucus?
transliteration: bei tai hai me go luk?
translation: 鼻涕係咩顏色？

english: Do you have pain or pressure in your cheeks or forehead?
transliteration: nei meen ju waak je ngaak tau yau mou tung waak je yau ap jyu ge gam gok?
translation: 你面珠或者額頭有冇痛或者有壓住嘅感覺？

english: Does mucus drip down the back of your throat?
transliteration: bei tai wui m wui dou lau lok hou lung hau meen?
translation: 鼻涕會唔會倒流落喉嚨後面？

english: Have you lost or noticed a change in your sense of smell?
transliteration: nei yau mou sat heung gok, waak je gok dak heung gok yau bin?
translation: 你有冇失去嗅覺，或者覺得嗅覺有變？

english: Do you sneeze or have itchy, watery eyes?
transliteration: nei yau mou daa fat chi, waak je ngaan han, lau ngaan sue?
translation: 你有冇打乞嗤，或者眼痕、流眼水？

english: Do you get sinus infections repeatedly?
transliteration: nei yau mou faan fuk bei sau gam yim?
translation: 你有冇反覆鼻竇感染？

english: Have you had a recent cold or allergy symptoms?
transliteration: nei jeui gan yau mou gam maau waak je man gam jing jiu?
translation: 你最近有冇感冒或者敏感症狀？

english: Have you had a nosebleed?
transliteration: nei yau mou lau bei hyut?
translation: 你有冇流鼻血？

english: Which nostril is bleeding?
transliteration: bin bin bei hung lau gan hyut?
translation: 邊邊鼻孔流緊血？

english: How long does the bleeding usually last?
transliteration: tung seung lau gei noi sin ji?
translation: 通常流幾耐先止？

english: Is the bleeding heavy or difficult to stop?
transliteration: lau hyut do m do, waak je naan m naan ji?
translation: 流血多唔多，或者難唔難止？

english: Have you injured your nose recently?
transliteration: nei jeui gan yau mou ging chan go bei?
translation: 你最近有冇整親個鼻？

english: Are you taking blood thinners?
transliteration: nei yau mou sik bok hyut yeuk?
translation: 你有冇食薄血藥？

english: Do you pick your nose or use nasal sprays?
transliteration: nei yau mou wa bei, waak je yong bei pan jai?
translation: 你有冇挖鼻，或者用鼻噴劑？

english: Do you have a sore throat?
transliteration: nei hou lung tung m tung?
translation: 你喉嚨痛唔痛？

english: Is swallowing painful?
transliteration: tun ye go jan wui m wui tung?
translation: 吞嘢嗰陣會唔會痛？

english: Is it difficult to swallow solids, liquids, or both?
transliteration: tun gu jaap sik mat, luk tai, ding hai leung ye dou yau kwan naan?
translation: 吞固體食物、液體，定係兩樣都有困難？

english: Does food feel stuck in your throat?
transliteration: nei gok m gok dak yau ye ka jyu hai hou lung?
translation: 你覺唔覺得有嘢卡住喺喉嚨？

english: Do you cough or choke when eating or drinking?
transliteration: nei sik ye waak je yam seui go jan wui m wui kau waak je gang chan?
translation: 你食嘢或者飲水嗰陣會唔會咳或者哽親？

english: Can you swallow your saliva?
transliteration: nei tun m tun dou hau seui?
translation: 你吞唔吞到口水？

english: Do you have fever, swollen tonsils, or white patches in your throat?
transliteration: nei yau mou faat siu, bin to siu jung, waak je hou lung yau baak dim?
translation: 你有冇發燒、扁桃腺腫，或者喉嚨有白點？

english: Have you had repeated tonsil infections?
transliteration: nei yau mou faan fuk bin to siu faat yim?
translation: 你有冇反覆扁桃腺發炎？

english: Do you feel a lump or something stuck in your throat?
transliteration: nei gok m gok dak hou lung yau lap ye, waak je yau ye ka jyu?
translation: 你覺唔覺得喉嚨有粒嘢，或者有嘢卡住？

english: Has your voice become hoarse or changed?
transliteration: nei baa seng yau mou bin saa waak je yau goi bin?
translation: 你把聲有冇變沙或者有改變？

english: How long has your voice been different?
transliteration: nei baa seng m tung jo gei noi?
translation: 你把聲唔同咗有幾耐？

english: Have you completely lost your voice?
transliteration: nei yau mou waan chyun sat seng?
translation: 你有冇完全失聲？

english: Do you have noisy breathing or difficulty breathing?
transliteration: nei foo kap yau mou jaap seng waak je kwan naan?
translation: 你呼吸有冇雜聲或者困難？

english: Do you snore loudly?
transliteration: nei fan gaau go jan bei han seng daai m daai?
translation: 你瞓覺嗰陣鼻鼾聲大唔大？

english: Has anyone noticed you stop breathing during sleep?
transliteration: yau mou yan lau yi dou nei fan gaau go jan wui ting jo foo kap?
translation: 有冇人留意到你瞓覺嗰陣會停咗呼吸？

english: Do you feel sleepy during the day?
transliteration: nei yat tau wui m wui gok dak ngaan?
translation: 你日頭會唔會覺得眼瞓？

english: Do you have persistent cough or acid reflux?
transliteration: nei yau mou chi juk kau sou waak je wai syun dou lau?
translation: 你有冇持續咳嗽或者胃酸倒流？

english: Do you have pain or sores in your mouth?
transliteration: nei hau chung yau mou tung waak je sang chong?
translation: 你口腔有冇痛或者生瘡？

english: Do you have white or red patches in your mouth?
transliteration: nei hau yap meen yau mou baak sik waak je hung sik ge baan?
translation: 你口入面有冇白色或者紅色嘅斑？

english: Do you have trouble opening your mouth?
transliteration: nei yau mou kwan naan jeung hoi go hau?
translation: 你有冇困難張開個口？

english: Do you have jaw pain or pain in front of your ear?
transliteration: nei haa ba tung, waak je yee jai chin meen tung m tung?
translation: 你下巴痛，或者耳仔前面痛唔痛？

english: Does your jaw click or lock?
transliteration: nei go haa ba wui m wui kaa kaa seng, waak je so jun yuk m do?
translation: 你個下巴會唔會咔咔聲，或者鎖住郁唔到？

english: Does your mouth feel unusually dry?
transliteration: nei go hau yau mou dak bit gon?
translation: 你個口有冇特別乾？

english: Do you have swelling under your jaw or near your ear?
transliteration: nei haa ba dai waak je yee jai foon gan yau mou jung?
translation: 你下巴底或者耳仔附近有冇腫？

english: Does the swelling or pain worsen when you eat?
transliteration: nei sik ye go jan, jung waak je tung wui m wui ga geuk?
translation: 你食嘢嗰陣，腫或者痛會唔會加劇？

english: Have you noticed a change in your sense of taste?
transliteration: nei yau mou lau yi dou mei gok yau goi bin?
translation: 你有冇留意到味覺有改變？

english: Have you noticed a lump or swelling in your neck?
transliteration: nei yau mou lau yi dou geng yau lap ye waak je jung hei?
translation: 你有冇留意到頸有粒嘢或者腫起？

english: How long has the lump been there?
transliteration: nei geng seung go lap ye yau gei noi?
translation: 你頸上嗰粒嘢有幾耐？

english: Is the lump growing or painful?
transliteration: go lap ye yau mou bin daai waak je wui tung?
translation: 嗰粒嘢有冇變大或者會痛？

english: Have you had unexplained weight loss or night sweats?
transliteration: nei yau mou mou gu sau jo waak je ye maan choot han?
translation: 你有冇無故瘦咗或者夜晚出汗？

english: Do you have persistent one-sided throat or ear pain?
transliteration: nei yau mou chi juk yat bin hou lung tung waak je yee tung?
translation: 你有冇持續一邊喉嚨痛或者耳痛？

english: Have you coughed up blood?
transliteration: nei yau mou kau hyut?
translation: 你有冇咳血？

english: Do you smoke, vape, or use chewing tobacco?
transliteration: nei yau mou sik yin, kap din ji yin, waak je sik yin cho?
translation: 你有冇食煙、吸電子煙，或者食煙草？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: nei yau mou yam jau?
translation: 你有冇飲酒？

english: Have you had ear, nose, or throat surgery?
transliteration: nei yau mou jou gwo yee, bei waak je hou lung sau suk?
translation: 你有冇做過耳、鼻或者喉嚨手術？

english: Have you had ear infections or a perforated eardrum before?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou si gwo yee do gam yim waak je yee mo chun jo?
translation: 你以前有冇試過耳朵感染或者耳膜穿咗？

english: Have you had your tonsils or adenoids removed?
transliteration: nei yau mou chit cho bin to siu waak je sin yeung tai?
translation: 你有冇切除過扁桃腺或者腺樣體？

english: Have you had a CT scan, MRI, or hearing test?
transliteration: nei yau mou jou gwo din nou sou miu, chi lik kung jan waak je ting lik chak si?
translation: 你有冇做過電腦掃描、磁力共振或者聽力測試？

english: What medications, drops, or sprays have you tried?
transliteration: nei si gwo yong me yeuk, dik yee yap waak je pan jai?
translation: 你試過用咩藥、滴耳液或者噴劑？

english: How often and for how long have you used them?
transliteration: nei yong jo gei mat, mooi chi yong gei noi?
translation: 你用咗幾密、每次用幾耐？

english: Did the treatment help?
transliteration: ji liu yau mou bong dou nei?
translation: 治療有冇幫到你？

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
transliteration: nei yau mou deoi yam ho yeuk mat man gam?
translation: 你有冇對任何藥物敏感？

english: Is there a family history of hearing loss or head and neck cancer?
transliteration: nei uk kei yan yau mou ting lik ha gong waak je tau geng gaai bing si?
translation: 你屋企人有冇聽力下降或者頭頸癌病史？

english: Please sit still. I am going to look inside your ear.
transliteration: ching cho ding, ngo yi gaa wui mong yap nei jek yee.
translation: 請坐定，我而家會望入你隻耳。

english: Please remove your hearing aid.
transliteration: ching cho diu dai jo ting yee hei.
translation: 請除低助聽器。

english: I will gently pull your ear to see inside.
transliteration: ngo wui hing hing laai hoi nei jek yee, tai yap meen.
translation: 我會輕輕拉開你隻耳，睇入面。

english: Tell me if this hurts.
transliteration: yue gwo tung jiu waa ngo ji.
translation: 如果痛就話我知。

english: I am going to check your hearing.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui bong nei gim cha ting lik.
translation: 我而家會幫你檢查聽力。

english: Cover one ear and repeat the words you hear.
transliteration: ze me yat bin yee, yin hau cung fuk nei ting dou ge ji.
translation: 遮住一邊耳，然後重複你聽到嘅字。

english: Tell me whether you hear the tuning fork on the left, right, or in the middle.
transliteration: waa ngo ji nei hai jo bin, yau bin, ding hai jung gaan ting dou yin cha ge seng.
translation: 話我知你喺左邊、右邊，定係中間聽到音叉嘅聲。

english: Tell me when you can no longer hear the sound.
transliteration: ting m dou seng go jan jau waa ngo ji.
translation: 聽唔到聲嗰陣就話我知。

english: I am going to examine your eardrum.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui gim cha nei ge yee mo.
translation: 我而家會檢查你嘅耳膜。

english: I am going to examine your nose.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui gim cha nei go bei.
translation: 我而家會檢查你個鼻。

english: Please breathe through your nose.
transliteration: ching yong bei foo kap.
translation: 請用鼻呼吸。

english: Close one nostril and breathe through the other.
transliteration: sai jyu yat bin bei hung, yong ling yat bin foo kap.
translation: 塞住一邊鼻孔，用另一邊呼吸。

english: Open your mouth wide, please.
transliteration: ching jeung daai go hau.
translation: 請張大個口。

english: Stick out your tongue, please.
transliteration: ching jin cho tiu lei.
translation: 請伸出條脷。

english: Say “ah,” please.
transliteration: ching gong aa.
translation: 請講「啊」。

english: Move your tongue from side to side.
transliteration: joh yau yuk haa tiu lei.
translation: 左右郁下條脷。

english: I am going to feel your neck for any lumps.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui mo haa nei geng, tai haa yau mou ngaang faai.
translation: 我而家會摸下你頸，睇下有冇硬塊。

english: Please swallow once.
transliteration: ching tun yat chi hau seui.
translation: 請吞一次口水。

english: Turn your head to the left, then to the right.
transliteration: heung joh juen tau, joi heung yau juen.
translation: 向左轉頭，再向右轉。

english: We may need a formal hearing test.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang jiu jou jing sik ge ting lik chak si.
translation: 我哋可能要做正式嘅聽力測試。

english: We may need a camera examination of your nose or throat.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang jiu yong geng tau gim cha nei go bei waak je hou lung.
translation: 我哋可能要用鏡頭檢查你個鼻或者喉嚨。

english: I will gently pass a small flexible camera through your nose.
transliteration: ngo wui hing hing gam yong yat tiu yau ge yun geng, yau nei go bei yap heui.
translation: 我會輕輕咁用一條幼嘅軟鏡，由你個鼻入去。

english: You may feel pressure or discomfort, but tell me if it is painful.
transliteration: nei ho nang wui gok dak yau di ap baak gam waak je m syu fuk, yue gwo gok dak tung go jan waa ngo ji.
translation: 你可能會覺得有啲壓迫感或者唔舒服，如果覺得痛就話我知。

english: We may need a CT scan or MRI to look more closely.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang jiu jiu din nou sou miu waak je chi lik kung jan, tai dak ching cho di.
translation: 我哋可能要照電腦掃描或者磁力共振，睇得清楚啲。

english: We may need to take a small sample of tissue for testing.
transliteration: ngo dei ho nang jiu chau siu siu ge jo ji yeung bun heui faa yim.
translation: 我哋可能要抽少少組織樣本去化驗。

english: I am going to remove some earwax if it is safe to do so.
transliteration: yue gwo on chyun ge waa, ngo yi gaa wui bong nei ching joi yat di yee gout.
translation: 如果安全嘅話，我而家會幫你清走一啲耳垢。

english: Please use the medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: ching gan jo fong chi yong yeuk.
translation: 請跟足處方用藥。

english: I will prescribe ear drops or a nasal spray if needed.
transliteration: yau seui jiu ge waa, ngo wui hoi yee yeuk seui waak je bei pan jai bei nei.
translation: 有需要嘅話，我會開耳藥水或者鼻噴劑畀你。

english: Keep your ear dry until we tell you otherwise.
transliteration: ngo dei tung ji nei ji chin, ching bou chi yee jai gon song.
translation: 我哋未通知你之前，請保持耳仔乾爽。

english: Do not put cotton swabs or other objects inside your ear.
transliteration: m hou jeung meen faa baang waak je kei ta ye sai yap yee jai.
translation: 唔好將棉花棒或者其他嘢塞入耳仔。

english: If you have sudden hearing loss, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: yue gwo nei daan yin ting m dou, ching lat kak kau yi.
translation: 如果你突然聽唔到，請即刻求醫。

english: If you have severe trouble breathing or cannot swallow saliva, seek emergency care.
transliteration: yue gwo nei foo kap fei seung kwan naan, waak je tun m dou hau seui, ching lat kak heui gap jing sat.
translation: 如果你呼吸非常困難，或者吞唔到口水，請即刻去急症室。

english: We will arrange an appointment with an ENT specialist.
transliteration: ngo dei wui bong nei on paai tai yee bei hou lung jun foo ga yi sang.
translation: 我哋會幫你安排睇耳鼻喉專科醫生。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to discuss results and treatment.
transliteration: ngo dei wui on paai juen yip faan yee yun, tung nei gong gaai gim cha git gwo tung ji liu.
translation: 我哋會安排專業傳譯員，同你講解檢查結果同治療。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: gim cha jou yun la. do je sai.
translation: 檢查做完喇。唔該晒。

english: I am going to examine your skin.
transliteration: ngo yi gaa wui gim cha nei ge pei foo.
translation: 我而家會檢查你嘅皮膚。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: nei gam yat dim gaai lai tai yee sang?
translation: 你今日點解嚟睇醫生？

english: Please show me the affected area.
transliteration: ching nei ji bei ngo tai sau ying ge wai ji.
translation: 請你指畀我睇受影響嘅位置。

english: May I examine this area?
transliteration: ngo ho yi gim cha ni go wai ji maa?
translation: 我可以檢查呢個位置嗎？

english: Is it okay if I take a photograph for your medical record?
transliteration: ngo ho yi ying jeung jeung pin fong yap nei ge bing lik maa?
translation: 我可以影張相放入你嘅病歷嗎？

english: When did you first notice this skin problem?
transliteration: nei gei si dai yat chi lau yi dou ni go pei foo man tai?
translation: 你幾時第一次留意到呢個皮膚問題？

english: How long have you had it?
transliteration: ni go ching fong chi juk jo gei noi?
translation: 呢個情況持續咗幾耐？

english: Did it appear suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: keui hai dat yin chut ying, ding hai maan maan chut ying?
translation: 佢係突然出現，定係慢慢出現？

english: Where did it first appear?
transliteration: jeui cho hai bin dou chut ying?
translation: 最初喺邊度出現？

english: Has it spread to other areas?
transliteration: yau mou kwok saan dou kei ta dei fong?
translation: 有冇擴散到其他地方？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: ching fong yau mou hou jo, bin cha, waak je mou bin?
translation: 情況有冇好轉、變差，或者冇變？

english: Does it come and go or stay all the time?
transliteration: keui hai si yau si mou, ding hai yat jik dou yau?
translation: 佢係時有時無，定係一直都有？

english: Have you had this before?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou si gwo gam yeung?
translation: 你以前有冇試過咁樣？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: mooi chi faat jok wui chi juk gei noi?
translation: 每次發作會持續幾耐？

english: Is it happening more often now?
transliteration: yi gaa hai m hai faat sang dak mat jo?
translation: 依家係咪發生得密咗？

english: Where on your body is the rash?
transliteration: pei chan hai nei san tai bin go wai ji?
translation: 皮疹喺你身體邊個位置？

english: Is it on one side or both sides?
transliteration: hai yat bin ding hai leung bin dou yau?
translation: 係喺一邊定係兩邊都有？

english: Is it on your face or scalp?
transliteration: meen waak je tau pei yau mou?
translation: 面或者頭皮有冇？

english: Is it on your hands, palms, or between your fingers?
transliteration: sau, sau jeung waak je sau ji laap yau mou?
translation: 手、手掌或者手指罅有冇？

english: Is it on your feet, soles, or between your toes?
transliteration: geuk, geuk baan dai waak je geuk ji laap yau mou?
translation: 腳、腳板底或者腳趾罅有冇？

english: Is it in your armpits or groin?
transliteration: haak haa waak je daai tui laap yau mou?
translation: 腋下或者大髀罅有冇？

english: Is it around your genitals or anus?
transliteration: sang jik hei waak je gong moon yau mou?
translation: 生殖器或者肛門周圍有冇？

english: Are the spots flat or raised?
transliteration: di baan hai ping ge, ding hai tau hei ge?
translation: 啲斑係平嘅，定係凸起嘅？

english: Are there blisters or fluid-filled bumps?
transliteration: yau mou seui paau waak je yap meen yau seui ge tau hei?
translation: 有冇水泡或者入面有水嘅凸起？

english: Is there scaling, flaking, or crusting?
transliteration: yau mou top pei, laai pei waak je git gaa?
translation: 有冇脫皮、甩皮或者結痂？

english: Are the spots circular or ring-shaped?
transliteration: di baan hai yun hing waak je waan hing ge maa?
translation: 啲斑係圓形或者環形嘅嗎？

english: Has the colour or size changed?
transliteration: ngaan sik waak je daai si yau mou bin?
translation: 顏色或者大小有冇變？

english: Is the skin cracked or peeling?
transliteration: pei foo yau mou lit hoi waak je top pei?
translation: 皮膚有冇裂開或者脫皮？

english: Does it itch?
transliteration: wui m wui han?
translation: 會唔會痕？

english: Where does it itch the most?
transliteration: bin dou jeui han?
translation: 邊度最痕？

english: Is the itching worse at night?
transliteration: maan seung wui m wui han dak lei hoi di?
translation: 夜晚會唔會痕得犀利啲？

english: Does the itching wake you from sleep?
transliteration: han wui m wui ling nei fan sing?
translation: 痕會唔會令你瞓醒？

english: Does scratching make it worse?
transliteration: gwaa jo wui m wui ling keui yim jung jo?
translation: 抓咗會唔會令佢嚴重咗？

english: Does anything relieve the itching?
transliteration: yau mou ye ho yi ji han?
translation: 有冇嘢可以止痕？

english: Is it painful, tender, or burning?
transliteration: wui m wui tung, dim lok heui wui m wui tung, waak je yau jeuk yit gam?
translation: 會唔會痛、掂落去會唔會痛，或者有灼熱感？

english: Does the skin feel hot to touch?
transliteration: mo lok heui go baan pei foo wui m wui gok dak yit?
translation: 摸落去塊皮膚會唔會覺得熱？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: yue gwo yau ling fun dou sap fun, tung cho yau gei yim jung?
translation: 如果由零分到十分，痛楚有幾嚴重？

english: Is the pain only when touched or also at rest?
transliteration: hai m hai dim dou sin wui tung, ding hai m dim dou dou wui tung?
translation: 係咪掂到先會痛，定係唔掂都會痛？

english: Do you have a fever or chills?
transliteration: nei yau mou faat siu waak je faat laang?
translation: 你有冇發燒或者發冷？

english: Is the redness spreading quickly?
transliteration: di hung jung yau mou hou faai kwok saan?
translation: 啲紅腫有冇好快擴散？

english: Is there pus, drainage, or a bad smell?
transliteration: yau mou nung, sam yeuk, waak je yau sau mei?
translation: 有冇膿、滲液，或者有臭味？

english: Are there painful blisters?
transliteration: yau mou di seui paau wui tung?
translation: 有冇啲水泡會痛？

english: Do you feel generally unwell?
transliteration: nei hai m hai sing go yan dou m syu fuk?
translation: 你係咪成個人都唔舒服？

english: Is the rash near your eye or affecting your vision?
transliteration: di pei chan hai m hai hai ngaan gan foon wai, waak je ying heung nei ge si lik?
translation: 啲皮疹係咪喺眼附近，或者影響到你嘅視力？

english: Do you have sores inside your mouth or on your genitals?
transliteration: nei hau chung yap meen waak je sang jik hei seung yau mou chong?
translation: 你口腔入面或者生殖器上有冇瘡？

english: Are you having trouble breathing or swelling of your lips or tongue?
transliteration: nei yau mou foo kap kwan naan, waak je jeui chun, sei tau jung jeung?
translation: 你有冇呼吸困難，或者嘴唇、舌頭腫脹？

english: Have you started any new medication recently?
transliteration: nei jeui gan yau mou hoi chi sik san yeuk?
translation: 你最近有冇開始食新藥？

english: Have you used any new soap, detergent, cream, or cosmetic?
transliteration: nei yau mou yong gwo san ge gaan yik, sai yee yik, woo foo seung waak je jong joong ban?
translation: 你有冇用過新嘅梘液、洗衣液、護膚霜或者化妝品？

english: Does it worsen after sun exposure?
transliteration: saai yun tai yeu hau wui m wui yim jung di?
translation: 曬完太陽之後會唔會嚴重啲？

english: Does heat, sweating, or exercise make it worse?
transliteration: tin hei yit, choot han waak je jou wan duk wui m wui ling keui yim jung di?
translation: 天氣熱、出汗或者做運動會唔會令佢嚴重啲？

english: Does cold weather or water trigger it?
transliteration: dung tin waak je dim dou seui wui m wui yan faat?
translation: 凍天或者掂到水會唔會引發？

english: Does it happen after certain foods?
transliteration: sik jo mau di ye ji hau wui m wui chut ying?
translation: 食咗某啲嘢之後會唔會出現？

english: Have you travelled recently?
transliteration: nei jeui gan yau mou heui leui hang?
translation: 你最近有冇去旅行？

english: Have you been bitten by an insect or tick?
transliteration: nei yau mou bei kwan chong waak je pai chong ngaau gwo?
translation: 你有冇俾昆蟲或者蜱蟲咬過？

english: Have you been around anyone with a similar rash or itching?
transliteration: nei yau mou jip juk gwo yau lei si pei chan waak je han ye ge yan?
translation: 你有冇接觸過有類似皮疹或者痕癢嘅人？

english: Are there pets or animals at home?
transliteration: uk kei yau mou yeung chung mat waak je kei ta dung mat?
translation: 屋企有冇養寵物或者其他動物？

english: Are you exposed to chemicals or irritants at work?
transliteration: nei gung jok si wui m wui jip juk dou faa hok ban waak je chi gik pei foo ge ye?
translation: 你工作時會唔會接觸到化學品或者刺激皮膚嘅嘢？

english: How long have you had this mole?
transliteration: ni lap ji yau gei noi?
translation: 呢粒痣你有幾耐？

english: Has this mole changed in size, shape, or colour?
transliteration: ni lap ji ge daai si, ying jong waak je ngaan sik yau mou bin gwo?
translation: 呢粒痣嘅大小、形狀或者顏色有冇變過？

english: Does the mole bleed, itch, or hurt?
transliteration: lap ji yau mou lau hyut, han waak je tung?
translation: 粒痣有冇流血、痕或者痛？

english: Has the mole developed an irregular border?
transliteration: lap ji ge bin yuen yau mou bin dak m gwai juk?
translation: 粒痣嘅邊緣有冇變得唔規則？

english: Have you noticed a new or unusual mole?
transliteration: nei yau mou lau yi dou san chut waak je m seun cheung ge ji?
translation: 你有冇留意到新出或者唔尋常嘅痣？

english: Have you ever had skin cancer or melanoma?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou waan gwo pei foo ga waak je hak sik sou lau bing?
translation: 你以前有冇患過皮膚癌或者黑色素瘤？

english: Has anyone in your family had melanoma or skin cancer?
transliteration: nei uk kei yau mou yan waan gwo hak sik sou lau bing waak je pei foo ga?
translation: 你屋企有冇人患過黑色素瘤或者皮膚癌？

english: Have you had frequent sunburns, especially in childhood?
transliteration: nei yau mou sing yat saai seung, dak bit hai sai go go jan?
translation: 你有冇成日曬傷，尤其係細個嗰陣？

english: Do you use sunscreen or protective clothing?
transliteration: nei yau mou cha fang saai, waak je jyu jong fong foo yee mat?
translation: 你有冇搽防曬，或者着防護衣物？

english: Have you used tanning beds?
transliteration: nei yau mou yong gwo saai hak chong?
translation: 你有冇用過曬黑床？

english: Have you ever had eczema?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou waan gwo sap jan?
translation: 你以前有冇患過濕疹？

english: Have you ever had psoriasis?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou waan gwo ngan seui bing?
translation: 你以前有冇患過銀屑病？

english: Have you had acne or pimples?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou sang gwo am chong waak je ching chun dou?
translation: 你以前有冇生過暗瘡或者青春痘？

english: Have you had hives or raised itchy welts?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou chut gwo fung laai, waak je di jung hei lei yau han ge jan?
translation: 你以前有冇出過風癩，或者啲腫起嚟又痕嘅疹？

english: Have you had a fungal skin infection?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou si gwo pei foo jun gam gam yim?
translation: 你以前有冇試過皮膚真菌感染？

english: Have you had warts?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou sang gwo yiu?
translation: 你以前有冇生過疣？

english: Have you had shingles?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou sang gwo sang se?
translation: 你以前有冇生過生蛇？

english: Have you had scabies?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou sang gwo gaai chong?
translation: 你以前有冇生過疥瘡？

english: Have you had head lice?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou sang gwo tau sat?
translation: 你以前有冇生過頭蝨？

english: Have you had cold sores around your lips?
transliteration: nei yi chin yau mou hai jeui chun foon gan sang gwo chun chong?
translation: 你以前有冇喺嘴唇附近生過唇瘡？

english: Do you have very dry or sensitive skin?
transliteration: nei yau mou pei foo hou gon waak je hou man gam?
translation: 你有冇皮膚好乾或者好敏感？

english: Have you noticed hair loss or thinning?
transliteration: nei yau mou lau yi dou top faat waak je tau faat bin taan?
translation: 你有冇留意到脫髮或者頭髮變薄？

english: Is the hair loss in patches or all over?
transliteration: top tau faat hai yat taat taat gam, ding hai sing go tau dou hai?
translation: 甩頭髮係一撻撻咁，定係成個頭都係？

english: Is your scalp itchy, painful, or flaky?
transliteration: nei go tau pei wui m wui han, tung waak je yau tau pei sit?
translation: 你個頭皮會唔會痕、痛或者有頭皮屑？

english: Have your nails changed colour or shape?
transliteration: nei di ji ga ge ngaan sik waak je ying jong yau mou bin?
translation: 你啲指甲嘅顏色或者形狀有冇變？

english: Are your nails thickened, brittle, or separating from the skin?
transliteration: nei di ji ga yau mou bin hau, bin cui, waak je tung pei foo fan hoi?
translation: 你啲指甲有冇變厚、變脆，或者同皮膚分開？

english: Do you have any allergies?
transliteration: nei yau mou yam ho?
translation: 你有冇任何過敏？

english: Do you have asthma or seasonal allergies?
transliteration: nei yau mou ha si waak je jit ling sing man gam?
translation: 你有冇哮喘或者季節性過敏？

english: Do you have diabetes or a condition affecting your immune system?
transliteration: nei yau mou tong niu bing, waak je ying heung min yat hei tung ge bing?
translation: 你有冇糖尿病，或者影響免疫系統嘅病？

english: Does anyone in your family have eczema, psoriasis, or similar skin problems?
transliteration: nei uk kei yau mou yan yau sap jan, ngan seui bing waak je lei si ge pei foo man tai?
translation: 你屋企有冇人有濕疹、銀屑病或者類似嘅皮膚問題？

english: Are you pregnant or breastfeeding?
transliteration: nei yi gaa yau mou waai yun waak je bei gan moon naai?
translation: 你而家有冇懷孕或者餵緊母乳？

english: What medicines and supplements do you take?
transliteration: nei yi gaa sik gan me yeuk tung bou chung jai?
translation: 你而家食緊咩藥同補充劑？

english: Have you tried any treatment for this problem?
transliteration: nei yau mou si gwo yong me fong faat ji liu ni go man tai?
translation: 你有冇試過用咩方法治療呢個問題？

english: What cream, lotion, or medicine have you used?
transliteration: nei yong gwo me yeuk gou, yun foo lou waak je yeuk?
translation: 你用過咩藥膏、潤膚露或者藥？

english: How often do you apply it?
transliteration: nei gei noi cha yat chi?
translation: 你幾耐搽一次？

english: How long have you been using it?
transliteration: nei yong jo gei noi?
translation: 你用咗幾耐？

english: When did you last use it?
transliteration: nei seung chi gei si yong?.
translation: 你上次幾時用？

english: Did it help or make the problem worse?
transliteration: YAU-MOH BONG-DOH NAY, DING-HAY LING-GOH MAN-TAI YIN-JUNG-JO?
translation: 有冇幫到你，定係令個問題嚴重咗？

english: Have you used a steroid or cortisone cream?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH YUNG-GWO LUI-GOO-CHUN-WA GE-YA HOH-TAI-SUNG YEUK-GO?
translation: 你有冇用過類固醇或者可體松藥膏？

english: Did you stop any treatment? Why?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH TING-GWO YAM-HO JI-LIU? DIM-GAI?
translation: 你有冇停過任何治療？點解？

english: Have you seen a dermatologist for this before?
transliteration: NAY JEE-CHIN YAU-MOH TAI-GWO PEI-FU-KOH YEE-SANG CHOO-LAI NEI-GOH MAN-TAI?
translation: 你之前有冇睇過皮膚科醫生處理呢個問題？

english: Please roll up your sleeves.
transliteration: M-GOI GYUN-HEI SAU-KAU.
translation: 唔該捲起袖口。

english: Please turn around so I can examine your back.
transliteration: M-GOI JUEN-GWO-SUN, DANG-NGO GIM-CHA NAY-GOH BUI-BEK.
translation: 唔該轉過身，等我檢查你個背脊。

english: I am going to examine your scalp and nails.
transliteration: NGO-YI-GA WUI GIM-CHA NAY-GE TAU-PEI TUNG JI-GA.
translation: 我而家會檢查你嘅頭皮同指甲。

english: I am going to look at this with a magnifying light.
transliteration: NGO-WUI YUNG FONG-DAI-DANG TAI-HA NEI-DOU.
translation: 我會用放大燈睇下呢度。

english: We may need to take a small skin sample (biopsy).
transliteration: NGO-DEI HO-NANG-YIU CHAU YAT-SIU-GWAII PEI-FU YEUNG-BUN (WOOT-GIM).
translation: 我哋可能要抽一小塊皮膚樣本（活檢）。

english: We may take a skin scraping to test for fungus.
transliteration: NGO-DEI HO-NANG-WUI GWAAT SIU-SIU PEI-FU, YIM-HA YAU-MOH JUN-KAM.
translation: 我哋可能會刮少少皮膚，驗下有冇真菌。

english: We may take a sample from your nail.
transliteration: NGO-DEI HO-NANG-WUI HAI NAY-JEK GA-DOU CHOI-YEUNG-BUN.
translation: 我哋可能會喺你隻甲度取樣本。

english: I am going to clean the area first.
transliteration: NGO-WUI SIN CHING-GAI NEI-GOH WAI-JI.
translation: 我會先清潔呢個位置。

english: You may feel a small pinch.
transliteration: NAY HO-NANG-WUI GOK-DOU HING-HING JEK-YAT-HA.
translation: 你可能會覺得輕輕拮一下。

english: I will prescribe a cream or ointment.
transliteration: NGO-WUI HOI YEUK-GO WAA-JE YEUK OINTMENT.
translation: 我會開藥膏或者藥 ointment。

english: Apply a thin layer to the affected skin.
transliteration: HAI SAU-YING-HEUNG GE PEI-FU SEUNG BUN-BUN GAM CHA YAT-CANG.
translation: 喺受影響嘅皮膚上薄薄咁搽一層。

english: How many times a day were you told to apply it?
transliteration: YEE-SANG GIU NAY YAT-YAT CHA GEI-DO-CHI?
translation: 醫生叫你一日搽幾多次？

english: For how many days were you told to use it?
transliteration: YEE-SANG GIU NAY YUNG GEI-DO-YAT?
translation: 醫生叫你用幾多日？

english: Avoid scratching or picking the skin.
transliteration: BI-MIN GRAAU WAA-JE KAU DI PEI-FU.
translation: 避免抓或者摳啲皮膚。

english: Use a gentle, fragrance-free moisturizer.
transliteration: YUNG WUN-WO, MOU HEUNG-LIU GE YUN-FU-SUONG.
translation: 用溫和、冇香料嘅潤膚霜。

english: Keep the area clean and dry.
transliteration: BOO-CHI NEI-GOH WAI-JI CHING-GAI TUNG GON-SOENG.
translation: 保持呢個位置清潔同乾爽。

english: Avoid the product that seems to trigger the rash.
transliteration: BI-MIN YUNG CHI-HOO WUI YAN-HEI PEI-JUN GE CHAN-PAN.
translation: 避免用似乎會引起皮疹嘅產品。

english: Use sunscreen and protect your skin from the sun.
transliteration: CHA FONG-SAI, BOO-WOO PEI-FU M-HOU SAI-SENG.
translation: 搽防曬，保護皮膚唔好曬傷。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: GIM-CHA-YUN LA, DO-JE NAY.
translation: 檢查完喇，多謝你。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: NGO-DEI WUI ON-PAI FOO-GAN.
translation: 我哋會安排覆診。

english: Please return if the rash worsens or spreads.
transliteration: YU-GWO PEI-JUN YUN-JUNG-JO WAA-JE KWOK-SAN, CHING FAN-LAI TAI-YEE-SANG.
translation: 如果皮疹嚴重咗或者擴散，請返嚟睇醫生。

english: Seek urgent medical care if you have trouble breathing or rapidly worsening symptoms.
transliteration: YU-GWO NAY FOO-SIP-KUN-NAN WAA-JE JUNG-JONG HOU-FAI WOK-WA, CHING JIK-GAK KAU-YEE.
translation: 如果你呼吸困難或者症狀好快惡化，請即刻求醫。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to explain the results and treatment.
transliteration: NGO-DEI WUI ON-PAI JUEN-YIP CHUEN-YI-YUEN HEUNG NAY GAI-SIK GIT-GWO TUNG JI-LIU FONG-FAAT.
translation: 我哋會安排專業傳譯員向你解釋結果同治療方法。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: NAY GAM-YAT YAU-MOH-SI WANTAI-YEE-SANG?
translation: 你今日有咩事想睇醫生？

english: Where does it hurt? Please point to the area.
transliteration: BIN-DOU TUNG? CHING JEE-YAT-JEE TUNG GE WAI-JI.
translation: 邊度痛？請指一指痛嘅位置。

english: Is the pain on the right, left, or both sides?
transliteration: HAI YAU-BIN TUNG, JO-BIN TUNG, DING-HAI LOENG-BIN DOU TUNG?
translation: 係右邊痛、左邊痛，定係兩邊都痛？

english: When did the pain start?
transliteration: GEI-SI HOI-CHI TUNG?
translation: 幾時開始痛？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: HAI DAT-YUN HOI-CHI, DING-HAI MAAN-MAAN HOI-CHI?
translation: 係突然開始，定係慢慢開始？

english: How long have you had this problem?
transliteration: NEI-GOH MAN-TAI YAU GEI-NAI?
translation: 呢個問題有幾耐？

english: Is the pain constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: HAI YAT-JIK DOU TUNG, DING-HAI GAAN-JUNG SIN TUNG?
translation: 係一直都痛，定係間中先痛？

english: Is the pain getting better or worse?
transliteration: TUNG-CHO HAI HO-JEUNG DING-HAI OK-WA?
translation: 痛楚係好轉定係惡化？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: YU-GWO YAU LING-FAN DOU SAP-FAN, TUNG-CHO YAU GEI YUN-JUNG?
translation: 如果由零分到十分，痛楚有幾嚴重？

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, burning, or throbbing?
transliteration: TUNG-CHO HAI CHIK-TUNG, YAM-YAM-JOK-TUNG, JEUK-TUNG, DING-HAI TIU-TUNG?
translation: 痛楚係刺痛、隱隱作痛、灼痛，定係跳痛？

english: Does the pain spread anywhere else?
transliteration: TUNG-CHO YAU-MOH KWOK-SAN-DOU KEI-TA DEI-FONG?
translation: 痛楚有冇擴散到其他地方？

english: Have you had this pain before?
transliteration: NAY YEE-CHIN SI-GWO GAM-YEUNG TUNG MA?
translation: 你以前試過咁樣痛嗎？

english: Did you fall or have an accident?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH DAI-DOU WAA-JE YU-GWO YI-WAI?
translation: 你有冇跌倒或者遇過意外？

english: When did the injury happen?
transliteration: GEI-SI SAU-SENG?
translation: 幾時受傷？

english: How did you injure yourself?
transliteration: NAY HAI DIM-YEUNG YING-CHUN GE?
translation: 你係點樣整親嘅？

english: Did you get hit directly in that area?
transliteration: GOH-GOH WAI-JI YAU-MOH JIK-JIP BEI-YE JUNG-DOU?
translation: 嗰個位置有冇直接俾嘢撞到？

english: Did you twist your ankle or knee?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH NIU-CHAN GOEK-NGAN WAA-JE KAI-TAU?
translation: 你有冇扭親腳眼或者膝頭？

english: Did you fall onto an outstretched hand?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH DAI-DI-SI YUNG JING-JIK GE SAU CHAANG-JYU DEI?
translation: 你有冇跌低時用伸直嘅手撐住地？

english: Did you hear or feel a pop or crack?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH TENG-DOU WAA-JE GOK-DOU 'PAK' YAT-SENG WAA-JE LIT-HOI GE SENG?
translation: 你有冇聽到或者感覺到「啪」一聲或者裂開嘅聲？

english: Did the swelling start immediately?
transliteration: JUNG-JONG HAI-MAI JIK-GAK HOI-CHI?
translation: 腫脹係咪即刻開始？

english: Could you walk right after the injury?
transliteration: SAU-SENG JI-HAU, NAY JIK-GAK HAANG-M-HAANG-DOU?
translation: 受傷之後，你即刻行唔行到？

english: Did you continue playing or working after the injury?
transliteration: SAU-SENG JI-HAU, NAY YAU-MOH GAI-JOOK WAN WAA-JE GUNG-JOK?
translation: 受傷之後，你有冇繼續玩或者工作？

english: Was this related to sports, work, or lifting something heavy?
transliteration: NEI-CHI SAU-SENG TUNG WAN-DUNG, GUNG-JOK, WAA-JE BUNG-JUNG-MAT YAU-MOH GUAN-HAI?
translation: 呢次受傷同運動、工作，或者搬重物有冇關係？

english: Did you injure your head or neck as well?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH TUNG-SI JING-DOU TAU WAA-JE TENG-GAAN?
translation: 你有冇同時整親個頭或者條頸？

english: Does it hurt more when you move?
transliteration: UK-DUNG GO-JAN WUI-M-WUI GANG-GA TUNG?
translation: 郁動嗰陣會唔會更加痛？

english: Does it hurt more when you walk or stand?
transliteration: HAANG-LOU WAA-JE KEI GE-SI, WUI-M-WUI GANG-GA TUNG?
translation: 行路或者企嘅時候，會唔會更加痛？

english: Does it hurt more when you sit or bend forward?
transliteration: JO-DI WAA-JE HEUNG-CHIN WAN-YIU GE-SI, WUI-M-WUI GANG-GA TUNG?
translation: 坐低或者向前彎腰嘅時候，會唔會更加痛？

english: Does the pain improve with rest?
transliteration: SIK-SIK JI-HAU, TUNG-CHO WUI-M-WUI GAAM-HING?
translation: 休息之後，痛楚會唔會減輕？

english: Does the pain wake you up at night?
transliteration: TUNG-CHO WUI-M-WUI LING NAY YE-MAAN FAN-SING?
translation: 痛楚會唔會令你夜晚瞓醒？

english: Do you have stiffness in the morning?
transliteration: NAY JIU-MAAN WUI-M-WUI GOK-DOU GEING-GANG?
translation: 你朝早會唔會覺得僵硬？

english: How long does the morning stiffness last?
transliteration: JIU-MAAN GEING-GANG WUI CHI-JOOK GEI-NAI?
translation: 朝早僵硬會持續幾耐？

english: Can you do your usual daily activities?
transliteration: NAY PING-SI MEI-YAT JO GE WUN-DUNG, JUNG JO-M-JO-DOU?
translation: 你平時每日做嘅活動，仲做唔做到？

english: Can you walk without assistance?
transliteration: NAY HO-M-HO-YI M-SAI YAN FU-JYU JI-GAI HAANG-LOU?
translation: 你可唔可以唔使人扶住自己行路？

english: How far can you walk before you need to stop?
transliteration: NAY HAANG GEI-YUEN JAU YIU TING-DI?
translation: 你行幾遠就要停低？

english: Can you climb stairs?
transliteration: NAY HAANG-M-HAANG-DOU LOU-THAI?
translation: 你行唔行到樓梯？

english: Does the joint lock, catch, or give way?
transliteration: GUAN-JIP WUI-M-WUI KA-JYU, KA-YAT-SENG, WAA-JE DAT-YUN MOU-LIK?
translation: 關節會唔會卡住、卡一聲，或者突然無力？

english: Is the area swollen?
transliteration: GOH-GOH WAI-JI YAU-MOH JUNG?
translation: 嗰個位置有冇腫？

english: Is the area red or warm to touch?
transliteration: GOH-GOH WAI-JI YAU-MOH HUNG, MOK-LOK-HEI WUI-M-WUI WUN?
translation: 嗰個位置有冇紅，摸落去會唔會暖？

english: Do you have a fever or feel unwell?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH FOT-SIU, WAA-JE GOK-DOU M-SOU-FOOK?
translation: 你有冇發燒，或者覺得唔舒服？

english: Do you feel numbness or tingling?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH MA-BEI WAA-JE CHIK-CHIK-DEI GE GAM-GOK?
translation: 你有冇麻痺或者刺刺哋嘅感覺？

english: Do you have weakness in your arm or leg?
transliteration: NAY JEK-SAU-BEI WAA-JE JEK-GOEK YAU-MOH FAT-LIK?
translation: 你隻手臂或者隻腳有冇乏力？

english: Can you feel me touching your fingers or toes?
transliteration: NAY GAM-GOK-M-GAM-GOK-DOU NGO TIM NAY DI SAU-JEE WAA-JE GOEK-JAI?
translation: 你感覺唔感覺到我掂你啲手指或者腳趾？

english: Have your fingers or toes become cold or pale?
transliteration: NAY DI SAU-JEE WAA-JE GOEK-JAI YAU-MOH BIN-GAANG WAA-JE BIN-BAAK?
translation: 你啲手指或者腳趾有冇變凍或者變白？

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your urine or stool?
transliteration: NAY JEUI-GAN YAU-MOH SUN CHUT-YUN GUNG-JOK-M-DOU SIU-BIN WAA-JE DAI-BIN GE CHING-KWONG?
translation: 你最近有冇新出現控制唔到小便或者大便嘅情況？

english: Do you have numbness around your groin or between your legs?
transliteration: NAY LOENG-TOI GAAN WAA-JE KWA-HAA YAU-MOH MA-BEI?
translation: 你兩腿之間或者胯下有冇麻痺？

english: Have you had unexplained weight loss?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH MOU-YUEN-MOU-GOO SAU-JO?
translation: 你有冇無緣無故瘦咗？

english: Does your neck hurt?
transliteration: NAY TENG-GAAN TUNG-M-TUNG?
translation: 你條頸痛唔痛？

english: Does your upper or lower back hurt?
transliteration: NAY SEUNG-BUI WAA-JE HAA-BUI TUNG-M-TUNG?
translation: 你上背或者下背痛唔痛？

english: Does the pain travel down your arm?
transliteration: TUNG-CHO YAU-MOH YUEN-JYU SAU-BEI HEUNG-HA YIN-SAN?
translation: 痛楚有冇沿住手臂向下延伸？

english: Does the pain travel down your buttock or leg?
transliteration: TUNG-CHO YAU-MOH YAU TUN-BOU WAA-JE DAAI-TOI YAT-LOU CHING-LOK JEK-GOEK?
translation: 痛楚有冇由臀部或者大髀一路伸落隻腳？

english: Is the pain worse when you cough or sneeze?
transliteration: KAAU-SAU WAA-JE DAA-GAT-CHI GE SI, TUNG-CHO WUI-M-WUI GA-JUK?
translation: 咳嗽或者打乞嗤嘅時候，痛楚會唔會加劇？

english: Is bending forward or backward painful?
transliteration: HEUNG-CHIN WAA-JE HEUNG-HAU WAN-YIU WUI-M-WUI TUNG?
translation: 向前或者向後彎腰會唔會痛？

english: Have you had a slipped or herniated disc before?
transliteration: NAY YEE-CHIN YAU-MOH SI-GWO JUI-GAAN-PAN TUUT-CHUT WAA-JE JUI-GAAN-PAN TUIT-CHUT?
translation: 你以前有冇試過椎間盤突出或者椎間盤脫出？

english: Have you had back surgery before?
transliteration: NAY YEE-CHIN YAU-MOH JO-GWO BUI-BOU SAU-SUT?
translation: 你以前有冇做過背部手術？

english: Does your shoulder hurt?
transliteration: NAY BOEK-TAU TUNG-M-TUNG?
translation: 你膊頭痛唔痛？

english: Can you lift your arm above your head?
transliteration: NAY HO-M-HO-YI JEUNG SAU-BEI GUI-GWO TAU-DING?
translation: 你可唔可以將手臂舉過頭頂？

english: Does your shoulder feel unstable or pop out?
transliteration: NAY-GOH BOEK-TAU GOK-M-GOK-DOU M-BAT, WAA-JE HOU-CHI LAAT-JO CHUT-LAI?
translation: 你個膊頭覺唔覺得唔穩，或者好似甩咗出嚟？

english: Does your elbow hurt?
transliteration: NAY SAU-JANG TUNG-M-TUNG?
translation: 你手踭痛唔痛？

english: Does your wrist hurt?
transliteration: NAY SAU-WAAN TUNG-M-TUNG?
translation: 你手腕痛唔痛？

english: Do you have pain or swelling in your fingers?
transliteration: NAY DI SAU-JEE YAU-MOH TUNG WAA-JE JUNG?
translation: 你啲手指有冇痛或者腫？

english: Can you make a fist?
transliteration: NAY HO-M-HO-YI WUN-KUEN?
translation: 你可唔可以握拳？

english: Can you grip or hold objects normally?
transliteration: NAY HO-M-HO-YI JING-CHONG GAM-JOEK WAA-JE LING-JYU DI-YE?
translation: 你可唔可以正常咁捉住或者拎住啲嘢？

english: Do your fingers become numb at night?
transliteration: NAY YE-MAAN SAU-JEE WUI-M-WUI MA-BEI?
translation: 你夜晚手指會唔會麻痺？

english: Does your hip or groin hurt?
transliteration: NAY KWA-BU WAA-JE KWA-HAA TUNG-M-TUNG?
translation: 你髖部或者胯下痛唔痛？

english: Does your knee hurt?
transliteration: NAY KAI-TAU TUNG-M-TUNG?
translation: 你膝頭痛唔痛？

english: Does your knee swell after activity?
transliteration: JO-WUN-DUNG JI-HAU, NAY KAI-TAU WUI-M-WUI JUNG?
translation: 做完活動之後，你膝頭會唔會腫？

english: Does your knee lock or give way?
transliteration: NAY KAI-TAU WUI-M-WUI KA-JYU WAA-JE DAT-YUN MOU-LIK?
translation: 你膝頭會唔會卡住或者突然無力？

english: Does your ankle hurt?
transliteration: NAY GOEK-NGAN TUNG-M-TUNG?
translation: 你腳眼痛唔痛？

english: Does your foot or heel hurt?
transliteration: NAY JEK-GOEK WAA-JE GOEK-GAN TUNG-M-TUNG?
translation: 你隻腳或者腳踭痛唔痛？

english: Can you put weight on the injured leg?
transliteration: NAY SAU-SENG GOH-JEK-GOEK HO-M-HO-YI SING-SAU-JUNG?
translation: 你受傷嗰隻腳可唔可以承受重量？

english: Can you take four steps?
transliteration: NAY HO-M-HO-YI HAANG SEI-BOU?
translation: 你可唔可以行四步？

english: Do you have pain in your calf?
transliteration: NAY SIU-TOI YAU-MOH TUNG?
translation: 你小腿有冇痛？

english: Is one calf more swollen than the other?
transliteration: NAY HAI-MAI YAT-BIN SIU-TOI BAI LING-YAT-BIN JUNG?
translation: 你係咪一邊小腿比另一邊腫？

english: Have you been diagnosed with arthritis?
transliteration: YEE-SANG YAU-MOH WAA NAY YAU GUAN-JIP-YUN?
translation: 醫生有冇話你有關節炎？

english: Have you been diagnosed with osteoarthritis?
transliteration: YEE-SANG YAU-MOH WAA NAY YAU TEI-GA-SING GUAN-JIP-YUN?
translation: 醫生有冇話你有退化性關節炎？

english: Have you been diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis?
transliteration: YEE-SANG YAU-MOH WAA NAY YAU LUI-FONG-MAAN-YUN?
translation: 醫生有冇話你有類風濕關節炎？

english: Have you been diagnosed with osteoporosis or weak bones?
transliteration: YEE-SANG YAU-MOH WAA NAY YAU GUT-JAT-SOENG-SUNG WAA-JE GUT-JAT-YEUK?
translation: 醫生有冇話你有骨質疏鬆或者骨質弱？

english: Have you broken a bone before?
transliteration: NAY YEE-CHIN YAU-MOH SI-GWO GUT-JIT?
translation: 你以前有冇試過骨折？

english: Have you had a bone density test?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH JO-GWO GUT-JAT-MAT-DOK GIM-CHA?
translation: 你有冇做過骨質密度檢查？

english: Do you have pain or swelling in several joints?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH GEI-GOH GUAN-JIP TUNG WAA-JE JUNG?
translation: 你有冇幾個關節痛或者腫？

english: Does anyone in your family have arthritis or osteoporosis?
transliteration: NAY UK-KEI-YAN YAU-MOH YAN YAU GUAN-JIP-YUN WAA-JE GUT-JAT-SOENG-SUNG?
translation: 你屋企人有冇人有關節炎或者骨質疏鬆？

english: Have you had surgery on a bone or joint?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH JO-GWO GUT WAA-JE GUAN-JIP SAU-SUT?
translation: 你有冇做過骨或者關節手術？

english: Have you had a hip or knee replacement?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH WUN-GWO KWA-GUAN-JIP WAA-JE KAI-GUAN-JIP?
translation: 你有冇換過髖關節或者膝關節？

english: Have you ever had a cast or splint?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH SI-GWO DA-SIP-GOU WAA-JE DAI-GOO-DING-TO?
translation: 你有冇試過打石膏或者戴固定托？

english: Have you tried physiotherapy?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH SI-GWO JO MAT-LAI-LIU?
translation: 你有冇試過做物理治療？

english: What medicines have you taken for the pain?
transliteration: NAY SIK-GWO ME YEUK JI-TUNG?
translation: 你食過咩藥止痛？

english: Have you taken ibuprofen, naproxen, or diclofenac (Voltaren)?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH SIK-GWO BOO-LOU-FAN, NAP-POO-SING WAA-JE SEUNG-LOU-FAN (Voltaren)?
translation: 你有冇食過布洛芬、萘普生或者雙氯芬酸（Voltaren）？

english: How much medicine do you take and how often?
transliteration: NAY MEI-CHI SIK GEI-DO YEUK? GEI-NAI SIK-YAT-CHI?
translation: 你每次食幾多藥？幾耐食一次？

english: How long have you been taking it?
transliteration: NAY SIK-JO NEI-JEK YEUK GEI-NAI?
translation: 你食咗呢隻藥幾耐？

english: Has the medicine helped?
transliteration: JEK YEUK YAU-MOH BONG-DOH NAY?
translation: 隻藥有冇幫到你？

english: Do you take blood thinners or steroid medicines?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH SIK BOOT-HYUT YEUK WAA-JE LUI-GOO-CHUN YEUK?
translation: 你有冇食薄血藥或者類固醇藥？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: NAY YAU-MOH DEOI ME YEUK MAN-GAAN?
translation: 你有冇對咩藥敏感？

english: I am going to examine the painful area.
transliteration: NGO-YI-GA WUI GIM-CHA TUNG GE DEI-FONG.
translation: 我而家會檢查痛嘅地方。

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: YAU BIN-DOU TUNG, CHING NAY WAA-BEI NGO-TENG.
translation: 有邊度痛，請你話畀我知。

english: Please stand up.
transliteration: CHING NAY GAI-HEI-SUN.
translation: 請你企起身。

english: Please sit down.
transliteration: CHING NAY JO-DI.
translation: 請你坐低。

english: Please lie on your back.
transliteration: CHING NAY TUN-HAI-DOU, MIN-HEUNG-SEUNG.
translation: 請你瞓喺度，面向上。

english: Please lie on your stomach.
transliteration: CHING NAY TUN-HAI-DOU, MIN-HEUNG-HA.
translation: 請你瞓喺度，面向下。

english: Please walk a few steps.
transliteration: CHING NAY HAANG GEI-BOU.
translation: 請你行幾步。

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: CHING NAY YUNG GOEK-JIM HAANG.
translation: 請你用腳尖行。

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: CHING NAY YUNG GOEK-GAN HAANG.
translation: 請你用腳跟行。

english: Bend forward, please.
transliteration: CHING NAY HEUNG-CHIN WAN-YIU.
translation: 請你向前彎腰。

english: Bend your knee, please.
transliteration: CHING NAY WUK KAI-TAU.
translation: 請你屈膝頭。

english: Straighten your knee, please.
transliteration: CHING NAY JING-JIK KAI-TAU.
translation: 請你伸直膝頭。

english: Raise your arm, please.
transliteration: CHING NAY GUI-GO JEK-SAU.
translation: 請你舉高隻手。

english: Make a fist and then open your hand.
transliteration: CHING NAY WUN-KUEN, JOI JEUNG-HOI JEK-SAU.
translation: 請你握拳，再張開隻手。

english: Spread your fingers apart.
transliteration: CHING NAY JEUNG-HOI SAU-JEE.
translation: 請你張開手指。

english: Push against my hand.
transliteration: CHING NAY YUNG SAU TEUI-JYU NGO JEK-SAU.
translation: 請你用手推住我隻手。

english: Pull against my hand.
transliteration: CHING NAY YUNG SAU LAI-JYU NGO JEK-SAU.
translation: 請你用手拉住我隻手。

english: Please relax your muscles.
transliteration: CHING NAY FONG-SUNG GEI-ROOK.
translation: 請你放鬆肌肉。

english: Tell me if you feel this touch.
transliteration: NGO TIM-DO NAY GE SI, NAY WAA-BEI NGO-TENG.
translation: 我掂到你嘅時候，你話畀我知。

english: I am going to examine your joints and muscles.
transliteration: NGO-YI-GA WUI GIM-CHA NAY GE GUAN-JIP TUNG GEI-ROOK.
translation: 我而家會檢查你嘅關節同肌肉。

english: Please tell me if anything hurts during the examination.
transliteration: GIM-CHA GAI-GAAN YAU BIN-DOU TUNG, CHING NAY WAA-BEI NGO-TENG.
translation: 檢查期間有邊度痛，請你話畀我知。

english: Please stand up straight.
transliteration: CHING NAY GAI-JIK.
translation: 請你企直。

english: Please walk across the room and come back.
transliteration: CHING NAY HAANG-GWO FONG-GAAN, JOI HAANG FAN JUEN-TAU.
translation: 請你行過房間，再行返轉頭。

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: CHING NAY YUNG GOEK-GAN HAANG.
translation: 請你用腳跟行。

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: CHING NAY YUNG GOEK-JIM HAANG.
translation: 請你用腳尖行。

english: Please try walking in a straight line, heel to toe.
transliteration: CHING NAY SI-HA GUN-JYU JIK-SIN HAANG, GOEK-GAN TIP-JYU GOEK-JIM.
translation: 請你試吓跟住直線行，腳跟貼住腳尖。

english: Please stand on one leg.
transliteration: CHING NAY DUN-GOEK GAI.
translation: 請你單腳企。

english: Please squat down as far as you comfortably can.
transliteration: CHING NAY JIM-LEUNG SHU-FOOK GAM CHUN-HA.
translation: 請你盡量舒服咁蹲低。

english: Please sit down and stand up without using your hands, if you can.
transliteration: YU-GWO HO-YI, CHING NAY M-HOU YUNG SAU, JO-DI JOI GAI-HEI-SUN.
translation: 如果可以，請你唔好用手，坐低再企起身。

english: Can you put your full weight on this leg?
transliteration: NAY HO-M-HO-YI YUNG NEI-JEK-GOEK SING-SAU CHUEN-SUN JUNG-LAANG?
translation: 你可唔可以用呢隻腳承受全身重量？

english: Please lie on your back.
transliteration: CHING NAY TUN-HAI-DOU, MIN-HEUNG-SEUNG.
translation: 請你瞓喺度，面向上。

english: Please lie on your stomach.
transliteration: CHING NAY TUN-HAI-DOU, MIN-HEUNG-HA.
translation: 請你瞓喺度，面向下。

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: CHING NAY JUEN-SUN CEK-BIN TUN.
translation: 請你轉身側邊瞓。

english: I am going to press gently on this area.
transliteration: NGO WUI HING-HING AAN NEI-GOH WAI-JI.
translation: 我會輕輕按呢個位置。

english: Does it hurt when I press here?
transliteration: NGO AAN NEI-DOU GE SI WUI-M-WUI TUNG?
translation: 我按呢度嘅時候會唔會痛？

english: Is the pain in the muscle, bone, or joint?
transliteration: NAY HAI GEI-ROOK, GUT, DING-HAI GUAN-JIP TUNG?
translation: 你係肌肉、骨，定係關節痛？

english: Please relax your muscles.
transliteration: CHING NAY FONG-SUNG GEI-ROOK.
translation: 請你放鬆肌肉。

english: I will move your arm or leg for you; try to relax.
transliteration: NGO WUI BONG NAY UK JEK-SAU WAA-JE JEK-GOEK, NAY SI-HA FONG-SUNG.
translation: 我會幫你郁隻手或者隻腳，你試吓放鬆。

english: Please look down and bring your chin toward your chest.
transliteration: CHING NAY MONG-DI, GOR HAA-BA TUNG-JYU SUM-KAU.
translation: 請你望低，個下巴向住心口。

english: Please look up toward the ceiling.
transliteration: CHING NAY HEUNG-SEUNG MONG-JYU TIN-WA-BAN.
translation: 請你向上望住天花板。

english: Please turn your head to the left and then to the right.
transliteration: CHING NAY-GOH TAU SIN HEUNG-JO JUEN, JOI HEUNG-YAU JUEN.
translation: 請你個頭先向左轉，再向右轉。

english: Please tilt your ear toward your shoulder.
transliteration: CHING NAY JEUNG JEE CEK-HEUNG BOEK-TAU.
translation: 請你將隻耳側向膊頭。

english: Please bend forward and try to touch your toes.
transliteration: CHING NAY HEUNG-CHIN WAN-YIU, SI-HA TIM-DO GOEK-JAI.
translation: 請你向前彎腰，試吓掂到腳趾。

english: Please lean backward as far as is comfortable.
transliteration: CHING NAY HEUNG-HAU AAU, AAU-DO SHU-FOOK WAI-JI.
translation: 請你向後拗，拗到舒服為止。

english: Please bend sideways to each side.
transliteration: CHING NAY HEUNG-JO TUNG HEUNG-YAU CEK-SUN WAN-YIU.
translation: 請你向左同向右側身彎腰。

english: Please twist your upper body to the left and right.
transliteration: CHING NAY SEUNG-BUN-SUN HEUNG-JO NIU, JOI HEUNG-YAU NIU.
translation: 請你上半身向左扭，再向右扭。

english: I will raise your straight leg; tell me if pain travels down it.
transliteration: NGO WUI TAI-HEI NAY JING-JIK GE GOEK, YU-GWO TUNG-CHO YUEN-JYU GOEK-LOK, CHING NAY WAA-BEI NGO-TENG.
translation: 我會抬起你伸直嘅腳，如果痛楚沿住隻腳落去，請你話我知。

english: Does this movement cause tingling or pain down your arm?
transliteration: GAM-YEUNG UK NAY JEK-SAU-BEI WUI-M-WUI YAU MA-BEI WAA-JE TUNG-CHO YIN-SAN-LOK-HA?
translation: 咁樣郁你隻手臂會唔會有麻痺或者痛楚延伸落去？

english: Please lift your hips off the bed.
transliteration: CHING NAY JEUNG TUN-BOU TAI-LAI-LEI JONG-BED.
translation: 請你將臀部抬離張床。

english: Please lift both arms straight in front of you.
transliteration: CHING NAY JEUNG LOENG-JEK SAU-BEI JING-JIK, HEUNG-CHIN GUI-HEI.
translation: 請你將兩隻手臂伸直，向前舉起。

english: Please raise both arms out to your sides.
transliteration: CHING NAY JEUNG LOENG-JEK SAU-BEI HEUNG LOENG-BIN GUI-HEI.
translation: 請你將兩隻手臂向兩邊舉起。

english: Please lift your arms above your head.
transliteration: CHING NAY JEUNG LOENG-JEK SAU-BEI GUI-GWO TAU-DING.
translation: 請你將兩隻手臂舉過頭頂。

english: Please reach behind your head.
transliteration: CHING NAY JEUNG JEK-SAU SUN-DO TAU-HAU-BIN.
translation: 請你將隻手伸到頭後面。

english: Please reach behind your back.
transliteration: CHING NAY JEUNG JEK-SAU SUN-DO BUI-BEK-HAU-BIN.
translation: 請你將隻手伸到背脊後面。

english: Keep your elbow by your side and turn your hand outward.
transliteration: SAU-JANG TIP-JYU SUN, JEK-SAU HEUNG-NGO JUEN.
translation: 手踭貼住身，隻手向外轉。

english: Keep your elbow by your side and turn your hand inward.
transliteration: SAU-JANG TIP-JYU SUN, JEK-SAU HEUNG-NEI JUEN.
translation: 手踭貼住身，隻手向內轉。

english: Please push your arm upward against my hand.
transliteration: CHING NAY YUNG SAU TEUI-SEUNG, DING-JYU NGO JEK-SAU.
translation: 請你用手推向上，頂住我隻手。

english: Please keep your arm up while I gently push down.
transliteration: NGO HING-HING HEUNG-HA TEUI GE SI, CHING NAY TO-JYU JEK-SAU-BEI.
translation: 我輕輕向下推嘅時候，請你托住隻手臂。

english: Please bring your arm across your chest.
transliteration: CHING NAY JEUNG JEK-SAU-BEI HONG-GWO HUNG-KAU.
translation: 請你將隻手臂橫過胸口。

english: Please bend and straighten your elbow.
transliteration: CHING NAY WUK-KOOK TUNG JING-JIK SAU-JANG.
translation: 請你屈曲同伸直手踭。

english: Please turn your palm up, then down.
transliteration: CHING NAY SAU-JEUNG HEUNG-SEUNG, JOI HEUNG-HA.
translation: 請你手掌向上，再向下。

english: Please bend your wrist up and down.
transliteration: CHING NAY SAU-WAAN HEUNG-SEUNG TUNG HEUNG-HA WUK.
translation: 請你手腕向上同向下屈。

english: Please move your wrist from side to side.
transliteration: CHING NAY SAU-WAAN HEUNG-JO TUNG HEUNG-YAU UK.
translation: 請你手腕向左同向右郁。

english: Please make a fist.
transliteration: CHING NAY WUN-KUEN.
translation: 請你握拳。

english: Please open your hand and spread your fingers.
transliteration: CHING NAY JEUNG-HOI JEK-SAU, TUNG-MAI JEUNG-HOI SAU-JEE.
translation: 請你張開隻手，同埋張開手指。

english: Please touch your thumb to each fingertip.
transliteration: CHING NAY YUNG MOU-JEE JOOK-GOH TIM KEI-TA SAU-JEE-JIM.
translation: 請你用拇指逐個掂其他手指尖。

english: Please squeeze my fingers as hard as you can.
transliteration: CHING NAY YUNG-JUN-LIK WUN-JYU NGO DI SAU-JEE.
translation: 請你用盡力握住我啲手指。

english: Please hold your fingers apart while I push them together.
transliteration: NGO TEUI-JUN NAY DI SAU-JEE GE SI, CHING NAY JIM-LEUNG FAN-HOI KEUI-DEI.
translation: 我推埋你啲手指嘅時候，請你盡量分開佢哋。

english: Please straighten your fingers against my hand.
transliteration: CHING NAY DING-JYU NGO JEK-SAU, JING-JIK SAU-JEE.
translation: 請你頂住我隻手，伸直手指。

english: Does tapping here cause tingling in your fingers?
transliteration: NGO HAI NEI-DOU HAAK GE SI, NAY DI SAU-JEE WUI-M-WUI MA-BEI?
translation: 我喺呢度敲嘅時候，你啲手指會唔會麻痺？

english: Please bend both wrists and hold the backs of your hands together.
transliteration: CHING NAY WUK-HEI LOENG-BIN SAU-WAAN, SAU-BEK TIP-JYU SAU-BEK.
translation: 請你屈起兩邊手腕，手背貼住手背。
